title: Pentateuhul Samaritean — Deuteronom
description: Deuteronom din Pentateuhul Samaritean, păstrând textul samaritean, versetele și textul englez din sursa de bază, cu adaptare în limba română.

samaritan_hebrew.dataset: DT-UCPH/sp - Text-Fabric Dataset of the Samaritan Pentateuch
samaritan_hebrew.project: Samaritanus project, Martin-Luther-Universitat Halle-Wittenberg (dir. Stefan Schorch)
manuscripts: MS Dublin Chester Beatty Library 751 (Genesis 1 - Deuteronomy 32:36)
samaritan_hebrew.critical_edition: Stefan Schorch (ed.), The Samaritan Pentateuch: A Critical editio maior, Berlin: de Gruyter, 2018-
samaritan_hebrew.processing: Verse text rendered via the Text-Fabric text API (T.text); NFKC normalisation; combining marks (vowel/consonant-disambiguation points) stripped; whitespace collapsed to produce clean consonantal Hebrew in standard square script.

english_translation.alignment_method: For each verse, the Alamo Polyglot Samaritan Hebrew column was compared (after the same normalisation) to the Chester Beatty 751/Garizim 1 Hebrew at the same (book, chapter, verse). English was attached only when the two Hebrew texts matched closely (identical or minor orthographic variants). Where the Samaritan verse divisions diverge from the English source's verse scheme (observed in parts of Genesis 32, Exodus 7-8 and 20, Leviticus 5-6, Numbers 16-17 and 21), the source English describes a different, shifted verse, so it was withheld rather than misattached.

verse_scheme: Samaritan Pentateuch verse divisions, as transcribed in DT-UCPH/sp from the source manuscripts

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה הדברים אשר דבר משה אל כל ישראל בעבר הירדן במדבר בערבה מול סוף בין פראן ובין תפל ולבן וחצרות ודי זהב
verses.english: These [be] the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red [sea], between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.romanian: Acestea sunt cuvintele pe care Moise le-a rostit lui toți Israel on dincoace de Iordan in the pustie, in the câmpie peste împotriva the Red mare, between Paran, și Tophel, și Laban, și Hazeroth, și Dizahab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אחד עשר יום מחורב דרך הר שעיר עד קדש ברנע
verses.english: ([There are] eleven days' [journey] from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
verses.romanian: ([acolo sunt] unsprezece zile' [călătorie] din Horeb by the cale of munte Seir lui Kadesh-barnea.)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בארבעים שנה בעשתי עשר חדש באחד לחדש דבר משה אל בני ישראל ככל אשר צוה יהוה אתו אליהם
verses.english: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first [day] of the month, [that] Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece in the fortieth an, in the al unsprezecelea lună, on the întâi [zi] of the lună, [că] Moise i-a vorbit lui the copiii lui Israel, according lui toți că DOMNUL had given him in poruncă lui them;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אחרי הכותו את סיחון מלך האמרי אשר ישב בחשבון ואת עוג מלך הבשן אשר ישב בעשתרות באדרעי
verses.english: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.romanian: după he had ucis Sihon the rege of the Amorites, care dwelt in Heshbon, și Og the rege of Bashan, care dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בעבר הירדן בארץ מואב הואל משה באר את התורה הזאת לאמר
verses.english: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying
verses.romanian: On dincoace de Iordan, in the țară of Moab, began Moise to declare this lege, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהינו דבר אלינו בחורב לאמר רב לכם שבת בהר הזה
verses.english: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.romanian: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru a vorbit lui us in Horeb, saying, voi au dwelt long enough in this munte:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פנו וסעו לכם ובאו הר האמרי ואל כל שכינו בערבה בהר ובשפלה בנגב ובחוף הים ארץ הכנעני והלבנון עד הנהר הגדול נהר פרת
verses.english: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all [the places] nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.romanian: a se întoarce you, și a lua vostru călătorie, și a merge to the munte of the Amorites, și lui toți [the places] nigh thereunto, in the câmpie, in the hills, și in the vale, in the south, și by the sea side, to the țară of the Canaanites, și lui Lebanon, lui the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראו נתתי לפניכם את הארץ באו ורשו את הארץ אשר נשבעתי לאבתיכם לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב לתת לזרעם אחריהם
verses.english: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them, to their seed after them.
verses.romanian: iată, I au a așeza the țară înainte you: a intra și a stăpâni țara pe care DOMNUL sware lui vostru părinți, Abraham, Isaac, și Jacob, to a da lui them, to lor sămânță după them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמר אליכם בעת ההיא לאמר לא אוכל לבדי שאת אתכם
verses.english: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.romanian: și I a vorbit lui you at că time, saying, sunt nu able to bear you myself alone:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהיכם הרבה אתכם והנכם היום ככוכבי השמים לרב
verses.english: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye [are] this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt multiplied you, și, iată, voi [sunt] this zi as the stars of heaven căci multitude.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהי אבתיכם יסף עליכם ככם אלף פעמים ויברך אתכם כאשר דבר לכם
verses.english: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye [are], and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.romanian: (DOMNUL Dumnezeul părinților voștri a face you a mie times so many more as voi [sunt], și bless you, as he sunt promised you!)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איכה אשא לבדי טרחכם משאכם וריבכם
verses.english: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, your burden, and your strife?
verses.romanian: cum poate I myself alone bear vostru cumbrance, vostru burden, și vostru strife?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הבו לכם אנשים חכמים ונבונים וידעים לשבטיכם ואשימם בראשיכם
verses.english: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.romanian: a lua you wise oameni, și understanding, și known între vostru seminții, și I va a face them conducători peste you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותענו אתי ותאמרו טוב הדבר אשר דברת לעשות
verses.english: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken [is] good [for us] to do.
verses.romanian: și voi a răspuns me, și a spus, The thing care tu hast spoken [este] good [căci us] to a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואקח את ראשי שבטיכם אנשים חכמים וידעים ואתן אתם ראשים עליכם שרי אלפים ושרי מאות שרי חמשים ושרי עשרות ושטרים לשבטיכם
verses.english: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.romanian: So I a luat the chief of vostru seminții, wise oameni, și known, și a făcut them capete peste you, captains peste mii, și captains peste sute, captains peste fifties, și captains peste tens, și officers între vostru seminții.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואצוה את שפטיכם בעת ההיא לאמר שמעו בין אחיכם ושפטתם צדק בין איש ובין אחיו ובין גרו
verses.english: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear [the causes] between your brethren, and judge righteously between [every] man and his brother, and the stranger [that is] with him.
verses.romanian: și I charged vostru judecători at că time, saying, a auzi [the causes] between vostru brethren, și judecător righteously between [fiecare] om și lui frate, și the străin [că este] cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תכירו פנים במשפט כקטן כגדול תשמעון לא תגורו מפני איש כי המשפט לאלהים הוא והדבר אשר יקשה מכם תקריבון אלי ושמעתיו
verses.english: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; [but] ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment [is] God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring [it] unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.romanian: voi va nu respect persons in judecată; [dar] voi va a auzi the small as well as the great; voi va nu fi afraid of the față of om; căci the judecată [este] Dumnezeu's: și the cause că este too hard căci you, a aduce [it] lui me, și I va a auzi it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואצוה אתכם בעת ההיא את כל הדברים אשר תעשון
verses.english: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.romanian: și I commanded you at că time toți the things care voi trebuie să a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסעה מחורב ונלכה את כל המדבר הגדול והנורא ההוא אשר ראיתם דרך הר האמרי כאשר צוה יהוה אלהינו אתנו ונבוא עד קדש ברנע
verses.english: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.romanian: și când we a plecat din Horeb, we a mers prin toți că great și terrible pustie, care voi a văzut by the cale of the munte of the Amorites, as DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru commanded us; și we a venit to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמר אליכם באתם עד הר האמרי אשר יהוה אלהינו נתן לנו
verses.english: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.romanian: și I a spus lui you, voi sunt a veni lui the munte of the Amorites, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru doth a da lui us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראה נתן יהוה אלהיך לפניך את הארץ עלה רש כאשר דבר יהוה אלהי אבתיך לך אל תירא ואל תחת
verses.english: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up [and] possess [it], as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.romanian: iată, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt a așeza the țară înainte te: a se urca [și] a stăpâni [it], as DOMNUL Dumnezeu of tău părinți sunt a spus lui te; a se teme nu, neither fi discouraged.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקרבון אלי כלכם ותאמרו נשלחה אנשים לפנינו ויחפדו לנו את הארץ וישיבו אתנו דבר את הדרך אשר נעלה בה ואת הערים אשר נבוא עליהן
verses.english: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.romanian: și voi a venit lângă lui me fiecare unu of you, și a spus, We va send oameni înainte us, și they va search us out the țară, și a aduce us cuvânt again by ce cale we trebuie a se urca, și into ce cetăți we va a veni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וייטב בעיני הדבר ואקח מכם שנים עשר אנשים איש אחד לשבט
verses.english: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.romanian: și the saying pleased me well: și I a luat doisprezece oameni of you, unu of a seminție:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפנו ויעלו ההרה ויבאו עד נחל אשכול וירגלו אתה
verses.english: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.romanian: și they s-a întors și a mers up into the munte, și a venit lui the valley of Eshcol, și searched it out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחו בידם מפרי הארץ ויורידו אלינו וישיבו אתנו דבר ויאמרו טובה הארץ אשר יהוה אלהינו נתן לנו
verses.english: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought [it] down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, [It is] a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.romanian: și they a luat of the rod of the țară in lor mâini, și a adus [it] down lui us, și a adus us cuvânt again, și a spus, [It este] a good țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru doth a da us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא אביתם לעלות ותמרו את פי יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding voi ar nu a se urca, dar rebelled împotriva the poruncă of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותרגנו באהליכם ותאמרו בשנאת יהוה אתנו הוציאנו מארץ מצרים לתת אתנו ביד האמרי להשמידנו
verses.english: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.romanian: și voi murmured in vostru tents, și a spus, pentru că DOMNUL hated us, he sunt a adus us forth out of the țara Egiptului, to deliver us into the mână of the Amorites, to a nimici us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אנה אנחנו עלים ואחינו המיסו את לבבנו לאמר עם גדול ורב ממנו ערים גדלות ובצרות בשמים וגם בני ענקים ראינו שם
verses.english: Whither shall we go up? And our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people [is] greater and more numerous than we; and the cities [are] great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.romanian: Whither va we a se urca? și nostru brethren au discouraged nostru inimă, saying, The popor [este] greater și more numerous than we; și the cetăți [sunt] great și walled up to heaven; și moreover we au seen the fiii lui the Anakims acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמר אליכם לא תערצון ולא תיראון מהם
verses.english: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.romanian: atunci I a spus lui you, Dread nu, neither fi afraid of them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהיכם ההלך לפניכם הוא ילחם לכם ככל אשר עשה אתכם במצרים לעיניכם
verses.english: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.romanian: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău care merge înainte you, he va a lupta căci you, după toți că he a făcut căci you in Egypt înainte vostru ochi;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובמדבר אשר ראית אשר נשאך יהוה אלהיך כאשר ישא איש את בנו בכל הדרך אשר הלכתם עד באכם עד המקום הזה
verses.english: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.romanian: și in the pustie, where tu hast seen cum că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău bare te, as a om doth bear lui fiu, in toți the cale că voi a mers, until voi a venit into this place.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובדבר הזה אינכם מאמנים ביהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God
verses.romanian: Yet in this thing voi a făcut nu believe DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ההלך לפניכם בדרך לתור לכם מקום להחנותכם באש לילה להראותכם בדרך אשר תלכו בה ובענן יומם
verses.english: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents [in], in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.romanian: care a mers in the cale înainte you, to search you out a place to pitch vostru tents [in], in foc by night, to shew you by ce cale voi trebuie să a merge, și in a cloud by zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע יהוה את קול דבריכם ויקצף וישבע לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a auzit the voice of vostru cuvinte, și era wroth, și sware, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם יראה איש באנשים האלה הדור הרע הזה את הארץ הטובה אשר נשבעתי לאבתיכם
verses.english: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers
verses.romanian: negresit acolo va nu unu of these oameni of this evil generation a vedea că good țară, care I sware to a da lui vostru părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זולתי כלב בן יפנה הוא יראנה ולו אתן את הארץ אשר דרך בה ולבניו יען כי מלא אחרי יהוה
verses.english: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
verses.romanian: Save Caleb the fiu of Jephunneh; he va a vedea it, și to him va I a da the țară că he sunt trodden upon, și to lui copii, pentru că he sunt wholly followed DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: גם בי התאנף יהוה בגללכם לאמר גם אתה לא תבוא שמה
verses.english: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.romanian: de asemenea DOMNUL era angry cu me căci vostru sakes, saying, tu de asemenea shalt nu a intra thither.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהושע בן נון העמד לפניך הוא יבוא שמה אתו אחזיק כי הוא ינחלנה את ישראל
verses.english: [But] Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.romanian: [dar] Iosua the fiu of Nun, care standeth înainte te, he va a intra thither: encourage him: căci he va cause Israel to a moșteni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבוז יהיה ובניכם הם יבאו שם ולהם אתננה והם יירשוה
verses.english: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.romanian: Moreover vostru little ones, care voi a spus trebuie să fi a prey, și vostru copii, care in că zi had no knowledge between good și evil, they va a intra thither, și lui them va I a da it, și they va a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתם פנו וסעו לכם המדברה דרך ים סוף
verses.english: But [as for] you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.romanian: dar [as căci] you, a se întoarce you, și a lua vostru călătorie into the pustie by the cale of the Marea Roșie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותענו ותאמרו אלי חטאנו ליהוה אלהינו אנחנו נעלה ונלחמנו ככל אשר צונו יהוה אלהינו ותחגרו איש את כלי מלחמתו ותהיינו לעלות ההרה
verses.english: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD God of us, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.romanian: atunci voi a răspuns și a spus lui me, We au sinned împotriva DOMNUL Dumnezeu of us, we va a se urca și a lupta, după toți că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru commanded us. și când voi had girded on fiecare om lui weapons of război, voi erau ready to a se urca into the hill.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי אמר להם לא תעלו ולא תלחמו כי אינני בקרבכם ולא תנגפו לפני איביכם
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I [am] not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, a spune lui them, a merge nu up, neither a lupta; căci I [am] nu între you; lest voi fi smitten înainte vostru enemies.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואדברה אליכם ולא שמעתם ותמרו את פי יהוה אלהיכם ותזידו ותעלו ההרה
verses.english: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD God of you, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.romanian: So I a vorbit lui you; și voi ar nu a auzi, dar rebelled împotriva the poruncă of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you, și a mers presumptuously up into the hill.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא העמלקי והכנעני הישב בהר ההוא לקראתכם וירדפו אתכם כאשר תעשינה הדברים ויכתו אתכם בשעיר עד חרמה
verses.english: And the Amalekites and the Cananites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, [even] unto Hormah.
verses.romanian: și the Amalekites și the Cananites, care dwelt in că munte, a venit out împotriva you, și chased you, as bees a face, și a nimicit you in Seir, [even] lui Hormah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותשבו ותבכו לפני יהוה ולא שמע יהוה בקולכם ולא האזין אליכם
verses.english: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.romanian: și voi returned și wept înainte DOMNUL; dar DOMNUL ar nu hearken to vostru voice, nor a da ureche lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותשבו בקדש ימים רבים כימים אשר ישבתם
verses.english: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode [there].
verses.romanian: So voi abode in Kadesh many zile, according lui the zile că voi abode [acolo].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפנה ונסעה המדברה דרך ים סוף כאשר דבר יהוה אלי ונסב את הר שעיר ימים רבים
verses.english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.romanian: atunci we s-a întors, și a luat nostru călătorie into the pustie by the cale of the Marea Roșie, as DOMNUL a vorbit lui me: și we compassed munte Seir many zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto me, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit lui me, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רב לכם סוב את ההר הזה פנו לכם צפונה
verses.english: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.romanian: voi au compassed this munte long enough: a se întoarce you northward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת העם צוי לאמר אתם עברים בגבול אחיכם בני עשו הישבים בשעיר וייראו מכם ונשמרתם מאד
verses.english: And command thou the people, saying, Ye [are] to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.romanian: și command tu the popor, saying, voi [sunt] to a trece prin the coast of vostru brethren the copiii lui Esau, care dwell in Seir; și they va fi afraid of you: a lua voi good heed lui yourselves de aceea:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תתגרו בם כי לא אתן לכם מארצם ירשה עד מדרך כף רגל כי ירשה לעשו נתתי את הר שעיר
verses.english: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land for possession, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau [for] a possession.
verses.romanian: Meddle nu cu them; căci I va nu a da you of lor țară căci moștenire, no, nu so much as a picior breadth; pentru că I au given munte Seir lui Esau [căci] a moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אכל תשברו מאתם בכסף ואכלתם וגם מים תכירו מאתם בכסף ושתיתם
verses.english: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.romanian: voi va buy carne of them căci money, că voi poate eat; și voi va de asemenea buy apă of them căci money, că voi poate drink.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהוה אלהיך ברכך בכל מעשה ידיך ידע לכתך את המדבר הגדול הזה זה ארבעים שנה יהוה אלהיך עמך לא חסרת דבר ואשלחה מלאכים אל מלך אדום לאמר אעברה בארצך לא אטה בשדה ובכרם ולא נשתה מי בור דרך המלך נלך לא נסור ימין ושמאל עד אשר נעבר גבולך ויאמר לא תעבר בי פן בחרב אצא לקראתך
verses.english: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hands: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God [hath been] with thee; thou hast lacked nothing. And I am sending messengers to king Edom to say: I shall cross over your land. Not I shall turn in the field and in the gardens, and not we shall drink from the wells. By the way of the king we shall go and not we shall turn right and left until we have crossed over boundary of you. And he said: You shall not cross in me, lest in sword I shall go out to meet you.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt binecuvântat te in toți the works of tău mâini: he knoweth tău walking prin this great pustie: these patruzeci ani DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [sunt been] cu te; tu hast lacked nimic. și sunt sending messengers to rege Edom to a spune: I va cross peste vostru țară. nu I va a se întoarce in the câmp și in the gardens, și nu we va drink din the wells. By the cale of the rege we va a merge și nu we va a se întoarce right și left until we au crossed peste boundary of you. și he a spus: să nu cross in me, lest in sword I va a ieși to meet you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונעברה מאת אחינו בני עשו הישבים בשעיר מדרך הערבה מאילת ומעציונ גבר ונפנה ונעברה דרך מדבר מואב
verses.english: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.romanian: și când we a trecut by din nostru brethren the copiii lui Esau, care dwelt in Seir, prin the cale of the câmpie din Elath, și din Ezion-gaber, we s-a întors și a trecut by the cale of the pustie of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי אל תצור את מואב ואל תתגר בו כי לא אתן לך מארצו ירשה כי לבני לוט נתתי את ער ירשה
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with him in battle: for I will not give thee of their land [for] a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot [for] a possession.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Distress nu the Moabites, neither contend cu him in battle: căci I va nu a da te of lor țară [căci] a moștenire; pentru că I au given Ar lui the copiii lui Lot [căci] a moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האימים לפנים ישבו בה עם גדול ורב ורם כענקים
verses.english: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.romanian: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a popor great, și many, și tall, as the Anakims;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והמואבים יקראו להם אימים
verses.english: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.romanian: care de asemenea erau accounted giants, as the Anakims; dar the Moabites a chema them Emims.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשעיר ישבו החרי לפנים ובני עשו יירשום וישמדם יהוה מפניהם ויירשום וישבו תחתיהם כאשר עשה ישראל לארץ ירשתו אשר נתן יהוה להם
verses.english: The Hori also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, and they had destroyed them, LORD, from before them, and possessed and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
verses.romanian: The Hori de asemenea dwelt in Seir beforetime; dar the copiii lui Esau succeeded them, și they had a nimicit them, DOMNUL, din înainte them, și a stăpânit și dwelt in lor stead; as Israel a făcut lui the țară of lui moștenire, care DOMNUL a dat lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה קומו סעו ועברו לכם את נחל זרד ונעברה את נחל זרד
verses.english: And now rise up, [said I] and journey, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.romanian: și acum a se ridica up, [a spus I] și călătorie, și get you peste the brook Zered. și we a mers peste the brook Zered.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והימים אשר הלכנו מקדש ברנע עד אשר עברנו את נחל זרד שלשים ושמנה שנה עד תם כל הדור אנשי המלחמה מקרב המחנה כאשר נשבע יהוה להם
verses.english: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, [was] thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
verses.romanian: și the space in care we a venit din Kadesh-barnea, until we erau a veni peste the brook Zered, [era] treizeci și opt ani; until toți the generation of the oameni of război erau wasted out din între the host, as DOMNUL sware lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגם יד יהוה היתה בם להמם מקרב המחנה עד תמם
verses.english: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.romanian: căci într-adevăr the mână of DOMNUL era împotriva them, to a nimici them din între the host, until they erau consumed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי כאשר תמו כל אנשי המלחמה למות מקרב העם
verses.english: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people
verses.romanian: So it a venit to a trece, când toți the oameni of război erau consumed și dead din între the popor

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי לאמר
verses.english: That the LORD said unto me, saying
verses.romanian: că DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אתה עבר היום את גבול מואב את ער
verses.english: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.romanian: tu art to a trece peste prin Ar, the coast of Moab, this zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבת מול בני עמון אל תצורם ואל תתגר בם כי לא אתן מארץ בני עמון לך ירשה כי לבני לוט נתתיה ירשה
verses.english: And [when] thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon [any] possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot [for] a possession.
verses.romanian: și [când] tu comest nigh peste împotriva the copiii lui Ammon, distress them nu, nor meddle cu them: căci I va nu a da te of the țară of the copiii lui Ammon [vreun] moștenire; pentru că I au given it lui the copiii lui Lot [căci] a moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארץ רפאים תחשב אף היא רפאים ישבו בה לפנים והעמונים יקראו להם זמזמים
verses.english: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;)
verses.romanian: (că de asemenea era accounted a țară of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; și the Ammonites a chema them Zamzummims;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עם גדול ורב ורם כענקים וישמדם יהוה מפניהם ויירשום וישבו תחתיהם
verses.english: (A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:)
verses.romanian: (A popor great, și many, și tall, as the Anakims; dar DOMNUL a nimicit them înainte them; și they succeeded them, și dwelt in lor stead:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר עשה לבני עשו הישבים בשעיר אשר השמיד את החרי מפניהם ויירשום וישבו תחתיהם עד היום הזה
verses.english: (As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:)
verses.romanian: (As he a făcut to the copiii lui Esau, care dwelt in Seir, când he a nimicit the Horims din înainte them; și they succeeded them, și dwelt in lor stead even lui this zi:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעוים הישבים בחצרים עד עזה כפתרים היוצאים מכפתר השמידם וישבו תחתם
verses.english: (And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, [even] unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.romanian: (și the Avims care dwelt in Hazerim, [even] lui Azzah, the Caphtorims, care a venit forth out of Caphtor, a nimicit them, și dwelt in lor stead.)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קומו סעו ועברו את נחל ארנן ראה נתתי בידך את סיחון מלך חשבון האמרי ואת ארצו החל רש והתגר בו מלחמה
verses.english: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess [it], and contend with him in battle.
verses.romanian: a se ridica voi up, a lua vostru călătorie, și a trece peste the river Arnon: iată, I au given into al tău mână Sihon the Amorite, rege of Heshbon, și lui țară: begin to a stăpâni [it], și contend cu him in battle.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: היום הזה החל תת פחדך ויראתך על פני העמים תחת כל השמים אשר ישמעו את שמעך ורגזו וחלו מפניך
verses.english: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations [that are] under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.romanian: This zi va I begin to a pune the dread of te și the a se teme of te upon the neamuri [că sunt] sub the whole heaven, care va a auzi report of te, și va tremble, și fi in anguish pentru că of te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשלחה מלאכים ממדבר קדמות אל סיחון מלך חשבון דברי שלום לאמר
verses.english: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying
verses.romanian: și I sent messengers out of the pustie of Kedemoth lui Sihon rege of Heshbon cu cuvinte of peace, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אעברה בארצך בדרך בדרך אלך לא אסור ימין ושמאל
verses.english: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.romanian: Let me a trece prin tău țară: I va a merge along by the high cale, I va neither a se întoarce lui the right mână nor to the left.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אכל בכסף תשבירני ואכלתי ומים בכסף תתן לי ושתיתי רק אעברה ברגלי
verses.english: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.romanian: să sell me carne căci money, că I poate eat; și a da me apă căci money, că I poate drink: numai I va a trece prin on meu picioare;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר עשו לי בני עשו הישבים בשעיר והמואבים הישבים בער עד אשר אעברה את הירדן אל הארץ אשר יהוה אלהינו נתן לנו
verses.english: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
verses.romanian: (As the copiii lui Esau care dwell in Seir, și the Moabites care dwell in Ar, a făcut lui me;) until I va a trece peste Iordan into the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru giveth us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא אבה סיחון מלך חשבון העבירנו בו כי הקשה יהוה אלהיך את רוחו ואמץ את לבבו למען תתו בידך כיום הזה
verses.english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as [appeareth] this day.
verses.romanian: dar Sihon rege of Heshbon ar nu let us a trece de el: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău hardened lui duh, și a făcut lui inimă obstinate, că he ar putea deliver him into tău mână, as [appeareth] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי ראה החלתי תת לפניך את סיחון מלך חשבון האמרי ואת ארצו החל רש לרשת את ארצו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, iată, I au begun to a da Sihon rege of Heshbon, the Amorite, și lui țară înainte te: begin to a stăpâni, că tu mayest a moșteni lui țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא סיחון לקראתנו הוא וכל עמו למלחמה יחצה
verses.english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.romanian: atunci Sihon a venit out împotriva us, he și toți lui popor, to a lupta at Jahaz.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתנהו יהוה אלהינו לפנינו ונכה אתו ואת בניו ואת כל עמו
verses.english: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru delivered him înainte us; și we a lovit him, și lui fii, și toți lui popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונלכדה את כל עריו בעת ההיא ונחרימה את כל עריו מתם הנשים והטף לא השאירנו שריד
verses.english: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.romanian: și we a luat toți lui cetăți at că time, și utterly a nimicit the oameni, și the femei, și the little ones, of fiecare cetate, we left niciun to remain:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק הבהמה בזזנו לנו ושלל הערים אשר לכדנו
verses.english: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.romanian: numai the vite we a luat căci a prey lui ourselves, și the spoil of the cetăți care we a luat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מערער אשר על שפת נחל ארנן והעיר אשר בנחל ועד הגלעד לא היתה קריה אשר שגבה ממנו את הכל נתן יהוה אלהינו בידנו
verses.english: From Aroer, which [is] by the brink of the river of Arnon, and [from] the city that [is] by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto our hand:
verses.romanian: din Aroer, care [este] by the brink of the river of Arnon, și [din] the cetate că [este] by the river, even lui Gilead, acolo era nu unu cetate too strong căci us: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru delivered toți lui nostru mână:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק אל ארץ בני עמון לא קרבת כל יד נחל היבק וערי ההר וכל אשר צונו יהוה אלהינו
verses.english: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, [nor] unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
verses.romanian: numai lui the țară of the copiii lui Ammon tu camest nu, [nor] lui vreun place of the river Jabbok, nor lui the cetăți in the munți, nor lui whatsoever DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru forbad us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפנה ונעלה דרך הבשן ויצא עוג מלך הבשן לקראתנו הוא וכל עמו למלחמה אדרעי
verses.english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.romanian: atunci we s-a întors, și a mers up the cale to Bashan: și Og the rege of Bashan a venit out împotriva us, he și toți lui popor, to battle at Edrei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי אל תירא אתו כי בידך נתתי אתו ואת כל עמו ואת ארצו ועשית לו כאשר עשית לסיחון מלך האמרי אשר ישב בחשבון
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, a se teme him nu: căci I va deliver him, și toți lui popor, și lui țară, into tău mână; și să a face lui him as tu didst lui Sihon rege of the Amorites, care dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן יהוה אלהינו בידנו גם את עוג מלך הבשן ואת כל עמו ונכנו עד בלתי השאיר לו שריד
verses.english: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.romanian: So DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru delivered into nostru mâini Og de asemenea, the rege of Bashan, și toți lui popor: și we a lovit him until niciun era left to him remaining.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונלכדה את כל עריו בעת ההיא לא היתה קריה אשר לא לקחנו מאתם ששים עיר כל חבל הארגב ממלכות עוג בבשן
verses.english: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.romanian: și we a luat toți lui cetăți at că time, acolo era nu a cetate care we a luat nu din them, threescore cetăți, toți the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל אלה ערים בצרות חומה גבחה דלתים ובריח לבד מערי הפרזי הרבה מאד
verses.english: All these cities [were] fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.romanian: toți these cetăți [erau] fenced cu high walls, porți, și bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונחרימה אתם כאשר עשינו לסיחון מלך חשבון החרים כל עיר מתם הנשים והטף
verses.english: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.romanian: și we utterly a nimicit them, as we a făcut lui Sihon rege of Heshbon, utterly destroying the oameni, femei, și copii, of fiecare cetate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הבהמה ושלל הערים בזזנו לנו
verses.english: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.romanian: dar toți the vite, și the spoil of the cetăți, we a luat căci a prey to ourselves.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונקח בעת ההיא את הארץ מיד שני מלכי האמרי אשר בעבר הירדן מנחל ארנן ועד הר חרמון
verses.english: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that [was] on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon and unto mount Hermon;
verses.romanian: și we a luat at că time out of the mână of the doi regi of the Amorites the țară că [era] on dincoace de Iordan, din the river of Arnon și lui munte Hermon;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צידנים יקראו לחרמון שרין והאמרי יקראו לו שניר
verses.english: ([Which] Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.romanian: ([care] Hermon the Sidonians a chema Sirion; și the Amorites a chema it Shenir;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ערי המישור וכל הגלעד וכל הבשן עד סלכה ואדרעי ערי ממלכת עוג בבשן
verses.english: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.romanian: toți the cetăți of the câmpie, și toți Gilead, și toți Bashan, lui Salchah și Edrei, cetăți of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי רק עוג מלך הבשן נשאר מיתר הרפאים הנה ערשו ערש ברזל הלוא היא ברבת בני עמון תשע אמות ארכה וארבע אמות רחבה באמת איש
verses.english: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead [was] a bedstead of iron; [is] it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits [was] the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.romanian: căci numai Og rege of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; iată, lui bedstead [era] a bedstead of fier; [este] it nu in Rabbath of the copiii lui Ammon? nouă cubits [era] the length thereof, și patru cubits the breadth of it, după the cubit of a om.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הארץ הזאת ירשנו בעת ההיא מערער אשר על שפת נחל ארנן וחצי הר הגלעד ועריו נתתי לראובני ולגדי
verses.english: And this land, [which] we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which [is] by the shores of the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.romanian: și this țară, [care] we a stăpânit at că time, din Aroer, care [este] by the shores of the river Arnon, și half munte Gilead, și the cetăți thereof, a dat I lui the Reubenites și to the Gadites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתר הגלעד וכל הבשן ממלכת עוג נתתי לחצי שבט המנשה כל חבל הארגב לכל הבשן ההוא יקרא ארץ רפאים
verses.english: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, [being] the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.romanian: și the rest of Gilead, și toți Bashan, [fiind] the kingdom of Og, a dat I lui the half seminție of Manasseh; toți the region of Argob, cu toți Bashan, care era a chemat the țară of giants.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאיר בן מנשה לקח את כל חבל הארגב עד גבול הגישורי והמכעתי ויקרא אתם על שמו את הבשן חות יאיר עד היום הזה
verses.english: And Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.
verses.romanian: și Jair the fiu of Manasseh a luat toți the țară of Argob lui the coasts of Geshuri și Maachathi; și a chemat them după lui own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, lui this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמכיר נתתי את הגלעד
verses.english: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.romanian: și I a dat Gilead lui Machir.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולראובני ולגדי נתתי מן הגלעד ועד נחל ארנן תוך הנחל וגבול עד יבק הנחל גבול בני עמון
verses.english: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, [which is] the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.romanian: și lui the Reubenites și lui the Gadites I a dat din Gilead even lui the river Arnon half the valley, și the border even lui the river Jabbok, [care este] the border of the copiii lui Ammon;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והערבה והירדנה וגבול מכנרת ועד ים הערבה ים המלח תחת אשדות הפסגה מזרחה
verses.english: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast [thereof], from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, [even] the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.
verses.romanian: The câmpie de asemenea, și Iordan, și the coast [thereof], din Chinnereth even lui the sea of the câmpie, [even] the salt sea, sub Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואצוה אתכם בעת ההיא לאמר יהוה אלהיכם נתן לכם את הארץ הזאת לרשתה חלוצים תעברו לפני אחיכם בני ישראל כל בני חיל
verses.english: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all [that are] meet for the war.
verses.romanian: și I commanded you at că time, saying, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt given you this țară to a stăpâni it: voi va a trece peste armed înainte vostru brethren the copiii lui Israel, toți [că sunt] meet căci the război.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק טפכם ונשיכם ומקניכם ידעתי כי מקנה רב לכם ישבו בעריכם אשר נתתי לכם
verses.english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, ([for] I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.romanian: dar vostru wives, și vostru little ones, și vostru vite, ([căci] I a cunoaște că voi au much vite,) va abide in vostru cetăți care I au given you;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עד אשר יניח יהוה לאחיכם ככם ויירשו גם הם את הארץ אשר יהוה אלהיכם נתן להם בעבר הירדן ושבתם איש לירשתו אשר נתתי לכם
verses.english: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and [until] they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and [then] shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.romanian: Until DOMNUL au given rest lui vostru brethren, as well as lui you, și [until] they de asemenea a stăpâni țara care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt given them dincolo de Iordan: și [atunci] va voi return fiecare om lui lui moștenire, care I au given you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת יהושע צויתי בעת ההיא לאמר עיניך הראות את אשר עשה יהוה לשני המלכים האלה כן יעשה יהוה לכל הממלכות אשר אתה עבר שמה
verses.english: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.romanian: și I commanded Iosua at că time, saying, al tău ochi au seen toți că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt done lui these doi regi: so va DOMNUL a face lui toți the kingdoms whither tu passest.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תיראם כי יהוה אלהיכם הוא הנלחם לכם
verses.english: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
verses.romanian: voi va nu a se teme them: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău he va a lupta căci you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתחננה אל יהוה בעת ההיא לאמר
verses.english: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying
verses.romanian: și I besought DOMNUL at că time, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אדני יהוה אתה החלת להראות את עבדך את גדלך ואת ידך החזקה אשר מי אל בשמים ובארץ אשר יעשה כמעשיך וכגבורתיך
verses.english: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God [is there] in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.romanian: O DOMNUL Dumnezeu, tu hast begun to shew tău slujitor tău greatness, și tău mighty mână: căci ce Dumnezeu [este acolo] in heaven sau in pământ, că poate a face după tău works, și după tău ar putea?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אעבר נא ואראה את הארץ הטובה אשר בעבר הירדן ההר הטוב הזה והלבנון
verses.english: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that [is] beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.romanian: I pray te, let me a merge peste, și a vedea the good țară că [este] dincolo de Iordan, că goodly munte, și Lebanon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתעבר יהוה בי למענכם ולא שמע אלי ויאמר יהוה אלי רב לך אל תוסף דבר אלי עוד בדבר הזה
verses.english: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.romanian: dar DOMNUL era wroth cu me căci vostru sakes, și ar nu a auzi me: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Let it suffice te; a vorbi no more lui me of this matter.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עלה אל ראש הפסגה ושא עיניך ימה וצפונה ותימנה ומזרחה וראה בעיניך כי לא תעבר את הירדן הזה
verses.english: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold [it] with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.romanian: Get te up into the top of Pisgah, și lift up al tău ochi westward, și northward, și southward, și eastward, și iată [it] cu al tău ochi: căci să nu a merge peste this Iordan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוי את יהושע וחזקהו ואמצהו כי הוא יעבר לפני העם הזה והוא ינחל אתם את הארץ אשר תראה
verses.english: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.romanian: dar charge Iosua, și encourage him, și strengthen him: căci he va a merge peste înainte this popor, și he va cause them to a moșteni țara care să a vedea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשב בגיא מול בית פעור
verses.english: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
verses.romanian: So we abode in the valley peste împotriva Beth-peor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה ישראל שמע אל החקים ואל המשפטים אשר אנכי מלמד אתכם לעשות למען תחיון ובאתם וירשתם את הארץ אשר יהוה אלהי אבתיכם נתן לכם
verses.english: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do [them], that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.romanian: acum de aceea hearken, O Israel, lui the porunci și lui the judecăți, care I a învăța you, căci to a face [them], că voi poate a trăi, și a intra și a stăpâni țara pe care DOMNUL Dumnezeul părinților voștri giveth you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תוסיפו על הדבר אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום ולא תגרעו ממנו לשמר את מצות יהוה אלהיכם אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם
verses.english: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you today, neither shall ye diminish [ought] from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.romanian: voi va nu add lui the cuvânt care I command you astăzi, neither va voi diminish [ought] din it, că voi poate a păzi poruncile of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău care I command you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עיניכם הראות את אשר עשה יהוה בבעל פעור כי כל האיש אשר הלך אחרי בעל פעור השמידו יהוה אלהיך מקרבך
verses.english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.romanian: vostru ochi au seen ce DOMNUL a făcut pentru că of Baal-peor: căci toți the oameni că followed Baal-peor, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt a nimicit them din între you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתם הדביקים ביהוה אלהיכם חיים כלכם היום
verses.english: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God [are] alive every one of you this day.
verses.romanian: dar voi că a făcut cleave lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [sunt] alive fiecare unu of you this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראו למדתי אתכם חקים ומשפטים כאשר צוני יהוה אלהי לעשות כן בקרב הארץ אשר אתם באים שמה לרשתה
verses.english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.romanian: iată, I au a învățat you porunci și judecăți, even as DOMNUL meu Dumnezeu commanded me, că voi trebuie să a face so in the țară whither voi a merge to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם ועשיתם כי היא חכמתכם ובינתכם לעיני העמים אשר ישמעו את כל החקים האלה ואמרו רק עם חכום ונבון הגוי הגדול הזה
verses.english: Keep therefore and do [them]; for this [is] your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation [is] a wise and understanding people.
verses.romanian: a păzi de aceea și a face [them]; căci this [este] vostru wisdom și vostru understanding in the sight of the neamuri, care va a auzi toți these porunci, și a spune, negresit this great neam [este] a wise și understanding popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מי גוי גדול אשר לו אלהים קרובים אליו כיהוה אלהינו בכל קראנו אליו
verses.english: For what nation [is there so] great, who [hath] God [so] nigh unto them, as the LORD our God [is] in all [things that] we call upon him [for]?
verses.romanian: căci ce neam [este acolo so] great, care [sunt] Dumnezeu [so] nigh lui them, as DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru [este] in toți [things că] we a chema upon him [căci]?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומי גוי גדול אשר לו חקים ומשפטים צדקים ככל התורה הזאת אשר אנכי נתן לפניכם היום
verses.english: And what nation [is there so] great, that hath statutes and judgments [so] righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.romanian: și ce neam [este acolo so] great, că sunt porunci și judecăți [so] righteous as toți this lege, care I a așeza înainte you this zi?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק השמר לך ושמור נפשך מאד פן תשכח את הדברים אשר ראו עיניך ופן יסורו מלבבך כל ימי חייך והודעתם לבניך ולבני בניך
verses.english: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
verses.romanian: numai a lua heed to thyself, și a păzi tău suflet diligently, lest tu a uita the things care al tău ochi au seen, și lest they a pleca din tău inimă toți the zile of tău life: dar a învăța them tău fii, și tău fii' fii;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יום אשר עמדת לפני יהוה אלהיך בחורב באמר יהוה אלי הקהל לי את העם ואשמיעם את דברי אשר ילמדון ליראה אתי כל הימים אשר הם חיים על האדמה ואת בניהם ילמדון
verses.english: [Specially] the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and [that] they may teach their children.
verses.romanian: [Specially] the zi că tu stoodest înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in Horeb, când DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Gather me the popor together, și I va a face them a auzi meu cuvinte, că they poate a învăța to a se teme me toți the zile că they va a trăi upon the pământ, și [că] they poate a învăța lor copii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקרבון ותעמדון תחת ההר וההר בער באש עד לבב השמים חשך ענן וערפל
verses.english: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.romanian: și voi a venit lângă și a stat sub the munte; și the munte burned cu foc lui the midst of heaven, cu darkness, clouds, și thick darkness.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אליכם מתוך האש קול דברים אתם שמעים ותמונה אינכם ראים זולתי קול
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only [ye heard] a voice.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit lui you out of the midst of the foc: voi a auzit the voice of cuvintele, dar a văzut no similitude; numai [voi a auzit] a voice.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגד לכם את בריתו אשר צוה אתכם לעשות עשרת הדברים ויכתבם על שני לוחת אבנים
verses.english: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, [even] ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.romanian: și he declared lui you lui legământ, care he commanded you to perform, [even] zece porunci; și he a scris them upon doi tables of piatră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתי צוה יהוה בעת ההיא ללמד אתכם חקים ומשפטים לעשותכם אתם בארץ אשר אתם עברים שמה לרשתה
verses.english: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL commanded me at că time to a învăța you porunci și judecăți, că voi ar putea a face them in the țară whither voi a merge peste to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשמרתם מאד לנפשתיכם כי לא ראיתם כל תמונה ביום דבר יהוה אליכם בחורב מתוך האש
verses.english: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day [that] the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.romanian: a lua voi de aceea good heed lui yourselves; căci voi a văzut no manner of similitude on the zi [că] DOMNUL a vorbit lui you in Horeb out of the midst of the foc:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פן תשחתון ועשיתם לכם פסל תמונת כל סמל תבנית זכר או נקבה
verses.english: Lest ye corrupt [yourselves], and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female
verses.romanian: Lest voi corrupt [yourselves], și a face you a chip cioplit, the similitude of vreun figure, the likeness of male sau female

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תבנית כל בהמה אשר בארץ תבנית כל צפור כנף אשר תעף בשמים
verses.english: The likeness of any beast that [is] on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air
verses.romanian: The likeness of vreun beast că [este] on the pământ, the likeness of vreun winged fowl că flieth in the air

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תבנית כל רמש באדמה תבנית כל דגי אשר במים מתחת לארץ
verses.english: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that [is] in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.romanian: The likeness of vreun thing că creepeth on the ground, the likeness of vreun fish că [este] in the ape beneath the pământ:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופן תשא עיניך השמים וראית את השמש ואת הירח ואת הכוכבים כל צבא השמים ונדחת והשתחוית להם ועבדתם אשר חלק יהוה אלהיך אתם לכל העמים תחת כל השמים
verses.english: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, [even] all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.romanian: și lest tu lift up al tău ochi lui heaven, și când tu seest the sun, și the moon, și the stars, [even] toți the host of heaven, shouldest fi driven to worship them, și a sluji them, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt divided lui toți neamuri sub the whole heaven.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתכם לקח יהוה ויוצא אתכם מכור הברזל ממצרים להיות לו לעם נחלה כיום הזה
verses.english: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, [even] out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as [ye are] this day.
verses.romanian: dar DOMNUL sunt taken you, și a adus you forth out of the fier furnace, [even] din Egipt, to fi lui him a popor of moștenire, as [voi sunt] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהוה התאנף בי על דבריכם לבלתי עברי את הירדן ולבלתי בא אל הארץ הטובה אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך נחלה
verses.english: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance:
verses.romanian: Furthermore DOMNUL era angry cu me căci vostru sakes, și sware că I trebuie să nu a merge peste Iordan, și că I trebuie să nu a intra lui că good țară, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te [căci] an moștenire:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אנכי מת בארץ הזאת אינני עבר את הירדן ואתם עברים וירשתם את הארץ הטובה הזאת
verses.english: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.romanian: dar I trebuie a muri in this țară, I trebuie nu a merge peste Iordan: dar voi va a merge peste, și a stăpâni că good țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמרו לכם פן תשכחו את ברית יהוה אלהיכם אשר כרת עמכם ועשיתם לכם פסל תמונת כל אשר צוך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, [or] the likeness of any [thing], which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.romanian: a lua heed lui yourselves, lest voi a uita the legământ of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care he a făcut cu you, și a face you a chip cioplit, [sau] the likeness of vreun [thing], care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt forbidden te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהוה אלהיך אש אכלה הוא אל קנא
verses.english: For the LORD thy God [is] a consuming fire, [even] a jealous God.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] a consuming foc, [even] a jealous Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תולידו בנים ובני בנים ונושנתם בארץ והשחתם ועשיתם פסל תמונת כל ועשיתם הרע בעיני יהוה אלהיכם להכעיסו
verses.english: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt [yourselves], and make a graven image, [or] the likeness of any [thing], and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.romanian: când să beget copii, și copii's copii, și voi va au remained long in the țară, și va corrupt [yourselves], și a face a chip cioplit, [sau] the likeness of vreun [thing], și va a față răul înaintea DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to provoke him to anger:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: העדתי בכם היום את השמים ואת הארץ כי אבד תאבדון מהר מעל הארץ אשר אתם עברים את הירדן שמה לרשתה לא תאריכון ימים עליה כי השמד תשמדון
verses.english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong [your] days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.romanian: I a chema heaven și pământ to witness împotriva you this zi, că voi va soon utterly perish din off the țară whereunto voi a merge peste Iordan to a stăpâni it; voi va nu prolong [vostru] zile upon it, dar va utterly fi a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והפיץ יהוה אתכם בעמים ונשארתם מתי מספר בגוים אשר ינהג יהוה אתכם שמה
verses.english: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va scatter you între the neamuri, și voi va fi left few in număr între the heathen, whither DOMNUL va lead you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבדתם שם אלהים מעשה ידי אדם עץ ואבן אשר לא יראון ולא ישמעון ולא יאכלון ולא יריחון
verses.english: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.romanian: și acolo voi va a sluji gods, the work of oameni's mâini, lemn și piatră, care neither a vedea, nor a auzi, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקשת משם את יהוה אלהיך ומצאתו כי תדרשנו בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך
verses.english: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find [him], if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.romanian: dar dacă din thence să a căuta DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, să find [him], dacă tu a căuta him cu toți tău inimă și cu tot sufletul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בצר לך ומצאוך כל הדברים האלה באחרית הימים ושבת עד יהוה אלהיך ושמעת בקולו
verses.english: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, [even] in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.romanian: când tu art in tribulation, și toți these things sunt a veni upon te, [even] in the latter zile, dacă tu a se întoarce to DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și shalt fi obedient lui lui voice;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אל רחום יהוה אלהיך לא ירפך ולא ישחיתך ולא ישכח את ברית אבתיך אשר נשבע להם
verses.english: (For the LORD thy God [is] a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.romanian: (căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] a merciful Dumnezeu;) he va nu forsake te, neither a nimici te, nor a uita the legământ of tău părinți care he sware lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי שאל נא לימים הראישונים אשר היו לפניך למן היום אשר ברא אלהים אדם על הארץ ולמקצה השמים ועד קצה השמים הן היה כדבר הגדול הזה או הנשמע כמהו
verses.english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and [ask] from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been [any such thing] as this great thing [is], or hath been heard like it?
verses.romanian: căci a întreba acum of the zile că sunt past, care erau înainte te, since the zi că Dumnezeu created om upon the pământ, și [a întreba] din the unu side of heaven lui the other, whether acolo sunt been [vreun such thing] as this great thing [este], sau sunt been a auzit like it?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמע עם קול אלהים חיים מדבר מתוך האש כאשר שמעת אתה ויחי
verses.english: Did [ever] people hear the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.romanian: a făcut [ever] popor a auzi the voice of the living Dumnezeu speaking out of the midst of the foc, as tu hast a auzit, și a trăi?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או הנסה אלהים לבוא לקחת לו גוי מקרב גוי במסות באתות ובמופתים ובמלחמה וביד חזקה ובזרוע נטויה ובמראים גדלים ככל אשר עשה לכם יהוה אלהיכם במצרים לעיניכם
verses.english: Or hath God assayed to go [and] take him a nation from the midst of [another] nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.romanian: sau sunt Dumnezeu assayed to a merge [și] a lua him a neam din the midst of [another] neam, by temptations, by signs, și by wonders, și by război, și by a mighty mână, și by a stretched out arm, și by great terrors, după toți că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a făcut căci you in Egypt înainte vostru ochi?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אתה הראת לדעת כי יהוה הוא האלהים אין עוד מלבדו
verses.english: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he [is] God; [there is] none else beside him.
verses.romanian: lui te it era shewed, că tu mightest a cunoaște că DOMNUL he [este] Dumnezeu; [acolo este] niciun else beside him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מן השמים השמיעך את קולו ליסרך ועל הארץ הראך את אשו הגדלה ודבריו שמעת מתוך האש
verses.english: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.romanian: Out of heaven he a făcut te to a auzi lui voice, că he ar putea instruct te: și upon pământ he shewed te lui great foc; și tu heardest lui cuvinte out of the midst of the foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותחת כי אהב את אבתיך ויבחר בזרעם אחריהם ויוציאך בפניו ובכחו הגדול ממצרים
verses.english: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.romanian: și pentru că he a iubit tău părinți, de aceea he a ales lor sămânță după them, și a adus te out in lui sight cu lui mighty power din Egipt;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: להוריש גוים גדלים ועצמים ממך מפניך להביאך לתת לך את ארצם נחלה כיום הזה
verses.english: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou [art], to bring thee in, to give thee their land [for] an inheritance, as [it is] this day.
verses.romanian: To a alunga neamuri din înainte te greater și mightier than tu [art], to a aduce te in, to a da te lor țară [căci] an moștenire, as [it este] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעת היום והשבות אל לבבך כי יהוה הוא האלהים בשמים ממעל ועל הארץ מתחת אין עוד
verses.english: Know therefore this day, and consider [it] in thine heart, that the LORD he [is] God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: [there is] none else.
verses.romanian: a cunoaște de aceea this zi, și consider [it] in al tău inimă, că DOMNUL he [este] Dumnezeu in heaven deasupra, și upon the pământ beneath: [acolo este] niciun else.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרת את חקיו ואת מצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום אשר ייטב לך ולבניך אחריך ולמען תאריך ימים על האדמה אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך כל הימים
verses.english: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong [thy] days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.romanian: să a păzi de aceea lui porunci, și lui porunci, care I command te this zi, că it poate a merge well cu te, și cu tău copii după te, și că tu mayest prolong [tău] zile upon the pământ, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אז יבדיל משה שלש ערים בעבר הירדן מזרח השמש
verses.english: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sun rising;
verses.romanian: atunci Moise severed trei cetăți on dincoace de Iordan toward the sun rising;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לנוס שמה הרצח אשר ירצח את רעהו בבלי דעת והוא לא שנא לו מתמול שלשום ונס אל אחת מן הערים האלה וחי
verses.english: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.romanian: că the slayer ar putea flee thither, care trebuie să a ucide lui neighbour unawares, și hated him nu in times past; și că fleeing lui unu of these cetăți he ar putea a trăi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את בוצר במדבר בארץ המישור לראובני ואת רמות בגלעד לגדי ואת גולן בבשן למנשה
verses.english: [Namely], Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.romanian: [Namely], Bezer in the pustie, in the câmpie țară, of the Reubenites; și Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; și Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת התורה אשר שם משה לפני בני ישראל
verses.english: And this [is] the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.romanian: și this [este] the lege care Moise a așeza înainte the copiii lui Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה העדות החקים והמשפטים אשר דבר משה אל בני ישראל בצאתם ממצרים
verses.english: These [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the testimonies, și the porunci, și the judecăți, pe care Moise le-a rostit lui the copiii lui Israel, după they a venit forth din Egipt

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בעבר הירדן בגיא מול בית פעור בארץ סיחון מלך האמרי אשר ישב בחשבון אשר הכה משה ובני ישראל בצאתם ממצרים
verses.english: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.romanian: On dincoace de Iordan, in the valley peste împotriva Beth-peor, in the țară of Sihon rege of the Amorites, care dwelt at Heshbon, pe care Moise și the copiii lui Israel a lovit, după they erau a veni forth din Egipt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויירשו את ארצו ואת ארץ עוג מלך הבשן שני מלכי האמרי אשר בעבר הירדן מזרח השמש
verses.english: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which [were] on this side Jordan toward the sun rising;
verses.romanian: și they a stăpânit lui țară, și the țară of Og rege of Bashan, doi regi of the Amorites, care [erau] on dincoace de Iordan toward the sun rising;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מערער אשר על שפת נחל ארנן ועד הר שיאון הוא חרמון
verses.english: From Aroer, which [is] by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which [is] Hermon
verses.romanian: din Aroer, care [este] by the bank of the river Arnon, even lui munte Sion, care [este] Hermon

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הערבה עבר הירדן מזרחה ועד ים הערבה ים המלח תחת אשדות הפסגה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא משה אל כל ישראל ויאמר אליהם שמע ישראל את החקים ואת המשפטים אשר אנכי דבר באזניכם היום ולמדתם אתם ושמרתם לעשותם
verses.english: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.romanian: și Moise a chemat toți Israel, și a spus lui them, Ascultă, Israele, the porunci și judecăți care I a vorbi in vostru urechi this zi, că voi poate a învăța them, și a păzi, și a face them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהינו כרת עמנו ברית בחורב
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא את אבתינו כרת יהוה את הברית הזאת כי אתנו אנחנו אלה פה היום כלנו חיים
verses.english: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, [even] us, who [are] all of us here alive this day.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL a făcut nu this legământ cu nostru părinți, dar cu us, [even] us, care [sunt] toți of us aici alive this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פנים בפנים דבר יהוה עמכם בהר מתוך האש
verses.english: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire
verses.romanian: DOMNUL talked cu you față în față in the munte out of the midst of the foc

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואנכי עמד בין יהוה ובינכם בעת ההיא להגיד לכם את דברי יהוה כי יראתם מפני האש ולא עליתם בהר לאמר
verses.english: (And I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying
verses.romanian: (și I a stat between DOMNUL și you at că time, to shew you the cuvânt of DOMNUL: căci voi erau afraid by reason of the foc, și a mers nu up into the munte;) saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אנכי יהוה אלהיך אשר הוצאתיך מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים
verses.english: I [am] the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.romanian: I [am] DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care a adus te out of the țara Egiptului, din the casa robiei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יהיה לך אלהים אחרים על פני
verses.english: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.romanian: să au niciun alți dumnezei înainte me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשה לך פסל וכל תמונה אשר בשמים ממעל ואשר בארץ מתחת ואשר במים מתחת לארץ
verses.english: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, [or] any likeness [of any thing] that [is] in heaven above, or that [is] in the earth beneath, or that [is] in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.romanian: să nu a face te vreun chip cioplit, [sau] vreun likeness [of vreun thing] că [este] in heaven deasupra, sau că [este] in the pământ beneath, sau că [este] in the ape beneath the pământ:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תשתחוה להם ולא תעבדם כי אנכי יהוה אלהיך אל קנא פקד עון אבות על בנים על שלישים ועל רביעים לשנאי
verses.english: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God [am] a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth [generation] of them that hate me
verses.romanian: să nu bow down thyself lui them, nor a sluji them: căci I DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [am] a jealous Dumnezeu, visiting the nelegiuire of the părinți upon the copii lui the al treilea și al patrulea [generation] of them că hate me

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה חסד לאלפים לאהבי ולשמרי מצותי
verses.english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.romanian: și shewing mercy lui mii of them că a iubi me și a păzi meu porunci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תשא את שם יהוה אלהיך לשוא כי לא ינקה יהוה את אשר ישא את שמו לשוא
verses.english: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold [him] guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.romanian: să nu a lua the name of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in vain: căci DOMNUL va nu hold [him] guiltless că taketh lui name in vain.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמור את יום השבת לקדשהו כאשר צוך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.romanian: a păzi the sabbath zi to sanctify it, as DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt commanded te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ששת ימים תעבד ועשית כל מלאכתך
verses.english: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.romanian: șase zile să labour, și a face toți tău work:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויום השביעי שבת ליהוה אלהיך לא תעשה בו כל מלאכה אתה ובנך ובתך עבדך ואמתך שורך וחמורך וכל בהמתך וגרך אשר בשעריך למען ינוח עבדך ואמתך כמוך
verses.english: But the seventh day [is] the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that [is] within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.romanian: dar the al șaptelea zi [este] the sabbath of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: in it să nu a face vreun work, tu, nor tău fiu, nor tău fiică, tău manservant, nor tău maidservant, al tău bou, nor al tău ass, nor vreun of tău vite, nor tău străin că [este] în tău porți; că tău manservant și tău maidservant poate rest as well as tu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרת כי עבד היית בארץ מצרים ויוציאך יהוה אלהיך משם ביד חזקה ובזרוע נטויה על כן צוך יהוה אלהיך לעשות את יום השבת
verses.english: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and [that] the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.romanian: și adu-ți aminte că tu wast a slujitor in the țara Egiptului, și [că] DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a adus te out thence prin a mighty mână și by a stretched out arm: de aceea DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău commanded te to a păzi the sabbath zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כבד את אביך ואת אמך כאשר צוך יהוה אלהיך למען יארכון ימיך ולמען ייטב לך על האדמה אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך
verses.english: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.romanian: Honour tău tată și tău mamă, as DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt commanded te; că tău zile poate fi prolonged, și că it poate a merge well cu te, in the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תרצח
verses.english: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.romanian: să nu a ucide.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תנאף
verses.english: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.romanian: să nu commit adultery.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תגנב
verses.english: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.romanian: să nu steal.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תענה ברעך עד שוא
verses.english: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.romanian: să nu bear false witness împotriva tău neighbour.
