verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תחמד בית רעך ולא תחמד אשת רעך שדהו עבדו ואמתו שורו וחמרו וכל אשר לרעך והיה כי יביאך יהוה אלהיך אל ארץ הכנעני אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה והקמת לך אבנים גדלות ושדת אתם בשיד וכתבת על האבנים את כל דברי התורה הזאת והיה בעברכם את הירדן תקימו את האבנים האלה אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום בהרגריזים ובנית שם מזבח ליהוה אלהיך מזבח אבנים לא תניף עליהם ברזל אבנים שלמות תבנה את מזבח יהוה אלהיך והעלית עליו עלות ליהוה אלהיך וזבחת שלמים ואכלת שם ושמחת לפני יהוה אלהיך ההר ההוא בעבר הירדן אחרי דרך מבוא השמש בארץ הכנעני הישב בערבה מול הגלגל אצל אלון מורא מול שכם
verses.english: Thou shalt not desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any [thing] that [is] thy neighbour's. And when it so happens that LORD God brings you to the land of Caanan, which you are coming to posses, you shall set-up there for you great stones and plaster them with plaster and you write on the stones all words of this law. And it becomes for you that across the Jordan you shall raise these stones, which I command you today, in mountain Grizim. And you build there the altar to the LORD God of you. Altar of stones. Not you shall wave on them iron. With whole stones you shall build the altar to LORD God of you. And you bring on it ascend offerings to LORD God of you, and you sacrifice peace offerings, and you eat there and you rejoice before the face of the LORD God of you. The mountain this is across the Jordan behind the way of the rising of the sun, in the land of Caanan who is dwelling in the desert before the Galgal, beside Alvin-Mara, before Sechem.
verses.romanian: să nu desire tău neighbour's wife, neither shalt tu covet tău neighbour's casă, lui câmp, lui manservant, sau lui maidservant, lui bou, sau lui ass, sau vreun [thing] că [este] tău neighbour's. și când it so happens că DOMNUL Dumnezeu brings you to the țară of Caanan, care you sunt coming to posses, să a așeza-up acolo căci you great pietre și plaster them cu plaster și you a scrie on the pietre toți cuvinte of this lege. și it becomes căci you că across the Iordan să raise these pietre, care I command you astăzi, in munte Grizim. și you a construi acolo the altar to DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you. altar of pietre. nu să wave on them fier. cu whole pietre să a construi the altar to DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you. și you a aduce on it ascend offerings to DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you, și you sacrifice peace offerings, și you eat acolo și you rejoice înainte the față of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you. The munte this este across the Iordan behind the cale of the rising of the sun, in the țară of Caanan care este dwelling in the pustie înainte the Galgal, beside Alvin-Mara, înainte Sechem.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את הדברים האלה דבר יהוה אל כל קהלכם בהר מתוך האש חשך ענן וערפל קול גדול ולא יסף ויכתבם על שני לוחת אבנים ויתנם אלי
verses.english: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, darkness, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.romanian: These cuvinte DOMNUL a vorbit lui toți vostru adunare in the munte out of the midst of the foc, darkness, of the cloud, și of the thick darkness, cu a great voice: și he added no more. și he a scris them in doi tables of piatră, și delivered them lui me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי כשמעכם את הקול מתוך החשך וההר בער באש ותקרבון אלי כל ראשי שבטיכם וזקניכם
verses.english: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, [even] all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece, când voi a auzit the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (căci the munte a făcut burn cu foc,) că voi a venit lângă lui me, [even] toți the capete of vostru seminții, și vostru elders;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותאמרו הן הראנו יהוה אלהינו את כבודו את גדלו ואת קולו שמענו מתוך האש היום הזה ראינו כי ידבר אלהים את האדם וחי
verses.english: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.romanian: și voi a spus, iată, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru sunt shewed us lui glory și lui greatness, și we au a auzit lui voice out of the midst of the foc: we au seen this zi că Dumnezeu doth talk cu om, și he liveth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה למה נמות כי תאכלנו האש הגדלה הזאת אם יספים אנחנו לשמע את קול יהוה אלהינו עוד ומתנו
verses.english: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.romanian: acum de aceea de ce trebuie să we a muri? căci this great foc va consume us: dacă we a auzi the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru vreun more, atunci we va a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מי כל בשר אשר שמע קול אלהים חיים מדבר מתוך האש כמונו ויחי
verses.english: For who [is there of] all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we [have], and lived?
verses.romanian: căci care [este acolo of] toți flesh, că sunt a auzit the voice of the living Dumnezeu speaking out of the midst of the foc, as we [au], și a trăit?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קרב אתה ושמע את כל אשר יאמר יהוה אלהינו ואתה תדבר אלינו את כל אשר ידבר יהוה אלהינו אליך ושמענו ועשינו
verses.english: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear [it], and do [it].
verses.romanian: a merge tu lângă, și a auzi toți că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru va a spune: și a vorbi tu lui us toți că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru va a vorbi lui te; și we va a auzi [it], și a face [it].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע יהוה את קול דבריכם בדברכם אלי ויאמר יהוה אלי שמעתי את קול דברי העם הזה אשר דברו אליך הטיבו כל אשר דברו
verses.english: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a auzit the voice of vostru cuvinte, când voi a vorbit lui me; și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, I au a auzit the voice of cuvintele of this popor, care they au spoken lui te: they au well a spus toți că they au spoken.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מי יתן והיה לבבם זה להם ליראה אתי ולשמר את מצותי כל הימים למען ייטב להם ולבניהם לעולם
verses.english: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.romanian: O că acolo erau such an inimă in them, că they ar a se teme me, și a păzi toți meu porunci always, că it ar putea fi well cu them, și cu lor copii căci ever!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לך אמר להם שובו לכם לאהליכם
verses.english: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.romanian: a merge a spune to them, Get you into vostru tents again.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתה פה עמד עמדי ואדברה אליך את כל המצוה החקים והמשפטים אשר תלמדם ועשו בארץ אשר אנכי נתן להם לרשתה
verses.english: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do [them] in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.romanian: dar as căci te, a sta tu aici by me, și I va a vorbi lui te toți the porunci, the porunci, și the judecăți, care să a învăța them, că they poate a face [them] in the țară care I a da them to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם לעשות כאשר צוה יהוה אלהיכם אתכם לא תסורו ימין ושמאל
verses.english: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.romanian: voi va a păzi to a face de aceea as DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt commanded you: voi va nu a se abate to the right mână sau to the left.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בכל הדרך אשר צוה יהוה אלהיכם אתכם תלכון למען תחיון וטוב לכם והארכתם ימים בארץ אשר תירשון
verses.english: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and [that it may be] well with you, and [that] ye may prolong [your] days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.romanian: voi va a umbla in toți the căi care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt commanded you, că voi poate a trăi, și [că it poate fi] well cu you, și [că] voi poate prolong [vostru] zile in the țară care voi va a stăpâni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת המצוה החקים והמשפטים אשר צוה יהוה אלהיכם ללמד אתכם לעשות בארץ אשר אתם עברים שמה לרשתה
verses.english: Now these [are] the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do [them] in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.romanian: acum these [sunt] the porunci, the porunci, și the judecăți, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău commanded to a învăța you, că voi ar putea a face [them] in the țară whither voi a merge to a stăpâni it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למען תירא את יהוה אלהיך לשמר את כל חקיו ומצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום אתה ובנך ובן בנך כל ימי חייך ולמען יאריכון ימיך
verses.english: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee today, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.romanian: că tu mightest a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi toți lui porunci și lui porunci, care I command te astăzi, tu, și tău fiu, și tău fiu's fiu, toți the zile of tău life; și că tău zile poate fi prolonged.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמעת ישראל ושמרת לעשות אשר ייטב לך ואשר תרבה מאד כאשר דבר יהוה אלהי אבתיך לך ארץ זבת חלב ודבש
verses.english: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do [it]; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.romanian: a auzi de aceea, O Israel, și a păzi to a face [it]; că it poate fi well cu te, și că voi poate increase mightily, as DOMNUL Dumnezeu of tău părinți sunt promised te, in the țară că floweth cu lapte și miere.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמע ישראל יהוה אלהינו יהוה אחד
verses.english: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God [is] one LORD:
verses.romanian: Ascultă, Israele: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru [este] unu DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואהבת את יהוה אלהיך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך ובכל מאדך
verses.english: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.romanian: și să a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu toată inima ta, și cu tot sufletul tău, și cu toată puterea ta.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו הדברים האלה אשר אנכי מצוך היום על לבבך
verses.english: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.romanian: și these cuvinte, care I command te this zi, va fi in al tău inimă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושננתם לבניך ודברת בם בשבתך בבית בלכתך בדרך בשכבך ובקומך
verses.english: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.romanian: și să a învăța them diligently lui tău copii, și shalt talk of them când tu sittest in al tău casă, când tu walkest by the cale, când tu liest down, și când tu risest up.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקשרתם לאות על ידיך והיו לטטפות בין עיניך
verses.english: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hands, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.romanian: și să bind them căci a sign upon al tău mâini, și they va fi as frontlets between al tău ochi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכתבתם על מזזות בתיך ובשעריך
verses.english: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.romanian: și să a scrie them upon the posts of tău casă, și on tău porți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יביאך יהוה אלהיך אל הארץ אשר נשבע לאבתיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב לתת לך ערים גדלות וטובות אשר לא בנית
verses.english: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not
verses.romanian: și it va fi, când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va au a adus te into the țară care he sware lui tău părinți, to Abraham, to Isaac, și to Jacob, to a da te great și goodly cetăți, care tu buildedst nu

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בתים מלאים כל טוב אשר לא מלאת בורות חצובים אשר לא חצבת כרמים וזיתים אשר לא נטעת ואכלת ושבעת
verses.english: And houses full of all good [things], which thou filledst not, wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.romanian: și case full of toți good [things], care tu filledst nu, wells digged, care tu diggedst nu, vineyards și olive copaci, care tu plantedst nu; când să au eaten și fi full;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן תשכח את יהוה אלהיך אשר הוציאך מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים
verses.english: [Then] beware lest thou forget the LORD God of you, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.romanian: [atunci] beware lest tu a uita DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you, care a adus te forth out of the țara Egiptului, din the casa robiei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את יהוה אלהיך תירא ואתו תעבד ובשמו תשבע
verses.english: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.romanian: să a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și a sluji him, și shalt swear by lui name.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תלכו אחרי אלהים אחרים מאלהי העמים אשר סביבתיכם
verses.english: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which [are] round about you;
verses.romanian: voi va nu a merge după alți dumnezei, of the gods of the popor care [sunt] round about you;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אל קנא יהוה אלהיך בקרבך פן יחר אף יהוה אלהיך בך והשמידך מעל פני האדמה
verses.english: (For the LORD thy God [is] a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.romanian: (căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] a jealous Dumnezeu între you) lest the anger of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău fi kindled împotriva te, și a nimici te din off the față of the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תנסו את יהוה אלהיכם כאשר נסיתם במסה
verses.english: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted [him] in Massah.
verses.romanian: voi va nu tempt DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, as voi tempted [him] in Massah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמר תשמרון את מצות יהוה אלהיכם ועדתיו וחקיו אשר צוך
verses.english: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.romanian: voi va diligently a păzi poruncile of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și lui testimonies, și lui porunci, care he sunt commanded te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשית הישר והטוב בעיני יהוה אלהיך למען ייטב לך ובאת וירשת את הארץ הטובה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיך
verses.english: And thou shalt do [that which is] right and good in the sight of the LORD God of you: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers
verses.romanian: și să a face [că care este] right și good in the sight of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you: că it poate fi well cu te, și că tu mayest a intra și a stăpâni the good țară care DOMNUL sware lui tău părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: להדיף את כל איביך מפניך כאשר דבר יהוה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי ישאלך בנך מחר לאמר מה העדות החקים והמשפטים אשר צוה יהוה אלהינו אתכם
verses.english: [And] when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What [mean] the testimonies, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.romanian: [și] când tău fiu asketh te in time to a veni, saying, ce [mean] the testimonies, the porunci, și the judecăți, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru sunt commanded you?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרת לבנך עבדים היינו לפרעה במצרים ויוציאנו יהוה ממצרים ביד חזקה
verses.english: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.romanian: atunci să a spune lui tău fiu, We erau Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; și DOMNUL a adus us din Egipt cu mână puternică:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן יהוה אתות ומופתים גדלים ורעים במצרים בפרעה ובכל ביתו לעינינו
verses.english: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL shewed signs și wonders, great și sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, și upon toți lui household, înainte nostru ochi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתנו הוציא משם למען הביא אתנו לתת לנו את הארץ אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתינו
verses.english: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.romanian: și he a adus us out din thence, că he ar putea a aduce us in, to a da us the țară care he sware lui nostru părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצונו יהוה לעשות את כל החקים האלה ליראה את יהוה אלהינו לטוב לנו כל הימים ולהחיותנו כיום הזה
verses.english: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as [it is] at this day.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL commanded us to a face toți these porunci, to a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru, căci nostru good always, că he ar putea preserve us alive, as [it este] at this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצדקה תהיה לנו כי נשמר לעשות את כל המצוה הזאת לפני יהוה אלהינו כאשר צונו
verses.english: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.romanian: și it va fi nostru righteousness, dacă we a păzi to a face toți these porunci înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru, as he sunt commanded us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יביאך יהוה אלהיך אל הארץ אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה ונשל גוים רבים מפניך החתי והגרגשי והאמרי והכנעני והפרזי והחוי והיבוסי שבעה גוים רבים ועצמים ממך
verses.english: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.romanian: când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a aduce te into the țară whither tu goest to a stăpâni it, și sunt cast out many neamuri înainte te, the Hittites, și the Girgashites, și the Amorites, și the Canaanites, și the Perizzites, și the Hivites, și the Jebusites, șapte neamuri greater și mightier than tu;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנם יהוה אלהיך לפניך והכיתם החרים תחרים אתם לא תכרת להם ברית ולא תחנם
verses.english: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, [and] utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.romanian: și când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va deliver them înainte te; să a lovi them, [și] utterly a nimici them; să a face no legământ cu them, nor shew mercy lui them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תתחתן בם בתך לא תתן לבנו ובתו לא תקח לבנך
verses.english: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.romanian: Neither shalt tu a face marriages cu them; tău fiică să nu a da lui lui fiu, nor lui fiică shalt tu a lua lui tău fiu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יסיר את בנך מאחרי ועבד אלהים אחרים וחרה אף יהוה בכם והשמידך מהר
verses.english: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.romanian: căci they va a se întoarce away tău fiu din following me, că they poate a sluji altor dumnezei: so va the anger of DOMNUL fi kindled împotriva you, și a nimici te suddenly.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם כה תעשה להם מזבחתיהם תתצון ומצבתיהם תשברון ואשריהם תגדעון ופסיליהם תשרפון באש
verses.english: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.romanian: dar astfel va voi deal cu them; voi va a nimici lor altare, și a sfărâma down lor chipuri, și a doborî lor groves, și burn lor chipuri cioplite cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי עם קדש אתה ליהוה אלהיך ובך בחר יהוה אלהיך להיות לו לעם סגלה מכל העמים אשר על פני האדמה
verses.english: For thou [art] an holy people unto the LORD thy God: and the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that [are] upon the face of the earth.
verses.romanian: căci tu [art] an sfânt popor lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales te to fi a special popor lui însuși, deasupra toți popor că [sunt] upon the față of the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא מרבכם מכל העמים חשק יהוה בכם ויבחר בכם כי אתם המעט מכל העמים
verses.english: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye [were] the fewest of all people:
verses.romanian: DOMNUL a făcut nu a așeza lui a iubi upon you, nor a alege you, pentru că voi erau more in număr than vreun popor; căci voi [erau] the fewest of toți popor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מאהבת יהוה אתכם ומשמרו את השבועה אשר נשבע לאבתיכם הוציא יהוה אתכם ביד חזקה ויפדך מבית עבדים מיד פרעה מלך מצרים
verses.english: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.romanian: dar pentru că DOMNUL a iubit you, și pentru că he ar a păzi the oath care he had sworn lui vostru părinți, sunt DOMNUL a adus you out cu mână puternică, și redeemed you out of the casă of bondmen, din the mână of Pharaoh rege of Egypt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעת כי יהוה אלהיך הוא האלהים האל הנאמן שמר הברית והחסד לאהביו ולשמרי מצותיו לאלף דור
verses.english: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he [is] God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.romanian: a cunoaște de aceea că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, he [este] Dumnezeu, the faithful Dumnezeu, care keepeth legământ și mercy cu them că a iubi him și a păzi lui porunci to a mie generations;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומשלם לשנאיו על פניו להאבידו לא יאחר לשנאיו על פניו ישלם לו
verses.english: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.romanian: și repayeth them că hate him to lor față, to a nimici them: he va nu fi slack to him că hateth him, he va repay him to lui față.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרת את המצוה את החקים ואת המשפטים אשר אנכי מצוך היום לעשותם
verses.english: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.romanian: să de aceea a păzi poruncile, și the porunci, și the judecăți, care I command te this zi, to a face them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה עקב תשמעון את המשפטים האלה ושמרתם ועשיתם אתם ושמר יהוה אלהיך לך את הברית ואת החסד אשר נשבע לאבתיך
verses.english: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.romanian: de aceea it va a veni to a trece, dacă voi hearken to these judecăți, și a păzi, și a face them, că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a păzi lui te the legământ și the mercy care he sware lui tău părinți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואהבך וברכך והרבך וברך פרי בטנך ופרי אדמתך דגנך תירשך ויצהרך שגר אלפיך ועשתרות צאנך על האדמה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיך לתת לך
verses.english: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.romanian: și he va a iubi te, și bless te, și multiply te: he va de asemenea bless the rod of tău womb, și the rod of tău țară, tău grâu, tău vin, și al tău ulei, the increase of tău kine, și the turme of tău oaie, in the țară care he sware lui tău părinți to a da te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברוך תהיה מכל העמים לא יהיה בך עקר ועקרה ובבהמתך
verses.english: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.romanian: să fi binecuvântat deasupra toți popor: acolo va nu fi male sau female barren între you, sau între vostru vite.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והסיר יהוה ממך כל חלי וכל מדוי מצרים הרעים אשר ידעת לא ישימם בך ונתנם בכל שנאיך
verses.english: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all [them] that hate thee.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va a lua away din te toți sickness, și va a pune niciun of the evil diseases of Egypt, care tu knowest, upon te; dar va lay them upon toți [them] că hate te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלת את כל העמים אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לא תחוס עינך עליהם ולא תעבד את אלהיהם כי מוקש הוא לך
verses.english: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that [will be] a snare unto thee.
verses.romanian: și să consume toți the popor care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va deliver te; al tău ochi va au no pity upon them: neither shalt tu a sluji lor gods; căci că [va fi] a snare lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תאמר בלבבך רבים הגוים האלה ממני איך אוכל להורישם
verses.english: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations [are] more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.romanian: dacă să a spune in al tău inimă, These neamuri [sunt] more than I; cum poate I dispossess them?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תירא מהם זכר תזכר את אשר עשה יהוה אלהיך לפרעה ולכל מצרים
verses.english: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: [but] shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.romanian: să nu fi afraid of them: [dar] shalt well a-și aduce aminte ce DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a făcut lui Pharaoh, și lui toți Egypt;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המסות הגדלות אשר ראו עיניך האתות והמופתים והיד החזקה והזרוע הנטויה אשר הוציאך יהוה אלהיך כן יעשה יהוה אלהיך לכל העמים אשר אתה ירא מפניהם
verses.english: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.romanian: The great temptations care al tău ochi a văzut, the signs, și the wonders, și the mighty mână, și the stretched out arm, whereby DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a adus te out: so va DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a face lui toți the popor of pe care tu art afraid.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגם את הצרעה ישלח יהוה אלהיך בם עד אבד הנשארים והנסתרים מפניך
verses.english: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.romanian: Moreover DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va send the hornet între them, until they că sunt left, și hide înșiși din te, fi a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תערץ מפניהם כי יהוה אלהיך בקרבך אל גדול ונורא
verses.english: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God [is] among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.romanian: să nu fi affrighted at them: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] între you, a mighty Dumnezeu și terrible.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשל יהוה אלהיך את הגוים האלה מלפניך מעט מעט לא תוכל כלותם מהר פן תרבה עליך חית השדה
verses.english: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a pune out those neamuri înainte te by little și little: tu mayest nu consume them at once, lest the beasts of the câmp increase upon te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנם יהוה אלהיך לפניך והמם מהמה גדלה עד השמידם
verses.english: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.romanian: dar DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va deliver them lui te, și va a nimici them cu a mighty destruction, until they fi a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן מלכיהם בידך ואבדת את שמם מתחת השמים לא יתיצב איש לפניך עד השמידך אתם
verses.english: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.romanian: și he va deliver lor regi into al tău mână, și să a nimici lor name din sub heaven: acolo va no om fi able to a sta înainte te, until tu au a nimicit them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פסילי אלהיהם תשרפון באש לא תחמד כסף וזהב עליהם ולקחת לך פן תוקש בו כי תועבת יהוה אלהיך הוא
verses.english: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold [that is] on them, nor take [it] unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it [is] an abomination to the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: The chipuri cioplite of lor gods va voi burn cu foc: să nu desire the argint sau aur [că este] on them, nor a lua [it] lui te, lest tu fi snared therein: căci it [este] an abomination to DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תביא תועבה אל ביתך והיית חרם כמהו שקץ תשקצנו ותעב תתעבנו כי חרם הוא
verses.english: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: [but] thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it [is] a cursed thing.
verses.romanian: Neither shalt tu a aduce an abomination into al tău casă, lest tu fi a blestemat thing like it: [dar] să utterly detest it, și să utterly abhor it; căci it [este] a blestemat thing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל המצוה אשר אנכי מצוך היום תשמרון לעשות למען תחיון ורביתם ובאתם וירשתם את הארץ אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיכם
verses.english: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
verses.romanian: toți the porunci care I command te this zi va voi a păzi to a face, că voi poate a trăi, și multiply, și a intra și a stăpâni țara pe care DOMNUL sware lui vostru părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרת את כל הדרך אשר הוליכך יהוה אלהיך זה ארבעים שנה במדבר למען ענותך לנסותך לדעת אשר בלבבך התשמר מצותיו אם לא
verses.english: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, [and] to prove thee, to know what [was] in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
verses.romanian: și să a-și aduce aminte toți the cale care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău led te these patruzeci ani in the pustie, to humble te, [și] to prove te, to a cunoaște ce [era] in al tău inimă, whether tu wouldest a păzi lui porunci, sau no.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויענך וירעבך ויאכילך את המן אשר לא ידעת ולא ידעו אבתיך למען הודיעך כי לא על הלחם לבדו יחיה האדם כי על כל מוצא פי יהוה יחיה האדם
verses.english: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every [word] that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verses.romanian: și he humbled te, și suffered te to hunger, și fed te cu manna, care tu knewest nu, neither a făcut tău părinți a cunoaște; că he ar putea a face te a cunoaște că om doth nu a trăi by pâine numai, dar by fiecare [cuvânt] că proceedeth out of the gură of DOMNUL doth om a trăi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמלתך לא בלתה מעליך ורגליך לא בצקה זה ארבעים שנה
verses.english: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy feet swell, these forty years.
verses.romanian: tău raiment waxed nu old upon te, neither a făcut tău picioare swell, these patruzeci ani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעת עם לבבך כי כאשר ייסר איש את בנו יהוה אלהיך מיסרך
verses.english: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, [so] the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.romanian: să de asemenea consider in al tău inimă, că, as a om chasteneth lui fiu, [so] DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău chasteneth te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרת את מצות יהוה אלהיך ללכת בדרכיו וליראה אתו
verses.english: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.romanian: de aceea să a păzi poruncile of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a umbla in lui căi, și to a se teme him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהוה אלהיך מביאך אל ארץ טובה ורחבה ארץ נחלי מים עינות תהומות יצאים בבקעה ובהר
verses.english: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good and wide land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains, depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău bringeth te into a good și wide țară, a țară of brooks of apă, of fountains, depths că spring out of valleys și hills;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארץ חטה ושערה גפן תאנה ורמון ארץ זית שמן ודבש
verses.english: A land of wheat, and barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.romanian: A țară of wheat, și barley, vițe, fig copaci, și pomegranates; a țară of ulei olive, și miere;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארץ אשר לא במסכנת תאכל בה לחם לא תחסר כל בה ארץ אשר אבניה ברזל ומהרריה תחצב נחשת
verses.english: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any [thing] in it; a land whose stones [are] iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.romanian: A țară wherein să eat pâine fără scarceness, să nu lack vreun [thing] in it; a țară al cărui pietre [sunt] fier, și out of al cărui hills tu mayest dig brass.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלת ושבעת וברכת את יהוה אלהיך על הארץ הטובה אשר נתן לך
verses.english: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.romanian: când tu hast eaten și art full, atunci să bless DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău căci the good țară care he sunt given te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן תשכח את יהוה אלהיך לבלתי שמר מצותיו ומשפטיו וחקתיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום
verses.english: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.romanian: Beware că tu a uita nu DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, in nu keeping lui porunci, și lui judecăți, și lui porunci, care I command te this zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פן תאכל ושבעת ובתים טובים תבנה וישבת
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקרך וצאנך ירבון וכסף וזהב ירבה לך וכל אשר לך ירבה
verses.english: And [when] thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.romanian: și [când] tău herds și tău turme multiply, și tău argint și tău aur este multiplied, și toți că tu hast este multiplied;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ורם לבבך ושכחת את יהוה אלהיך המוציאך מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים
verses.english: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.romanian: atunci al tău inimă fi lifted up, și tu a uita DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care a adus te forth out of the țara Egiptului, din the casa robiei;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המוליכך במדבר הגדול והנורא נחש שרוף עקרב וצמאון אשר אין מים המוצא לך מים מצור החלמיש
verses.english: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, [wherein were] fiery serpents, scorpions, and drought, where [there was] no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.romanian: care led te prin că great și terrible pustie, [wherein erau] fiery serpents, scorpions, și drought, where [acolo era] no apă; care a adus te forth apă out of the rock of flint;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המאכילך מן במדבר אשר לא ידעו אבתיך למען ענותך ולמען נסותך להטיבך באחריתך
verses.english: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, and that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.romanian: care fed te in the pustie cu manna, care tău părinți a cunoscut nu, și că he ar putea humble te, și că he ar putea prove te, to a face te good at tău latter end;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרת בלבבך כחי ועצם ידי עשה לי את החיל הזה
verses.english: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of [mine] hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.romanian: și tu a spune in al tău inimă, meu power și the ar putea of [al meu] mână sunt gotten me this wealth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרת את יהוה אלהיך כי הוא הנתן לך כח לעשות חיל ולמען הקים את בריתו אשר נשבע לאבתיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב כיום הזה
verses.english: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for [it is] he that giveth thee power to get wealth, and that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, Ischak, and Jacob, as [it is] this day.
verses.romanian: dar să a-și aduce aminte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: căci [it este] he că giveth te power to get wealth, și că he poate establish lui legământ care he sware lui tău părinți, to Abraham, Ischak, și Jacob, as [it este] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אם שכח תשכח את יהוה אלהיך והלכת אחרי אלהים אחרים ועבדתם והשתחוית להם העדתי בכם היום כי אבד תאבדון
verses.english: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.romanian: și it va fi, dacă tu a face at toți a uita DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și a umbla după alți dumnezei, și a sluji them, și worship them, I testify împotriva you this zi că voi va negresit perish.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כגוים אשר יהוה מאבד מפניכם כן תאבדון עקב לא תשמעון בקול יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: As the neamuri care DOMNUL destroyeth înainte vostru față, so va voi perish; pentru că voi ar nu fi obedient lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמע ישראל אתה עבר היום את הירדן לבוא לרשת גוים גדלים ועצמים ממך ערים גדלות ובצרות בשמים
verses.english: Hear, O Israel: Thou [art] to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven
verses.romanian: Ascultă, Israele: tu [art] to a trece peste Iordan this zi, to a intra to a stăpâni neamuri greater și mightier than thyself, cetăți great și fenced up to heaven

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עם גדול ורם בני ענקים אשר אתה ידעת ואתה שמעת מי יתיצב לפני בני ענק
verses.english: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and [of whom] thou hast heard [say], Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.romanian: A popor great și tall, the copiii lui the Anakims, pe care tu knowest, și [of pe care] tu hast a auzit [a spune], care poate a sta înainte the copiii lui Anak!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעת היום כי יהוה אלהיך הוא העבר לפניך אש אכלה הוא ישמידם והוא יכנעם לפניך והורשתם ואבדתם מהר כאשר דבר יהוה לך
verses.english: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God [is] he which goeth over before thee; [as] a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
verses.romanian: Understand de aceea this zi, că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] he care merge peste înainte te; [as] a consuming foc he va a nimici them, și he va a aduce them down înainte tău față: so shalt tu a-i alunga, și a nimici them quickly, as DOMNUL sunt a spus lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תאמר בלבבך בהדיף יהוה אלהיך אתם מפניך לאמר בצדקתי הביאני יהוה לרשת את הארץ הזאת וברשעת הגוים האלה יהוה מורישם מפניך
verses.english: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.romanian: a vorbi nu tu in al tău inimă, după că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt cast them out din înainte te, saying, căci meu righteousness DOMNUL sunt a adus me in to a stăpâni this țară: dar căci the wickedness of these neamuri DOMNUL doth a-i alunga din înainte te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא בצדקתך ובישר לבבך אתה בא לרשת את ארצם כי ברשעת הגוים האלה יהוה מורישם מפניך ולמען הקים את הדבר אשר נשבע לאבתיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב
verses.english: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.romanian: nu căci tău righteousness, sau căci the uprightness of al tău inimă, dost tu a merge to a stăpâni lor țară: dar căci the wickedness of these neamuri DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău doth a-i alunga din înainte te, și că he poate perform the cuvânt care DOMNUL sware lui tău părinți, Abraham, Isaac, și Jacob.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעת כי לא בצדקתך יהוה אלהיך נתן לך את הארץ הטובה הזאת לרשתה כי עם קשה ערף אתה
verses.english: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou [art] a stiffnecked people.
verses.romanian: Understand de aceea, că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te nu this good țară to a stăpâni it căci tău righteousness; căci tu [art] a stiffnecked popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זכור ואל תשכח את אשר הקצפת את יהוה אלהיך במדבר למן היום אשר יצאתם מארץ מצרים עד באכם עד המקום הזה ממרים הייתם עם יהוה
verses.english: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.romanian: a-și aduce aminte, și a uita nu, cum tu provokedst DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău to wrath in the pustie: din the zi că tu didst a pleca out of the țara Egiptului, until voi a venit lui this place, voi au been rebellious împotriva DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובחורב הקצפתם את יהוה ויתאנף יהוה בכם להשמיד אתכם
verses.english: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.romanian: de asemenea in Horeb voi provoked DOMNUL to wrath, so că DOMNUL era angry cu you to au a nimicit you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בעלותי ההרה לקחת לוחות האבנים לוחת הברית אשר כרת יהוה עמכם ואשב בהר ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה לחם לא אכלתי ומים לא שתיתי
verses.english: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, [even] the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.romanian: când I era gone up into the munte to receive the tables of piatră, [even] the tables of the legământ care DOMNUL a făcut cu you, atunci I abode in the munte patruzeci zile și patruzeci nights, I neither a făcut eat pâine nor drink apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן יהוה אלי את שני לוחת האבנים כתובים באצבע אלהים ועליהם ככל הדברים אשר דבר יהוה אליכם בהר מתוך האש ביום הקהל
verses.english: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them [was written] according to all the words, which the LORD spake to you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL delivered lui me doi tables of piatră written cu the finger of Dumnezeu; și on them [era written] după toți cuvintele, care DOMNUL a vorbit to you in the munte out of the midst of the foc in the zi of the adunare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי מקץ ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה נתן יהוה אלי את שני לוחת הברית
verses.english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, [that] the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, [even] the tables of the covenant.
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece at the end of patruzeci zile și patruzeci nights, [că] DOMNUL a dat me the doi tables of piatră, [even] the tables of the legământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי קום רד מהר מזה כי שחת עמך אשר הוצאת ממצרים סרו מהר מן הדרך אשר צויתם עשו להם עגל מסכה
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted [themselves]; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a calf molten.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Arise, get te down quickly din hence; căci tău popor care tu hast a adus forth din Egipt au corrupted [înșiși]; they sunt quickly s-a întors aside out of the cale care I commanded them; they au a făcut them a calf molten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי לאמר ראיתי את העם הזה והנה עם קשה ערף הוא
verses.english: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it [is] a stiffnecked people:
verses.romanian: Furthermore DOMNUL a vorbit lui me, saying, I au seen this popor, și, iată, it [este] a stiffnecked popor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הרף ממני ואשמידם ואמחה את שמם מתחת השמים ואעשה אתך לגוי עצום ורב ממנו
verses.english: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.romanian: Let me alone, că I poate a nimici them, și blot out lor name din sub heaven: și I va a face of te a neam mightier și greater than they.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואפנה וארדה מן ההר וההר בער באש ושני לוחת הברית על שתי ידי
verses.english: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant [were] in my two hands.
verses.romanian: So I s-a întors și a venit down din the munte, și the munte burned cu foc: și the doi tables of the legământ [erau] in meu doi mâini.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואראה והנה חטאתם ליהוה אלהיכם עשיתם לכם עגל מסכה סרתם מהר מן הדרך אשר צוה יהוה אתכם
verses.english: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, [and] had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.romanian: și I a privit, și, iată, voi had sinned împotriva DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, [și] had a făcut you a molten calf: voi had s-a întors aside quickly out of the cale care DOMNUL had commanded you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתפשה בשני הלוחות ואשליכם מעל שתי ידי ואשברם לעיניכם
verses.english: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.romanian: și I a luat the doi tables, și cast them out of meu doi mâini, și brake them înainte vostru ochi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתנפלה לפני יהוה כראישונה ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה לחם לא אכלתי ומים לא שתיתי על כל חטאתיכם אשר חטאתם לעשות הרע בעיני יהוה להכעיסו
verses.english: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.romanian: și I a căzut down înainte DOMNUL, as at the întâi, patruzeci zile și patruzeci nights: I a făcut neither eat pâine, nor drink apă, pentru că of toți vostru păcate care voi sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of DOMNUL, to provoke him to anger.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יגרתי מפני האף והחמה אשר קצף יהוה עליכם להשמיד אתכם וישמע יהוה אלי גם בפעם ההוא
verses.english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.romanian: căci I era afraid of the anger și hot displeasure, wherewith DOMNUL era wroth împotriva you to a nimici you. dar DOMNUL hearkened lui me at că time de asemenea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאהרן התאנף יהוה מאד להשמידו ואתפללה גם בעד אהרן בעת ההיא
verses.english: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL era foarte angry cu Aaron to au a nimicit him: și I prayed căci Aaron de asemenea the same time.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת חטאתיכם אשר עשיתם את העגל לקחתי ואשרפה אתו באש ואכתה אתו טחון הייטב עד אשר דק לעפר ואשליכה את עפרו אל הנחל היורד מן ההר
verses.english: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, [and] ground [it] very small, [even] until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.romanian: și I a luat vostru păcat, the calf care voi had a făcut, și burnt it cu foc, și stamped it, [și] ground [it] foarte small, [even] until it era as small as dust: și I cast the dust thereof into the brook că descended out of the munte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובתבערה ובמסה ובקברות התאוה מקצפים הייתם את יהוה
verses.english: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
verses.romanian: și at Taberah, și at Massah, și at Kibroth-hattaavah, voi provoked DOMNUL to wrath.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשלח יהוה אתכם מקדש ברנע לאמר עלו ורשו את הארץ אשר נתתי לכם ותמרו את פי יהוה אלהיכם ולא האמנתם לו ולא שמעתם בקולו
verses.english: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.romanian: Likewise când DOMNUL sent you din Kadesh-barnea, saying, a se urca și a stăpâni țara care I au given you; atunci voi rebelled împotriva the poruncă of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și voi believed him nu, nor hearkened to lui voice.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ממרים הייתם עם יהוה מיום דעתו אתכם
verses.english: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
verses.romanian: voi au been rebellious împotriva DOMNUL din the zi că I a cunoscut you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתנפלה לפני יהוה את ארבעים היום ואת ארבעים הלילה אשר התנפלתי כי אמר יהוה להשמיד אתכם
verses.english: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down [at the first]; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
verses.romanian: astfel I a căzut down înainte DOMNUL patruzeci zile și patruzeci nights, as I a căzut down [at the întâi]; pentru că DOMNUL had a spus he ar a nimici you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתפללה אל יהוה ואמרה אדני יהוה אל תשחית עמך ונחלתך אשר פדית בגדלך אשר הוצאת ממצרים בידך החזקה
verses.english: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.romanian: I prayed de aceea lui DOMNUL, și a spus, O DOMNUL Dumnezeu, a nimici nu tău popor și al tău moștenire, care tu hast redeemed prin tău greatness, care tu hast a adus forth din Egipt cu mână puternică.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זכור לעבדיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב אל תפן אל קשה העם הזה ואל רשעו ואל חטאתו
verses.english: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.romanian: a-și aduce aminte tău slujitori, Abraham, Isaac, și Jacob; a privi nu lui the stubbornness of this popor, nor to lor wickedness, nor to lor păcat:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פן יאמרו עם הארץ אשר הוצאתנו משם מבלתי יכלת יהוה להביא אתם אל הארץ אשר דבר להם ומשנאתו אתם הוציאם להמיתם במדבר
verses.english: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.romanian: Lest the țară whence tu broughtest us out a spune, pentru că DOMNUL era nu able to a aduce them into the țară care he promised them, și pentru că he hated them, he sunt a adus them out to a ucide them in the pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והם עמך ונחלתך אשר הוצאת ממצרים בכחך הגדול ובזרועך הנטויה
verses.english: Yet they [are] thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out of Egypt by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
verses.romanian: Yet they [sunt] tău popor și al tău moștenire, care tu broughtest din Egipt by tău mighty power și by tău stretched out arm.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בעת ההיא אמר יהוה אלי פסל לך שני לוחת אבנים כראישונים ועלה אלי ההרה ועשית לך ארון עץ
verses.english: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.romanian: At că time DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Hew te doi tables of piatră like lui the întâi, și a veni up lui me into the munte, și a face te an ark of lemn.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכתבה על הלוחות את הדברים אשר היו על הלוחות הראישונים אשר שברת ושמתם בארון
verses.english: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.romanian: și I va a scrie on the tables cuvintele că erau in the întâi tables care tu brakest, și să a pune them in the ark.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואעשה ארון עצי שטים ואפסלה שני לוחת אבנים כראישונים ואעלה ההרה ושני הלוחות בידי
verses.english: And I made an ark [of] shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.romanian: și I a făcut an ark [of] shittim lemn, și hewed doi tables of piatră like lui the întâi, și a mers up into the munte, having the doi tables in al meu mână.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכתב על הלוחות כמכתב הראישון את עשרת הדברים אשר דבר יהוה עליכם בהר מתוך האש ביום הקהל ויתנם יהוה אלי
verses.english: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.romanian: și he a scris on the tables, după the întâi writing, the zece porunci, care DOMNUL a vorbit lui you in the munte out of the midst of the foc in the zi of the adunare: și DOMNUL a dat them lui me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואפנה וארדה מן ההר ואשימה את הלוחות בארון אשר עשיתי ויהיו שם כאשר צוני יהוה
verses.english: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.romanian: și I s-a întors myself și a venit down din the munte, și a pune the tables in the ark care I had a făcut; și acolo they fi, as DOMNUL commanded me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני ישראל נסעו ממסרות ויחנו בבני יעקן
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: משם נסעו ויחנו הגדגדה משם נסעו ויחנו ביטבתה ארץ נחלי מים משם נסעו ויחנו בעברנה משם נסעו ויחנו בעציונ גבר משם נסעו ויחנו במדבר צן היא קדש משם נסעו ויחנו בהר ההר וימת שם אהרן ויקבר שם ויכהן אלעזר בנו תחתיו
verses.english: From thence they journeyed and camped at Gudgodah; and from there they journeyed and camped in Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters. From there they journeyed and camped in Barnea. From there they journeyed and camped in Ezivot-Gabar. From there they journeyed and camped in the holy wilderness of Zin. From there they journeyed and camped in mountain Hur. And he is dying there Aaron and he is burried there. And Elazar became a priest instead of him.
verses.romanian: din thence they journeyed și camped at Gudgodah; și din acolo they journeyed și camped in Jotbath, a țară of rivers of ape. din acolo they journeyed și camped in Barnea. din acolo they journeyed și camped in Ezivot-Gabar. din acolo they journeyed și camped in the sfânt pustie of Zin. din acolo they journeyed și camped in munte Hur. și he este dying acolo Aaron și he este burried acolo. și Elazar became a preot instead of him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בעת ההיא הבדיל יהוה את שבט הלוי לשאת את ארון ברית יהוה לעמד לפני יהוה לשרתו ולברך בשמו עד היום הזה
verses.english: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.romanian: At că time DOMNUL separated the seminție of Levi, to bear the ark of the legământ of DOMNUL, to a sta înainte DOMNUL to minister lui him, și to bless in lui name, lui this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על כן לא היה ללוי חלק ונחלה עם אחיו יהוה הוא נחלתו כאשר דבר יהוה אלהיך לו
verses.english: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD [is] his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
verses.romanian: de aceea Levi sunt no part nor moștenire cu lui brethren; DOMNUL [este] lui moștenire, după cum DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău promised him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואנכי עמדתי בהר כימים הראישונים ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה וישמע יהוה אלי גם בפעם ההוא ולא אבה יהוה השחיתך
verses.english: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.romanian: și I stayed in the munte, după the întâi time, patruzeci zile și patruzeci nights; și DOMNUL hearkened lui me at că time de asemenea, și DOMNUL ar nu a nimici te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי קום לך למסע לפני העם הזה ויבאו ויירשו את הארץ אשר נשבעתי לאבותם לתת להם
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take [thy] journey before this people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, Arise, a lua [tău] călătorie înainte this popor, că they poate a intra și a stăpâni țara, care I sware lui lor părinți to a da lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה ישראל מה יהוה אלהיך שאל מעמך כי אם ליראה את יהוה אלהיך ללכת בכל דרכיו ולאהבה אתו ולעבד את יהוה אלהיך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך
verses.english: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul
verses.romanian: și acum, Israel, ce doth DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău require of te, dar to a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a umbla in toți lui căi, și to a iubi him, și to a sluji DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu toți tău inimă și cu tot sufletul tău

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולשמר את מצות יהוה אלהיך ואת חקתיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום לטוב לך
verses.english: And To keep the commandments of the LORD God of you, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
verses.romanian: și To a păzi poruncile of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you, și lui porunci, care I command te this zi căci tău good?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הן ליהוה אלהיך השמים ושמי השמים הארץ וכל אשר בה
verses.english: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens [is] the LORD's thy God, the earth [also], with all that therein [is].
verses.romanian: iată, the heaven și the heaven of heavens [este] DOMNUL's tău Dumnezeu, the pământ [de asemenea], cu toți că therein [este].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק באבתיך חשק יהוה לאהבה אתם ויבחר בזרעם אחריהם בכם מכל העמים כיום הזה
verses.english: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, [even] you above all people, as [it is] this day.
verses.romanian: numai DOMNUL had a delight in tău părinți to a iubi them, și he a ales lor sămânță după them, [even] you deasupra toți popor, as [it este] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומלתם את ערלת לבבכם וערפכם לא תקשו עוד
verses.english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.romanian: Circumcise de aceea the foreskin of vostru inimă, și fi no more stiffnecked.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהוה אלהיכם הוא אלהי האלהים ואדון האדונים האל הגדול והגיבור והנורא אשר לא ישא פנים ולא יקח שחד
verses.english: For the LORD your God [is] God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, and mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [este] Dumnezeu of gods, și DOMNUL of lords, a great Dumnezeu, și mighty, și a terrible, care regardeth nu persons, nor taketh reward:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עשה משפט יתום ואלמנה ואהב גר לתת לו לחם ושמלה
verses.english: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.romanian: He doth execute the judecată of the fatherless și văduvă, și loveth the străin, in giving him hrană și raiment.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואהבתם את הגר כי גרים הייתם בארץ מצרים
verses.english: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.romanian: a iubi voi de aceea the străin: căci voi erau străini in the țara Egiptului.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את יהוה אלהיך תירא ואתו תעבד ובו תדבק ובשמו תשבע
verses.english: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; and him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.romanian: să a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău; și him shalt tu a sluji, și to him shalt tu cleave, și swear by lui name.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הוא תהלתך והוא אלהיך אשר עשה אתך את הגדלות ואת הנוראות האלה אשר ראו עיניך
verses.english: He [is] thy praise, and he [is] thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.romanian: He [este] tău praise, și he [este] tău Dumnezeu, că sunt done căci te these great și terrible things, care al tău ochi au seen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בשבעים נפש ירדו אבתיך מצרימה ועתה שמך יהוה אלהיך ככוכבי השמים לרב
verses.english: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.romanian: tău părinți a mers down into Egypt cu threescore și zece persons; și acum DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt a făcut te as the stars of heaven căci multitude.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואהבת את יהוה אלהיך ושמרת משמרתו חקתיו ומצותיו ומשפטיו כל הימים
verses.english: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, always.
verses.romanian: de aceea să a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și a păzi lui charge, lui porunci, și lui judecăți, și lui porunci, always.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידעתם היום כי לא את בניכם אשר לא ידעו ואשר לא ראו את מוסר יהוה אלהיכם את גדלו ואת ידו החזקה ואת זרועו הנטויה
verses.english: And know ye this day: for [I speak] not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, and his mighty hand, and with his stretched out arm
verses.romanian: și a cunoaște voi this zi: căci [I a vorbi] nu cu vostru copii care au nu known, și care au nu seen the chastisement of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, lui greatness, și lui mighty mână, și cu lui stretched out arm

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את אתותיו ואת מעשיו אשר עשה בתוך מצרים לפרעה ולכל ארצו
verses.english: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.romanian: și lui miracles, și lui acts, care he a făcut in the midst of Egypt lui Pharaoh the rege of Egypt, și lui toți lui țară;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשר עשה לחיל מצרים לסוסיו ולרכבו אשר הציף את מי ים סוף על פניהם ברדפם אחריכם ויאבדם יהוה עד היום הזה
verses.english: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and [how] the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
verses.romanian: și ce he a făcut lui the army of Egypt, lui lor horses, și to lor chariots; cum he a făcut the apă of the Marea Roșie to overflow them as they pursued după you, și [cum] DOMNUL sunt a nimicit them lui this zi;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשר עשה לכם במדבר עד באכם עד המקום הזה
verses.english: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
verses.romanian: și ce he a făcut lui you in the pustie, until voi a venit into this place;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשר עשה לדתן ולאבירם בני אליאב בן ראובן אשר פצתה הארץ את פיה ותבלעם ואת כל האדם אשר לקרח ואת בתיהם ואת אהליהם ואת כל היקום אשר ברגליהם בקרב כל ישראל
verses.english: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up all men of Korah, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that [was] in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
verses.romanian: și ce he a făcut lui Dathan și Abiram, the fiii lui Eliab, the fiu of Reuben: cum the pământ opened ei gură, și swallowed them up toți oameni of Korah, și lor households, și lor tents, și toți the substance că [era] in lor moștenire, in the midst of toți Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי עיניכם הראות את כל מעשה יהוה הגדול אשר עשה
verses.english: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
verses.romanian: dar vostru ochi au seen toți the great acts of DOMNUL care he a făcut.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את כל המצוה אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום למען תחזקו ובאתם וירשתם את הארץ אשר אתם באים שמה לרשתה
verses.english: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command with you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
verses.romanian: de aceea va voi a păzi toate poruncile care I command cu you this zi, că voi poate fi strong, și a intra și a stăpâni țara, whither voi a merge to a stăpâni it;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמען תאריכון ימים על האדמה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיכם לתת לזרעם ארץ זבת חלב ודבש
verses.english: And that ye may prolong [your] days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.romanian: și că voi poate prolong [vostru] zile in the țară, care DOMNUL sware lui vostru părinți to a da lui them și to lor sămânță, a țară că floweth cu lapte și miere.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי הארץ אשר אתם באים שמה לרשתה לא כארץ מצרים היא אשר יצאתם משם אשר תזרע את זרעך והשקית ברגליך כגן הירק
verses.english: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, [is] not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst [it] with thy feet, as a garden of herbs:
verses.romanian: căci the țară, whither tu goest in to a stăpâni it, [este] nu as the țara Egiptului, din whence voi a venit out, where tu sowedst tău sămânță, și wateredst [it] cu tău picioare, as a garden of herbs:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והארץ אשר אתם עברים שמה לרשתה ארץ הרים ובקעות למטר השמים תשתה מים
verses.english: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, [is] a land of hills and valleys, [and] drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
verses.romanian: dar the țară, whither voi a merge to a stăpâni it, [este] a țară of hills și valleys, [și] drinketh apă of the rain of heaven:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך דרש אתה תמיד עיני יהוה אלהיך בה מראשית השנה ועד אחרית השנה
verses.english: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God [are] always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
verses.romanian: A țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău careth căci: the ochi of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [sunt] always upon it, din the beginning of the an even lui the end of the an.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אם שמע תשמעו אל מצותי אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום לאהבה את יהוה אלהיכם לעבדו בכל לבבכם ובכל נפשכם
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, dacă voi va hearken diligently lui meu porunci care I command you this zi, to a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și to a sluji him cu toată inima voastră și cu tot sufletul vostru

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן מטר ארצך בעתו יורא ומלקוש ואספת דגנך תירשך ויצהרך
verses.english: That I will give [you] the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, thy wine, and thine oil.
verses.romanian: că I va a da [you] the rain of vostru țară in lui due season, the întâi rain și the latter rain, că tu mayest gather in tău grâu, tău vin, și al tău ulei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן עשב בשדך לבהמתך ואכלת ושבעת
verses.english: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
verses.romanian: și I va send grass in tău câmpuri căci tău vite, că tu mayest eat și fi full.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמרו לכם פן יפתה לבבכם וסרתם ועבדתם אלהים אחרים והשתחויתם להם
verses.english: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.romanian: a lua heed to yourselves, că vostru inimă fi nu deceived, și voi a se abate, și a sluji altor dumnezei, și worship them;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחרה אף יהוה בכם ועצר את השמים ולא יהיה מטר והאדמה לא תתן את יבולה ואבדתם מהר מעל הארץ הטובה אשר יהוה נתן לכם
verses.english: And [then] the LORD's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and [lest] ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
verses.romanian: și [atunci] DOMNUL's wrath fi kindled împotriva you, și he shut up the heaven, că acolo fi no rain, și că the țară yield nu ei rod; și [lest] voi perish quickly din off the good țară care DOMNUL giveth you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמתם את דברי אלה על לבבכם ועל נפשכם וקשרתם אתם לאות על ידיכם והיו לטטפות בין עיניכם
verses.english: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hands, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.romanian: de aceea va voi lay up these meu cuvinte in vostru inimă și in vostru suflet, și bind them căci a sign upon vostru mâini, că they poate fi as frontlets between vostru ochi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמדתם אתם את בניכם לדבר בם בשבתך בבית בלכתך בדרך בשכבך ובקומך
verses.english: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.romanian: și voi va a învăța them vostru copii, speaking of them când tu sittest in al tău casă, când tu walkest by the cale, când tu liest down, și când tu risest up.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכתבתם על מזזות בתיך ובשעריך
verses.english: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
verses.romanian: și să a scrie them upon the door posts of al tău casă, și upon tău porți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למען ירבון ימיכם וימי בניכם על האדמה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיכם לתת להם כימי השמים על הארץ
verses.english: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.romanian: că vostru zile poate fi multiplied, și the zile of vostru copii, in țara pe care DOMNUL sware lui vostru părinți to a da them, as the zile of heaven upon the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם שמר תשמרון את כל המצוה הזאת אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום לעשותה לאהבה את יהוה אלהיכם ללכת בכל דרכיו ולהדבקה בו
verses.english: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you today, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
verses.romanian: căci dacă voi va diligently a păzi toți these porunci care I command you astăzi, to a face them, to a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a umbla in toți lui căi, și to cleave lui him;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוריש יהוה את כל הגוים האלה מלפניך וירשתם גוים גדלים ועצמים ממך
verses.english: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
verses.romanian: atunci va DOMNUL a alunga toți these neamuri din înainte you, și voi va a stăpâni greater neamuri și mightier than yourselves.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל המקום אשר תדרך כף רגלכם בו לכם יהיה מן המדבר והלבנון ומן הנהר נהר פרת ועד הים האחרון יהיה גבולכם
verses.english: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, and from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
verses.romanian: fiecare place whereon the soles of vostru picioare va tread va fi ale voastre: din the pustie și Lebanon, și din the river, the river Euphrates, even lui the uttermost sea va vostru coast fi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יתיצב איש לפניכם פחדכם ומראכם יתן יהוה אלהיכם על פני כל הארץ אשר תדרכו בה כאשר דבר לכם
verses.english: There shall no man be able to stand before you: [for] the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
verses.romanian: acolo va no om fi able to a sta înainte you: [căci] DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va lay the a se teme of you și the dread of you upon toți the țară că voi va tread upon, as he sunt a spus lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראה אנכי נתן לפניכם היום ברכה וקללה
verses.english: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
verses.romanian: iată, I a așeza înainte you this zi a binecuvântare și a blesteme;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את הברכה אשר תשמעון אל מצות יהוה אלהיכם אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום
verses.english: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
verses.romanian: A binecuvântare, dacă voi a asculta the porunci of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care I command you this zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקללה אם לא תשמעון אל מצות יהוה אלהיכם וסרתם מן הדרך אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם היום ללכת אחרי אלהים אחרים אשר לא ידעתם
verses.english: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
verses.romanian: și a blesteme, dacă voi va nu a asculta the porunci of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, dar a se abate out of the cale care I command you this zi, to a merge după alți dumnezei, care voi au nu known.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יביאך יהוה אלהיך אל הארץ אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה ונתתה את הברכה על הרגריזים ואת הקללה על הר עיבל
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt a adus te in lui the țară whither tu goest to a stăpâni it, că să a pune the binecuvântare upon munte Gerizim, și the blesteme upon munte Ebal.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הלוא הם בעבר הירדן אחרי דרך מבוא השמש בארץ הכנעני הישב בערבה מול הגלגל אצל אלון מורא מול שכם
verses.english: [Are] they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh, beside Sechem?
verses.romanian: [sunt] they nu on the other side Iordan, by the cale where the sun merge down, in the țară of the Canaanites, care dwell in the champaign peste împotriva Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh, beside Sechem?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אתם עברים את הירדן לבוא לרשת את הארץ אשר יהוה אלהיכם נתן לכם וירשתם אתה וישבתם בה
verses.english: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.romanian: căci voi va a trece peste Iordan to a intra to a stăpâni țara care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth you, și voi va a stăpâni it, și dwell therein.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם לעשות את כל החקים ואת כל המשפטים אשר אנכי נתן לפניכם היום
verses.english: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and all judgments which I set before you this day.
verses.romanian: și voi va a păzi to a face toți the porunci și toți judecăți care I a așeza înainte you this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה החקים והמשפטים אשר תשמרו לעשות בארץ אשר נתן יהוה אלהי אבתיך לך לרשתה כל הימים אשר אתם חיים על האדמה
verses.english: These [are] the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the porunci și judecăți, care voi va a păzi to a face in the țară, care DOMNUL Dumnezeu of tău părinți giveth te to a stăpâni it, toți the zile că voi a trăi upon the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אבד תאבדון את כל המקומות אשר עבדו שם הגוים אשר אתם ירשים אתם את אלהיהם על ההרים הרמים ועל הגבעות ותחת כל עץ רענן
verses.english: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
verses.romanian: voi va utterly a nimici toți the places, wherein the neamuri care voi va a stăpâni a slujit lor gods, upon the high munți, și upon the hills, și sub fiecare green copac:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתצתם את מזבחתיהם ושברתם את מצבתיהם ואשריהם תשרפון באש ופסילי אלהיהם תגדעון ואבדתם את שמם מן המקום ההוא
verses.english: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
verses.romanian: și voi va overthrow lor altare, și a sfărâma lor stâlpi, și burn lor groves cu foc; și voi va hew down the chipuri cioplite of lor gods, și a nimici the names of them out of că place.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשו כן ליהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: voi va nu a face so lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם אל המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיכם מכל שבטיכם לשים את שמו שם לשכינו תדרשו ובאתם שם
