verses.english: But unto the place which the LORD your God has chosen out of all your tribes to put his name there, [even] unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
verses.romanian: dar lui the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales out of toți vostru seminții to a pune lui name acolo, [even] lui lui habitation va voi a căuta, și thither să a veni:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבאתם שמה עלתיכם וזבחיכם ואת מעשרתיכם ואת תרומתיכם ונדריכם ונדבתיכם ובכורת בקרכם וצאנכם
verses.english: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
verses.romanian: și thither voi va a aduce vostru burnt offerings, și vostru sacrifices, și vostru tithes, și heave offerings of vostru mână, și vostru vows, și vostru freewill offerings, și the firstlings of vostru herds și of vostru turme:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתם שם לפני יהוה אלהיכם ושמחתם בכל משלח ידיכם אתם ובתיכם אשר ברכך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hands unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
verses.romanian: și acolo voi va eat înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și voi va rejoice in toți că voi a pune vostru mâini lui, voi și vostru households, wherein DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt binecuvântat te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשו ככל אשר אנחנו עשים פה היום איש כל הישר בעיניו
verses.english: Ye shall not do after all [the things] that we do here this day, every man whatsoever [is] right in his own eyes.
verses.romanian: voi va nu a face după toți [the things] că we a face aici this zi, fiecare om whatsoever [este] right in lui own ochi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא באתם עד עתה אל המנוחה ואל הנחלה אשר יהוה אלהיכם נתן לכם
verses.english: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
verses.romanian: căci voi sunt nu as yet a veni to the rest și to the moștenire, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועברתם את הירדן וישבתם בארץ אשר יהוה אלהיכם מנחיל אתכם והניח לכם מכל איביכם מסביב וישבתם בטח
verses.english: But [when] ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and [when] he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
verses.romanian: dar [când] voi a merge peste Iordan, și dwell in the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth you to a moșteni, și [când] he giveth you rest din toți vostru enemies round about, so că voi dwell in safety;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיכם בו לשכן את שמו שם שמה תביאו את כל אשר אנכי מצוה אתכם עלתיכם וזבחיכם ומעשרתיכם ותרומתיכם ונדבתיכם וכל מבחר נדריכם אשר תדרו ליהוה
verses.english: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God has chosen to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and free will offerings, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
verses.romanian: atunci acolo va fi a place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales to cause lui name to dwell acolo; thither va voi a aduce toți că I command you; vostru burnt offerings, și vostru sacrifices, și vostru tithes, și the heave offering of vostru mână, și free va offerings, și toți vostru choice vows care voi vow lui DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמחתם לפני יהוה אלהיכם אתם ובניכם ובנתיכם עבדיכם ואמתיכם והלוי אשר בשעריכם כי אין לו חלק ונחלה אתכם
verses.english: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that [is] within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.romanian: și voi va rejoice înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, voi, și vostru fii, și vostru fiice, vostru menservants, și vostru maidservants, și the levit că [este] în vostru porți; forasmuch as he sunt no part nor moștenire cu you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן תעלה עלתיך בכל המקום אשר תראה
verses.english: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
verses.romanian: a lua heed to thyself că tu offer nu tău burnt offerings in fiecare place că tu seest:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם במקום אשר בחר יהוה באחד שבטיך שם תעלה עלתיך ושם תעשה את כל אשר אנכי מצוך
verses.english: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
verses.romanian: dar in locul pe care DOMNUL va a alege in unu of tău seminții, acolo să offer tău burnt offerings, și acolo să a face toți că I command te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק בכל אות נפשך תזבח ואכלת בשר כברכת יהוה אלהיך אשר נתן לך בכל שעריך הטמא והטהור יאכלנו כצבי וכאיל
verses.english: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding tu mayest a ucide și eat flesh in toți tău porți, whatsoever tău suflet lusteth după, după the binecuvântare of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău care he sunt given te: the necurat și the curat poate eat thereof, as of the roebuck, și as of the hart.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק הדם לא תאכל על הארץ תשפכנו כמים
verses.english: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.romanian: numai voi va nu eat the blood; voi va pour it upon the pământ as apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תוכל לאכל בשעריך מעשר דגנך תירשך ויצהרך ובכורת בקרך וצאנך וכל נדריך אשר תדר ונדבתיך ותרומות ידיך
verses.english: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hands:
verses.romanian: tu mayest nu eat în tău porți the tithe of tău grâu, sau of tău vin, sau of tău ulei, sau the firstlings of tău herds sau of tău turmă, nor vreun of tău vows care tu vowest, nor tău freewill offerings, sau heave offering of al tău mâini:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם לפני יהוה אלהיך תאכלנו במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך בו אתה ובנך ובתך עבדך ואמתך והלוי אשר בשעריך ושמחת לפני יהוה אלהיך בכל משלח ידיך
verses.english: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that [is] within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
verses.romanian: dar tu trebuie eat them înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege, tu, și tău fiu, și tău fiică, tău manservant, și tău maidservant, și the levit că [este] în tău porți: și să rejoice înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in toți că tu puttest al tău mâini lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן תעזב את הלוי כל ימיך על אדמתך
verses.english: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
verses.romanian: a lua heed to thyself că tu forsake nu the levit as long as tu livest upon the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ירחיב יהוה אלהיך את גבולך כאשר דבר לך ואמרת אכלה בשר כי תאוה נפשך לאכל בשר בכל אות נפשך תאכל בשר
verses.english: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.romanian: când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va enlarge tău border, as he sunt promised te, și să a spune, I va eat flesh, pentru că tău suflet longeth to eat flesh; tu mayest eat flesh, whatsoever tău suflet lusteth după.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ירחק ממך המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם וזבחת מבקרך ומצאנך אשר נתן יהוה לך כאשר צויתיך ואכלת בשעריך בכל אות נפשך
verses.english: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to tabernacle with his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.romanian: dacă the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales to tabernacle cu lui name acolo fi too far din te, atunci să a ucide of tău cireadă și of tău turmă, care DOMNUL sunt given te, as I au commanded te, și să eat in tău porți whatsoever tău suflet lusteth după.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך כאשר יאכל את הצבי ואת האיל כן תאכלנו הטמא בך והטהור יאכלנו יחדו
verses.english: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean among you and the clean shall eat [of] them alike.
verses.romanian: Even as the roebuck și the hart este eaten, so să eat them: the necurat între you și the curat va eat [of] them alike.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק חזק לבלתי אכל הדם כי הדם הוא הנפש ולא תאכל הנפש עם הבשר
verses.english: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood [is] the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.romanian: numai fi sure că tu eat nu the blood: căci the blood [este] the life; și tu mayest nu eat the life cu the flesh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלנו על הארץ תשפכנו כמים
verses.english: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.romanian: să nu eat it; să pour it upon the pământ as apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלנו למען ייטב לך ולבניך אחריך כי תעשה הישר בעיני יהוה
verses.english: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do [that which is] right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.romanian: să nu eat it; că it poate a merge well cu te, și cu tău copii după te, când să a face [că care este] right in the sight of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק קדשיך אשר יהיו לך ונדריך תשא ובאת אל המקום אשר בחר יהוה
verses.english: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose.
verses.romanian: numai tău sfânt things care tu hast, și tău vows, să a lua, și a merge lui locul pe care DOMNUL va a alege.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשית עלתיך הבשר והדם על מזבח יהוה אלהיך ודם זבחיך ישפך על מזבח יהוה אלהיך והבשר תאכל
verses.english: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
verses.romanian: și să offer tău burnt offerings, the flesh și the blood, upon the altar of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: și the blood of tău sacrifices va fi poured out upon the altar of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și să eat the flesh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמור ושמעת ועשית את כל הדברים האלה אשר אנכי מצוך היום למען ייטב לך ולבניך אחריך עד עולם כי תעשה הישר והטוב בעיני יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: Observe and hear and do all these words which I command thee today, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest [that which is] right and good in the sight of the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: a păzi și a auzi și a face toți these cuvinte care I command te astăzi, că it poate a merge well cu te, și cu tău copii după te căci ever, când tu doest [că care este] right și good in the sight of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יכרית יהוה אלהיך את הגוים אשר אתה בא שם לרשת אתם מפניך וירשת אתם וישבת בארצם
verses.english: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
verses.romanian: când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va nimicit the neamuri din înainte te, whither tu goest to a stăpâni them, și tu succeedest them, și dwellest in lor țară;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן תנקש אחריהם אחרי השמידם מפניך ופן תדרש לאלהיהם לאמר איך יעבדו הגוים האלה את אלהיהם ואעשה כן גם אני
verses.english: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou inquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
verses.romanian: a lua heed to thyself că tu fi nu snared by following them, după că they fi a nimicit din înainte te; și că tu inquire nu după lor gods, saying, cum a făcut these neamuri a sluji lor gods? even so va I a face likewise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשה כן ליהוה אלהיך כי את כל תועבת יהוה אשר שנא עשו לאלהיהם כי גם את בניהם ואת בנתיהם ישרפו באש לאלהיהם
verses.english: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
verses.romanian: să nu a face so lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: căci fiecare abomination to DOMNUL, care he hateth, au they done lui lor gods; căci even lor fii și lor fiice they au burnt in the foc to lor gods.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את כל הדבר אשר אנכי מצוך היום אתו תשמרו לעשות לא תוסיפו עליו ולא תגרעו ממנו
verses.english: What thing soever I command you today, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.romanian: ce thing soever I command you astăzi, a păzi to a face it: să nu add thereto, nor diminish din it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יקום בקרבך נביא או חלם חלום ונתן אליך אות או מופת
verses.english: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder
verses.romanian: dacă acolo arise între you a prophet, sau a dreamer of dreams, și giveth te a sign sau a wonder

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא האות והמופת אשר דבר אליך לאמר נלכה אחרי אלהים אחרים אשר לא ידעתם ונעבדם
verses.english: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
verses.romanian: și the sign sau the wonder a veni to a trece, whereof he a vorbit lui te, saying, Let us a merge după alți dumnezei, care tu hast nu known, și let us a sluji them;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תשמע אל דברי הנביא ההוא או אל החלם החלום ההוא כי מנסה יהוה אלהיכם אתכם לדעת הישכם אהבים את יהוה אלהיכם בכל לבבכם ובכל נפשכם
verses.english: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.romanian: să nu hearken lui cuvintele of că prophet, sau că dreamer of dreams: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău proveth you, to a cunoaște whether voi a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu toată inima voastră și cu tot sufletul vostru.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אחרי יהוה אלהיכם תלכון ואתו תיראון ואת מצותיו תשמרון ובקולו תשמעון ואתו תעבדו ובו תדבקו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנביא ההוא או החלם החלום ההוא יומת כי דבר סרה על יהוה אלהיך המוציאך מארץ מצרים והפדך מבית עבדים להדיחך מן הדרך אשר צוך יהוה אלהיך ללכת בה ובערת הרע מקרבך
verses.english: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn [you] away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
verses.romanian: și că prophet, sau că dreamer of dreams, va fi dat morții; pentru că he sunt spoken to a se întoarce [you] away din DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care a adus you out of the țara Egiptului, și redeemed you out of the casa robiei, to thrust te out of the cale care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău commanded te to a umbla in. So shalt tu a pune the evil away din the midst of te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יסיתך אחיך בן אביך או בן אמך או בנך או בתך או אשת חיקך או רעך אשר כנפשך בסתר לאמר נלכה ונעבדה אלהים אחרים אשר לא ידעת אתה ואבתיך
verses.english: If thy brother, the son of thy father or the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which [is] as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
verses.romanian: dacă tău frate, the fiu of tău tată sau the fiu of tău mamă, sau tău fiu, sau tău fiică, sau the wife of tău bosom, sau tău friend, care [este] as al tău own suflet, entice te secretly, saying, Let us a merge și a sluji altor dumnezei, care tu hast nu known, tu, nor tău părinți;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מאלהי העמים אשר סביבתיכם הקרובים אליך או הרחוקים ממך מקצה הארץ ועד קצה הארץ
verses.english: [Namely], of the gods of the people which [are] round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the [one] end of the earth even unto the [other] end of the earth;
verses.romanian: [Namely], of the gods of the popor care [sunt] round about you, nigh lui te, sau far off din te, din the [unu] end of the pământ even lui the [other] end of the pământ;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאבה אליו ולא תשמע אליו ולא תחוס עינך עליו ולא תחמל ולא תכסה עליו
verses.english: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
verses.romanian: să nu consent lui him, nor hearken lui him; neither va al tău ochi pity him, neither shalt tu spare, neither shalt tu conceal him:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי הרג תהרגנו ידך תהיה בו בראישונה להמיתו ויד כל העם באחרנה
verses.english: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
verses.romanian: dar să negresit a ucide him; al tău mână va fi întâi upon him to a pune him to death, și afterwards the mână of toți the popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסקלתו באבנים ומת כי בקש להדיחך מעל יהוה אלהיך המוציאך מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים
verses.english: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.romanian: și să piatră him cu pietre, că he a muri; pentru că he sunt a căutat to thrust te away din DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care a adus te out of the țara Egiptului, din the casa robiei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל ישראל ישמעו וייראו ולא יוסיפו עוד לעשות כדבר הרע הזה בקרבך
verses.english: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
verses.romanian: și toți Israel va a auzi, și a se teme, și va a face no more vreun such wickedness as this este între you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תשמע באחת עריך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לשבת שם לאמר
verses.english: If thou shalt hear [say] in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying
verses.romanian: dacă să a auzi [a spune] in unu of tău cetăți, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt given te to dwell acolo, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יצאו אנשים בני בלעיל מקרבך וידיחו את ישבי עירם לאמר נלכה ונעבדה אלהים אחרים אשר לא ידעתם
verses.english: [Certain] men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
verses.romanian: [Certain] oameni, the copiii lui Belial, sunt gone out din între you, și au withdrawn the inhabitants of lor cetate, saying, Let us a merge și a sluji altor dumnezei, care voi au nu known;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ודרשת וחקרת ושאלת הייטב והנה אמת נכון הדבר נעשתה התועבה הזאת בקרבך
verses.english: Then shalt thou inquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, [if it be] truth, [and] the thing certain, [that] such abomination is wrought among you;
verses.romanian: atunci shalt tu inquire, și a face search, și a întreba diligently; și, iată, [dacă it fi] truth, [și] the thing certain, [că] such abomination este wrought între you;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הכה תכה את ישבי העיר ההיא לפי חרב החרים אתה ואת כל אשר בה ואת בהמתה לפי חרב
verses.english: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that [is] therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
verses.romanian: să negresit a lovi the inhabitants of că cetate cu the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, și toți că [este] therein, și the vite thereof, cu the edge of the sword.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל שללה תקבץ אל תוך רחבה ושרפת באש את העיר ואת כל שללה כליל ליהוה אלהיך והיתה תל עולם לא תבנה עוד
verses.english: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
verses.romanian: și să gather toți the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, și shalt burn cu foc the cetate, și toți the spoil thereof fiecare whit, căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: și it va fi an heap căci ever; it va nu fi a construit again.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא ידבק בידך מאומה מן החרם למען ישוב יהוה מחרון אפו ונתן לך רחמים ורחמך והרבך כאשר נשבע לאבתיך
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר את כל מצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום לעשות הישר והטוב בעיני יהוה אלהיך
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בנים אתם ליהוה אלהיכם לא תתגדדו ולא תשימו קרחה בין עיניכם למת
verses.english: Ye [are] the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.romanian: voi [sunt] the copiii lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: voi va nu cut yourselves, nor a face vreun baldness between vostru ochi căci the dead.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי עם קדש אתה ליהוה אלהיך ובך בחר יהוה אלהיך להיות לו לעם סגלה מכל העמים אשר על פני האדמה
verses.english: For thou [art] an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD God of you hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that [are] upon the earth.
verses.romanian: căci tu [art] an sfânt popor lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you sunt ales te to fi a peculiar popor lui însuși, deasupra toți the neamuri că [sunt] upon the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלו כל תועבה
verses.english: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
verses.romanian: să nu eat vreun abominable thing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת הבהמה אשר תאכלו שור ושה כשבים ושה עזים
verses.english: And these [are] the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, and the sheep, and the goat
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the beasts care voi va eat: the bou, și the oaie, și the țap

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איל וצבי ויחמור אקו ודישון ותאי וזמר
verses.english: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, the pygarg, and the wild ox, and chamois.
verses.romanian: The hart, și the roebuck, și the fallow deer, și the wild țap, the pygarg, și the wild bou, și chamois.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל בהמה מפריסת פרסה ושסעת שסע שתי פרסות מעלות גרה בבהמה אתה תאכלו
verses.english: Every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, [and] cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
verses.romanian: fiecare beast că parteth the hoof, și cleaveth the cleft into doi claws, [și] cheweth the cud între the beasts, că voi va eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך את זה לא תאכלו ממעלי הגרה וממפרסי הפרסה את הגמל ואת הארנבת ואת השפן כי מעלה גרה הם ופרסה לא הפריסו טמאים הם לכם
verses.english: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; [as] the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; [therefore] they [are] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: Nevertheless these voi va nu eat of them că chew the cud, sau of them că divide the cloven hoof; [as] the camel, și the hare, și the coney: căci they chew the cud, dar divide nu the hoof; [de aceea] they [sunt] necurat lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החזיר כי מפריס פרסה הוא ושסע שסע פרסה והוא גרה לא יגור טמא הוא לכם מבשרם לא תאכלו ובנבלתם לא תגעו
verses.english: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof and cloves the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it [is] unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
verses.romanian: și the swine, pentru că it divideth the hoof și cloves the hoof, yet cheweth nu the cud, it [este] necurat lui you: voi va nu eat of lor flesh, nor touch lor dead carcase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת זה תאכלו מכל אשר במים כל אשר לו סנפיר וקשקשת תאכלו
verses.english: And these ye shall eat of all that [are] in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
verses.romanian: și these voi va eat of toți că [sunt] in the ape: toți că au fins și scales va voi eat:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר אין לו סנפיר וקשקשת לא תאכלו טמא הוא לכם
verses.english: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it [is] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever sunt nu fins și scales voi poate nu eat; it [este] necurat lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל צפור טהרה תאכלו
verses.english: [Of] all clean birds ye shall eat.
verses.romanian: [Of] toți curat păsări voi va eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה אשר לא תאכלו מהם את הנשר ואת הפרס ואת העזניה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הדאה ואת האיה למינה
verses.english: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind
verses.romanian: și the glede, și the kite, și the vulture după lui kind

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל ערב למינו
verses.english: And every raven after his kind
verses.romanian: și fiecare raven după lui kind

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת בת היענה ואת התחמוס ואת השחף למינו ואת הנץ
verses.english: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckoo after his kind, and the hawk after his kind
verses.romanian: și the owl, și the night hawk, și the cuckoo după lui kind, și the hawk după lui kind

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הכוס ואת השלך ואת הינשוף ואת התנשמת
verses.english: And the little owl, and the osprey, and the great owl, and the swan
verses.romanian: și the little owl, și the osprey, și the great owl, și the swan

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הקאת ואת הרחמה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החסידה והאנפה למינה ואת הדגיפת ואת העטלף
verses.english: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.romanian: și the stork, și the heron după ei kind, și the lapwing, și the bat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל שרץ העוף טמא הוא לכם לא תאכלו מהם
verses.english: And every creeping thing that flieth [is] unclean unto you: from them it shall not be eaten.
verses.romanian: și fiecare creeping thing că flieth [este] necurat lui you: din them it va nu fi eaten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל עוף טהור תאכלו
verses.english: [But of] all clean fowls ye may eat.
verses.romanian: [dar of] toți curat fowls voi poate eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלו כל נבלה לגר אשר בשעריך תתננה ואכלה או מכרה לנכרי כי עם קדש אתה ליהוה אלהיך לא תבשל גדי בחלב אמו
verses.english: Ye shall not eat [of] any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that [is] in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou [art] an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.romanian: voi va nu eat [of] vreun thing că dieth of itself: să a da it lui the străin că [este] in tău porți, că he poate eat it; sau tu mayest sell it lui an alien: căci tu [art] an sfânt popor lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău. să nu seethe a kid in lui mamă's lapte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עשר תעשר את כל תבואת זרעך יוצא השדה שנה בשנה
verses.english: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
verses.romanian: să truly tithe toți the increase of tău sămânță, că the câmp bringeth forth an by an.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתו לפני יהוה אלהיך במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם מעשר דגנך תירשך ויצהרך ובכורת בקרך וצאנך למען תלמד ליראה את יהוה אלהיך כל הימים
verses.english: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose the LORD God to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.
verses.romanian: și să eat înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, in locul pe care îl va alege DOMNUL Dumnezeu to place lui name acolo, the tithe of tău grâu, of tău vin, și of al tău ulei, și the firstlings of tău herds și of tău turme; că tu mayest a învăța to a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău always.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ירבה ממך הדרך כי לא תוכל שאתו כי ירחק ממך המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם כי יברכך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; [or] if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.romanian: și dacă the cale fi too long căci te, so că tu art nu able to carry it; [sau] dacă the place fi too far din te, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege to a așeza lui name acolo, când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt binecuvântat te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה בכסף וצרת הכסף בידך והלכת אל המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך בו
verses.english: Then shalt thou turn [it] into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:
verses.romanian: atunci shalt tu a se întoarce [it] into money, și bind up the money in al tău mână, și shalt a merge lui the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה הכסף בכל אשר תאוה נפשך בבקר ובצאן ביין ובשכר ובכל אשר תשאלך נפשך ואכלת שם לפני יהוה אלהיך ושמחת אתה וביתך
verses.english: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household
verses.romanian: și să bestow că money căci whatsoever tău suflet lusteth după, căci boi, sau căci oaie, sau căci vin, sau căci strong drink, sau căci whatsoever tău suflet desireth: și să eat acolo înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și să rejoice, tu, și al tău household

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלוי אשר בשעריך לא תעזבנו כי אין לו חלק ונחלה עמך
verses.english: And the Levite that [is] within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
verses.romanian: și the levit că [este] în tău porți; să nu forsake him; căci he sunt no part nor moștenire cu te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מקץ שלש שנים תוצא את כל מעשר תבואתך בשנה ההיא והנחתו בשעריך
verses.english: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay [it] up within thy gates:
verses.romanian: At the end of trei ani să a aduce forth toți the tithe of al tău increase the same an, și shalt lay [it] up în tău porți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא הלוי כי אין לו חלק ונחלה עמך והגר והיתום והאלמנה אשר בשעריך ואכלו ושבעו למען יברכך יהוה אלהיך בכל מעשה ידיך אשר תעשה
verses.english: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which [are] within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands which thou doest.
verses.romanian: și the levit, (pentru că he sunt no part nor moștenire cu te,) și the străin, și the fatherless, și the văduvă, care [sunt] în tău porți, va a veni, și va eat și fi satisfied; că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău poate bless te in toți the work of al tău mâini care tu doest.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מקץ שבע שנים תעשה שמטה
verses.english: At the end of [every] seven years thou shalt make a release.
verses.romanian: At the end of [fiecare] șapte ani să a face a release.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה דבר השמטה שמט כל בעל משא ידו אשר ישא ברעהו לא יגש את רעהו את אחיו כי קרא שמטה ליהוה
verses.english: And this [is] the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth [ought] unto his neighbour shall release [it]; he shall not exact [it] of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD's release.
verses.romanian: și this [este] the manner of the release: fiecare creditor că lendeth [ought] lui lui neighbour va release [it]; he va nu exact [it] of lui neighbour, sau of lui frate; pentru că it este a chemat DOMNUL's release.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את הנכרי תגש ואשר יהיה לך את אחיך תשמט ידך
verses.english: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact [it again]: but [that] which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
verses.romanian: Of a foreigner tu mayest exact [it again]: dar [că] care este al tău cu tău frate al tău mână va release;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אפס כי לא יהיה בך אביון כי ברוך יברכך יהוה אלהיך בארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך נחלה לרשתה
verses.english: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD God shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance to possess it:
verses.romanian: Save când acolo va fi no sărac între you; căci DOMNUL Dumnezeu va greatly bless te in the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te [căci] an moștenire to a stăpâni it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק אם שמע תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר לעשות את כל המצוה הזאת אשר אנכי מצוך היום
verses.english: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.romanian: numai dacă tu carefully hearken lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi și to a face toți these porunci care I command te this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהוה אלהיך ברכך כאשר דבר לך והעבטת גוים רבים ואתה לא תעבט ומשלת בגוים רבים ובך לא ימשלו
verses.english: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău blesseth te, as he promised te: și să lend lui many neamuri, dar să nu borrow; și să reign peste many neamuri, dar they va nu reign peste te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהיה בך אביון מאחד אחיך באחת שעריך בארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לא תאמץ את לבבך ולא תכפץ את ידך מאחיך האביון
verses.english: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:
verses.romanian: dacă acolo fi între you a sărac om of unu of tău brethren în vreun of tău porți in tău țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, să nu harden al tău inimă, nor shut al tău mână din tău sărac frate:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי פתח תפתח ידך לו העביט תעביטנו די מחסרו אשר יחסר לו
verses.english: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, [in that] which he wanteth.
verses.romanian: dar să open al tău mână wide lui him, și shalt negresit lend him sufficient căci lui need, [in că] care he wanteth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: השמר לך פן יהיה דבר עם לבבך בלעיל לאמר קרובה שנת השבעה שנת השמטה ורעה עינך באחיך האביון ולא תתן לו וקרא עליך אל יהוה והיה בך חטא
verses.english: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
verses.romanian: Beware că acolo fi nu a thought in tău wicked inimă, saying, The al șaptelea an, the an of release, este at mână; și al tău ochi fi evil împotriva tău sărac frate, și tu givest him nought; și he cry lui DOMNUL împotriva te, și it fi păcat lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נתן תתן לו ולא ירע בלבבך בתתך לו כי בגלל הדבר הזה יברכך יהוה אלהיך בכל מעשיך ובכל משלח ידיך
verses.english: Thou shalt surely give him, and in thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
verses.romanian: să negresit a da him, și in al tău inimă va nu fi grieved când tu givest lui him: pentru că că căci this thing DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va bless te in toți tău works, și in toți că tu puttest al tău mâini lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא יחדל האביון מקרב הארץ על כן אנכי מצוך לאמר פתח תפתח ידך לאחיך לעניך ולאביונך בארצך
verses.english: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
verses.romanian: căci the sărac va never cease out of the țară: de aceea I command te, saying, să open al tău mână wide lui tău frate, to tău sărac, și to tău needy, in tău țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ימכר לך אחיך העברי או העבריה ועבדך שש שנים ובשנה השביעית תשלחנו חפשי מעמך
verses.english: [And] if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
verses.romanian: [și] dacă tău frate, an Hebrew om, sau an Hebrew femeie, fi sold lui te, și a sluji te șase ani; atunci in the al șaptelea an să let him a merge free din te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תשלחנו חפשי מעמך לא תשלחנו ריקם
verses.english: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
verses.romanian: și când tu sendest him out free din te, să nu let him a merge away empty:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: העניק תעניק לו מצאנך ומגרנך ומיקבך כאשר ברכך יהוה אלהיך תתן לו
verses.english: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
verses.romanian: să furnish him liberally out of tău turmă, și out of tău floor, și out of tău winepress: of că wherewith DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt binecuvântat te să a da lui him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרת כי עבד היית בארץ מצרים ויפדך יהוה אלהיך על כן אנכי מצוך את הדבר הזה היום
verses.english: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
verses.romanian: și să adu-ți aminte că tu wast a bondman in the țara Egiptului, și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău redeemed te: de aceea I command te this thing to zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יאמר אליך לא אצא מעמך כי אהבך ואת ביתך כי טוב לו עמך
verses.english: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;
verses.romanian: și it va fi, dacă he a spune lui te, I va nu a merge away din te; pentru că he loveth te și al tău casă, pentru că he este well cu te;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחת את המרצע ונתתה באזנו ובדלת והיה לך עבד עולם ואף לאמתך תעשה כן
verses.english: Then thou shalt take an awl, and thrust [it] through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
verses.romanian: atunci să a lua an awl, și thrust [it] prin lui ureche lui the door, și he va fi tău slujitor căci ever. și de asemenea lui tău maidservant să a face likewise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יקשה בעיניך בשלחך אתו חפשי מעמך כי משנה שכר שכיר עבדך שש שנים וברכך יהוה אלהיך בכל אשר תעשה
verses.english: And it shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant [to thee], in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
verses.romanian: și it va nu seem hard lui te, când tu sendest him away free din te; căci he sunt been worth a double hired slujitor [to te], in serving te șase ani: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va bless te in toți că tu doest.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הבכור אשר יולד בבקרך ובצאנך הזכר תקדיש ליהוה אלהיך לא תעבד בבכור שורך ולא תגז את בכור צאנך
verses.english: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.
verses.romanian: toți the firstling males că a veni of tău cireadă și of tău turmă să sanctify lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: să a face no work cu the firstling of tău bullock, nor shear the firstling of tău oaie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לפני יהוה אלהיך תאכלנו שנה בשנה במקום אשר בחר יהוה אתה וביתך
verses.english: Thou shalt eat [it] before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
verses.romanian: să eat [it] înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău an by an in locul pe care DOMNUL va a alege, tu și tău household.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יהיה בו מום פסח או עור או כל מום רע לא תזבחנו ליהוה אלהיך
verses.english: And if there be [any] blemish therein, [as if it be] lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: și dacă acolo fi [vreun] blemish therein, [as dacă it fi] lame, sau blind, sau au vreun ill blemish, să nu sacrifice it lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בשעריך תאכלנו הטמא והטהור יחדו כצבי וכאיל
verses.english: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean [person shall eat it] alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
verses.romanian: să eat it în tău porți: the necurat și the curat [person va eat it] alike, as the roebuck, și as the hart.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק את דמו לא תאכל על הארץ תשפכנו כמים
verses.english: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
verses.romanian: numai să nu eat the blood thereof; să pour it upon the ground as apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שמור את חדש האביב ועשית פסח ליהוה אלהיך כי בחדש האביב הוציאך יהוה אלהיך ממצרים לילה
verses.english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.
verses.romanian: a păzi the lună of Abib, și a păzi the passover lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: căci in the lună of Abib DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău a adus te forth din Egipt by night.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזבחת פסח ליהוה אלהיך צאן ובקר במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם
verses.english: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD God of you shall choose to place his name there.
verses.romanian: să de aceea sacrifice the passover lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, of the turmă și the cireadă, in locul pe care DOMNUL Dumnezeu of să a alege to place lui name acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלו עליו חמץ שבעת ימים תאכלו עליו מצות לחם עני כי בחפזון יצאת מארץ מצרים למען תזכר את יום צאתך מארץ מצרים כל ימי חייך
verses.english: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, [even] the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.
verses.romanian: să eat no leavened pâine cu it; șapte zile shalt tu eat unleavened pâine therewith, [even] the pâine of affliction; căci tu camest forth out of the țara Egiptului in haste: că tu mayest a-și aduce aminte the zi când tu camest forth out of the țara Egiptului toți the zile of tău life.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יראה לך שאר בכל גבולך שבעת ימים ולא ילין מן הבשר אשר תזבח בין הערבים ביום הראישון לבקר
verses.english: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there [any thing] of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day between the even, remain all night until the morning.
verses.romanian: și acolo va fi no leavened pâine seen cu te in toți tău coast șapte zile; neither va acolo [vreun thing] of the flesh, care tu sacrificedst the întâi zi between the even, remain toți night until the morning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תוכל לזבח את הפסח באחת שעריך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך
verses.english: And thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:
verses.romanian: și tu mayest nu sacrifice the passover în vreun of tău porți, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם שם תזבח את הפסח בערב כבוא השמש מועד צאתך ממצרים
verses.english: But in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.
verses.romanian: dar in the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege to place lui name acolo, acolo să sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season că tu camest forth din Egipt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשלת ואכלת במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך בו ופנית בבקר והלכת לאהליך
verses.english: And thou shalt roast and eat [it] in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
verses.romanian: și să roast și eat [it] in the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege: și să a se întoarce in the morning, și a merge lui tău tents.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ששת ימים תאכל מצות וביום השביעי חג ליהוה אלהיך לא תעשה כל מלאכת עבדה
verses.english: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day [shall be] a celebration to the LORD thy God: thou shalt not do any work of service [therein].
verses.romanian: șase zile să eat unleavened pâine: și on the al șaptelea zi [va fi] a celebration to DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău: să nu a face vreun work of service [therein].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבעה שבעות תספר לך מהחלך חרמש בקמה תחל לספר שבעה שבעות
verses.english: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from [such time as] thou beginnest [to put] the sickle to the corn.
verses.romanian: șapte weeks shalt tu număr lui te: begin to număr the șapte weeks din [such time as] tu beginnest [to a pune] the sickle to the grâu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשית חג שבעות ליהוה אלהיך מסת נדבת ידיך אשר תתן כאשר ברכך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hands, which thou shalt give [unto the LORD thy God], according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.romanian: și să a păzi the feast of weeks lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu a tribute of a freewill offering of al tău mâini, care să a da [lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău], după cum DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt binecuvântat te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמחת לפני יהוה אלהיך אתה ובנך ובתך עבדך ואמתך והלוי אשר בשעריך והגר והיתום והאלמנה אשר בקרבך במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך לשכן את שמו שם
verses.english: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that [is] within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that [are] among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
verses.romanian: și să rejoice înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, tu, și tău fiu, și tău fiică, tău manservant, și tău maidservant, și the levit că [este] în tău porți, și the străin, și the fatherless, și the văduvă, că [sunt] între you, in the place care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales to place lui name acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרת כי עבד היית בארץ מצרים ושמרת ועשית את החקים האלה
verses.english: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in land of Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
verses.romanian: și să adu-ți aminte că tu wast a bondman in țara Egiptului: și să a păzi și a față these porunci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חג הסכות תעשה לך שבעת ימים באספך מגרנך ומיקבך
verses.english: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
verses.romanian: să a păzi the feast of tabernacles șapte zile, după că tu hast gathered in tău grâu și tău vin:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמחת בחגך אתה ובנך ובתך עבדך ואמתך והלוי והגר והיתום והאלמנה אשר בשעריך
verses.english: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that [are] within thy gates.
verses.romanian: și să rejoice in tău feast, tu, și tău fiu, și tău fiică, tău manservant, și tău maidservant, și the levit, the străin, și the fatherless, și the văduvă, că [sunt] în tău porți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבעת ימים תחג ליהוה אלהיך במקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך כי יברכך יהוה אלהיך בכל תבואתך ובכל מעשה ידיך והיית אך שמח
verses.english: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD God of you shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
verses.romanian: șapte zile shalt tu a păzi a solemn feast lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in locul pe care DOMNUL Dumnezeu of să a alege: pentru că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va bless te in toți al tău increase, și in toți the works of al tău mâini, de aceea să negresit rejoice.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שלש פעמים בשנה יראה כל זכורך את פני יהוה אלהיך במקום אשר בחר בו בחג המצות ובחג השבעות ובחג הסכות ולא יראו את פני יהוה רקים
verses.english: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:
verses.romanian: trei times in a an va toți tău males appear înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in locul pe care îl va alege; in the feast of unleavened pâine, și in the feast of weeks, și in the feast of tabernacles: și they va nu appear înainte DOMNUL empty:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש כמתנת ידו כברכת יהוה אלהיך אשר נתן לך
verses.english: Every man [shall give] as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
verses.romanian: fiecare om [va a da] as he este able, după the binecuvântare of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău care he sunt given te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שפטים ושטרים תתן לך בכל שעריך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לשבטיך ושפטו את העם משפט צדק
verses.english: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
verses.romanian: judecători și officers shalt tu a face te in toți tău porți, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, throughout tău seminții: și they va judecător the popor cu just judecată.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תטה משפט ולא תכיר פנים ולא תקח שחד כי השחד יעור עיני חכמים ויסלף דברי צדקים
verses.english: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; and thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
verses.romanian: să nu wrest judecată; și să nu respect persons, neither a lua a gift: căci a gift doth blind the ochi of the wise, și pervert cuvintele of the righteous.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צדק צדק תרדף למען תחיה וירשת את הארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך
verses.english: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.romanian: că care este altogether just shalt tu follow, că tu mayest a trăi, și a moșteni țara care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תטע לך אשרה כל עץ אצל מזבח יהוה אלהיך אשר תעשה לך
verses.english: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
verses.romanian: să nu plant te a grove of vreun copaci lângă lui the altar of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care să a face te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תקים לך מצבה אשר שנאה יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: Neither shalt thou set thee up [any] image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
verses.romanian: Neither shalt tu a așeza te up [vreun] chip; care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău hateth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תזבח ליהוה אלהיך שור ושה אשר יהיה בו מום כל דבר רע כי תועבת יהוה אלהיך הוא
verses.english: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God [any] bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, [or] any evilfavouredness: for that [is] an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: să nu sacrifice lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău [vreun] bullock, sau oaie, wherein este blemish, [sau] vreun evilfavouredness: căci că [este] an abomination lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ימצא בקרבך באחת שעריך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך איש או אשה אשר יעשה את הרע בעיני יהוה אלהיך לעבר בריתו
verses.english: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant
verses.romanian: dacă acolo fi found între you, în vreun of tău porți care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, om sau femeie, că sunt wrought wickedness in the sight of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, in transgressing lui legământ

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילך ויעבד אלהים אחרים וישתחוי להם ולשמש או לירח או לכל צבא השמים אשר לא צויתיו
verses.english: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
verses.romanian: și sunt gone și a slujit alți dumnezei, și worshipped them, either the sun, sau moon, sau vreun of the host of heaven, care I au nu commanded;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והגידו לך ושמעת ודרשת הייטב והנה אמת נכון הדבר נעשתה התועבה הזאת בישראל
verses.english: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard [of it], and inquired diligently, and, behold, [it be] true, [and] the thing certain, [that] such abomination is wrought in Israel:
verses.romanian: și it fi told te, și tu hast a auzit [of it], și inquired diligently, și, iată, [it fi] true, [și] the thing certain, [că] such abomination este wrought in Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוצאת את האיש ההוא או את האשה ההיא אשר עשו את הדבר הרע הזה אל שעריך את האיש או את האשה וסקלתם באבנים ומתו
verses.english: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, [even] that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
verses.romanian: atunci shalt tu a aduce forth că om sau că femeie, care au committed că wicked thing, lui tău porți, [even] că om sau că femeie, și shalt piatră them cu pietre, till they a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי שני עדים או על פי שלשה עדים יומת המת לא יומת על פי עד אחד
verses.english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; [but] at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
verses.romanian: At the gură of doi witnesses, sau at the gură of trei witnesses, va he că este worthy of death fi dat morții; [dar] at the gură of unu witness he va nu fi dat morții.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יד העדים תהיה בו בראישונה להמיתו ויד כל העם באחרנה ובערת הרע מקרבך
verses.english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
verses.romanian: The mâini of the witnesses va fi întâi upon him to a pune him to death, și afterward the mâini of toți the popor. So să a pune the evil away din între you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יפלא ממך דבר למשפט בין דם לדם ובין דין לדין ובין נגע לנגע דברי ריבות בשעריך וקמת ועלית אל המקום אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאת אל הכהנים הלוים ואל השופט אשר יהיה בימים ההם ודרשו והגידו לך את דבר המשפט
verses.english: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and inquire; and they shall show thee the sentence of judgment:
verses.romanian: și să a veni lui the preoți the leviți, și lui the judecător că va fi in those zile, și inquire; și they va show te the sentence of judecată:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשית על פי הדבר אשר יגידו לך מן המקום ההוא אשר בחר יהוה אלהיך ושמרת לעשות ככל אשר יורוך
verses.english: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD God of you shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
verses.romanian: și să a face după the sentence, care they of că place care DOMNUL Dumnezeu of să a alege va shew te; și să a păzi to a face după toți că they inform te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי התורה אשר יורוך ועל פי המשפט אשר יאמרו לך תעשה ולא תסור מן הדבר אשר יגידו לך ימין ושמאל
verses.english: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the mouth of judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: and thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, [to] the right hand, nor [to] the left.
verses.romanian: după the sentence of the lege care they va a învăța te, și după the gură of judecată care they va tell te, să a face: și să nu decline din the sentence care they va shew te, [to] the right mână, nor [to] the left.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאיש אשר יעשה בזדון לבלתי שמע אל הכהן העמד לשרת שם את יהוה אלהיך או אל השופט ומת האיש ההוא ובערת הרע מישראל
verses.english: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.
verses.romanian: și the om că va a face presumptuously, și va nu hearken lui the preot că standeth to minister acolo înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, sau lui the judecător, even că om va a muri: și să a pune away the evil din Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל העם ישמעו וייראו ולא יזידו עוד
verses.english: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
verses.romanian: și toți the popor va a auzi, și a se teme, și a face no more presumptuously.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תבוא אל הארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך וירשת וישבת בה ואמרת אשימה עלי מלך ככל הגוים אשר סביבתי
verses.english: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that [are] about me;
verses.romanian: când tu art a veni lui the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, și shalt a stăpâni it, și shalt dwell therein, și shalt a spune, I va a așeza a rege peste me, like as toți the neamuri că [sunt] about me;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שים תשים עליך מלך אשר יבחר יהוה אלהיך בו מקרב אחיך תשים עליך מלך לא תוכל לתת עליך איש נכרי אשר לא אחיך הוא
verses.english: Thou shalt in any wise set [him] king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: [one] from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which [is] not thy brother.
verses.romanian: să in vreun wise a așeza [him] rege peste te, pe care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a alege: [unu] din între tău brethren shalt tu a așeza rege peste te: tu mayest nu a așeza a străin peste te, care [este] nu tău frate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: רק לא ירבה לו סוסים ולא ישיב את העם מצרימה למען הרבות סוס ויהוה האמר לכם לא תוסיפון לשוב בדרך הזה עוד
verses.english: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.
verses.romanian: dar he va nu multiply horses to însuși, nor cause the popor to return to Egypt, to the end că he trebuie să multiply horses: forasmuch as DOMNUL sunt a spus lui you, voi va henceforth return no more că cale.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא ירבה לו נשים ולא יסור לבבו וכסף וזהב לא ירבה לו מאד
verses.english: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
verses.romanian: Neither va he multiply wives to însuși, că lui inimă a se întoarce nu away: neither va he greatly multiply to însuși argint și aur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כשבתו על כסא ממלכתו וכתב לו את משנה התורה הזאת על ספר מלפני הכהנים הלוים
verses.english: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of [that which is] before the priests the Levites:
verses.romanian: și it va fi, când he sitteth upon the throne of lui kingdom, că he va a scrie him a copy of this lege in a book out of [că care este] înainte the preoți the leviți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה עמו וקרא בה כל ימי חייו למען ילמד ליראה את יהוה אלהיו לשמר את כל דברי התורה הזאת ואת החקים האלה לעשותם
verses.english: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
verses.romanian: și it va fi cu him, și he va a citi therein toți the zile of lui life: că he poate a învăța to a se teme DOMNUL lui Dumnezeu, to a păzi toți cuvintele of this lege și these porunci, to a face them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבלתי רם לבבו מאחיו ולבלתי סר מן המצוה ימין ושמאל למען יאריך ימים על כסא ממלכתו הוא ובניו בקרב ישראל
verses.english: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, [to] the right hand, or [to] the left: to the end that he may prolong [his] days over throne of his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.
verses.romanian: că lui inimă fi nu lifted up deasupra lui brethren, și că he să nu te abați din the poruncă, [to] the right mână, sau [to] the left: to the end că he poate prolong [lui] zile peste throne of lui kingdom, he, și lui copii, in the midst of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יהיה לכהנים הלוים כל שבט לוי חלק ונחלה עם ישראל אשי יהוה ונחלתו יאכלון
verses.english: The priests the Levites, [and] all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.
verses.romanian: The preoți the leviți, [și] toți the seminție of Levi, va au no part nor moștenire cu Israel: they va eat the offerings of DOMNUL a făcut by foc, și lui moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונחלה לא יהיה לו בקרב אחיו יהוה הוא נחלתו כאשר דבר לו
verses.english: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD [is] their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.
verses.romanian: de aceea va they au no moștenire între lor brethren: DOMNUL [este] lor moștenire, as he sunt a spus lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה יהיה משפט הכהנים מאת העם מאת זבחי הזבח אם שור אם שה ונתן לכהן הזרוע והלחים והקבה
verses.english: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether [it be] ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
verses.romanian: și this va fi the preot's due din the popor, din them că offer a sacrifice, whether [it fi] bou sau oaie; și they va a da lui the preot the shoulder, și the doi cheeks, și the maw.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראשית דגנך תירשך ויצהרך וראשית גז צאנך תתן לו
verses.english: The firstfruit [also] of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
verses.romanian: The firstfruit [de asemenea] of tău grâu, of tău vin, și of al tău ulei, și the întâi of the fleece of tău oaie, shalt tu a da him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי בו בחר יהוה אלהיך מכל שבטיך לעמד לפני יהוה אלהיך לשרתו ולברך בשמו הוא ובניו כל הימים
verses.english: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister before the LORD God of you and to minister and to bless in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt ales him out of toți tău seminții, to a sta to minister înainte DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you și to minister și to bless in the name of DOMNUL, him și lui fii căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יבוא הלוי מאחת שעריך מכל ישראל אשר הוא גר שם ובא בכל אות נפשו אל המקום אשר בחר יהוה
verses.english: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;
verses.romanian: și dacă a levit a veni din vreun of tău porți out of toți Israel, where he sojourned, și a veni cu toți the desire of lui mind lui locul pe care DOMNUL va a alege;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושרת בשם יהוה אלהיו ככל אחיו הלוים העמדים שם לפני יהוה
verses.english: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites [do], which stand there before the LORD.
verses.romanian: atunci he va minister in the name of DOMNUL lui Dumnezeu, as toți lui brethren the leviți [a face], care a sta acolo înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חלק כחלק יאכל לבד ממכרו על האבות
verses.english: They shall have like portions to eat, and beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
verses.romanian: They va au like portions to eat, și beside că care cometh of the sale of lui patrimony.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אתה בא אל הארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לא תלמד לעשות כתועבות הגוים ההם
verses.english: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
verses.romanian: când tu art a veni into the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, să nu a învăța to a face după the abominations of those neamuri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא ימצא בך מעביר בנו ובתו באש קסם קסמים מענן מנחש מכשף
verses.english: There shall not be found among you [any one] that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, [or] that useth divination, [or] an observer of times, an enchanter, a witch
verses.romanian: acolo va nu fi found între you [vreun unu] că maketh lui fiu sau lui fiică to a trece prin the foc, [sau] că useth divination, [sau] an observer of times, an enchanter, a witch

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חבר חבר שאל אוב או ידעוני ודרש אל המתים
verses.english: A charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, a wizard, or a necromancer.
verses.romanian: A charmer, sau a consulter cu familiar duhuri, a wizard, sau a necromancer.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תועבת יהוה אלהיך כל עשה אלה ובגלל התועבות האלה יהוה אלהיך מורישם מפניך
verses.english: For all that do these things [are] an abomination unto the LORD God of you: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.romanian: căci toți că a face these things [sunt] an abomination lui DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you: și pentru că of these abominations DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău doth a-i alunga din înainte te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תמים תהיה עם יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: să fi perfect cu DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי הגוים האלה אשר אתם ירשים אתם אל המעננים ואל הקסמים ישמעו ואתה לא כן נתן לך יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so [to do].
verses.romanian: căci these neamuri, care să a stăpâni, hearkened lui observers of times, și lui diviners: dar as căci te, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt nu suffered te so [to a face].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נביא מקרב אחיך כמוני יקים לך יהוה אלהיך אליו תשמעון
verses.english: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
verses.romanian: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va raise up lui te a Prophet din the midst of te, of tău brethren, like lui me; lui him voi va hearken;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ככל אשר שאלת מעם יהוה אלהיך בחורב ביום הקהל לאמר לא אוסיף לשמע את קול יהוה אלהי ואת אשו הגדלה הזאת לא אראה עוד ולא אמות
verses.english: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
verses.romanian: după toți că tu desiredst of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in Horeb in the zi of the adunare, saying, Let me nu a auzi again the voice of DOMNUL meu Dumnezeu, neither let me a vedea this great foc vreun more, că I a muri nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אלי הטיבו אשר דברו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto me, They have well [spoken that] which they have spoken.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui me, They au well [spoken că] care they au spoken.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נביא אקים להם מקרב אחיהם כמוך ונתתי דברי בפיו ודבר אליהם את כל אשר אצונו
verses.english: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
verses.romanian: I va raise them up a Prophet din între lor brethren, like lui te, și va a pune meu cuvinte in lui gură; și he va a vorbi lui them toți că I va command him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה האיש אשר לא ישמע אל דבריו אשר ידבר בשמי אנכי אדרש מעמו
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, [that] whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require [it] of him.
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, [că] whosoever va nu hearken lui meu cuvinte care he va a vorbi in meu name, I va require [it] of him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך הנביא אשר יזיד לדבר דבר בשמי את אשר לא צויתיו לדבר ואשר ידבר בשם אלהים אחרים ומת הנביא ההוא
verses.english: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
verses.romanian: dar the prophet, care va presume to a vorbi a cuvânt in meu name, care I au nu commanded him to a vorbi, sau că va a vorbi in the name of alți dumnezei, even că prophet va a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תאמר בלבבך איך נודע את הדבר אשר לא דברו יהוה
verses.english: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
verses.romanian: și dacă tu a spune in al tău inimă, cum va we a cunoaște the cuvânt care DOMNUL sunt nu spoken?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר ידבר הנביא בשם יהוה לא יהיה הדבר ולא יבוא הוא הדבר אשר לא דברו יהוה בזדון דברו הנביא לא תגור ממנו
verses.english: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that [is] the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, [but] the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
verses.romanian: când a prophet speaketh in the name of DOMNUL, dacă the thing follow nu, nor a veni to a trece, că [este] the thing care DOMNUL sunt nu spoken, [dar] the prophet sunt spoken it presumptuously: să nu fi afraid of him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יכרית יהוה אלהיך את הגוים אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך את ארצם וירשתם וישבת בעריהם ובבתיהם
verses.english: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
verses.romanian: când DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt nimicit the neamuri, al cărui țară DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te, și tu succeedest them, și dwellest in lor cetăți, și in lor case;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שלש ערים תבדיל לך בתוך ארצך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לרשתה
verses.english: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.romanian: să separate trei cetăți căci te in the midst of tău țară, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תכן לך הדרך ושלשת את גבול ארצך אשר ינחילך יהוה אלהיך והיה לנוס שמה כל רצח
verses.english: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
verses.romanian: să prepare te a cale, și divide the coasts of tău țară, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te to a moșteni, into trei parts, că fiecare slayer poate flee thither.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה דבר הרצח אשר ינוס שמה וחי אשר יכה את רעהו בבלי דעת והוא לא שנא לו מתמול שלשום
verses.english: And this [is] the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
verses.romanian: și this [este] the case of the slayer, care va flee thither, că he poate a trăi: Whoso killeth lui neighbour ignorantly, pe care he hated nu in time past;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשר יבוא את רעהו ביער לחטב עצים ונדח ידו בגרזן לכרת העץ ונשל הברזל מן העץ ומצא את רעהו ומת הוא ינוס אל אחת מן הערים האלה וחי
verses.english: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
verses.romanian: As când a om merge into the lemn cu lui neighbour to hew lemn, și lui mână fetcheth a lovitură cu the axe to a doborî the copac, și the cap slippeth din the helve, și lighteth upon lui neighbour, că he a muri; he va flee lui unu of those cetăți, și a trăi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פן ירדף גאל הדם אחרי הרצח כי יחם לבבו והשיגו כי ירבה הדרך והכהו נפש ולו אין משפט מות כי לא שנא הוא לו מתמול שלשום
verses.english: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he [was] not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.
verses.romanian: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, în timp ce lui inimă este hot, și overtake him, pentru că the cale este long, și a ucide him; whereas he [era] nu worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him nu in time past.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על כן אנכי מצוך לאמר שלש ערים תבדיל לך
verses.english: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.
verses.romanian: de aceea I command te, saying, să separate trei cetăți căci te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם ירחיב יהוה אלהיך את גבולך כאשר נשבע לאבתיך ונתן לך את כל הארץ אשר דבר לתת לאבתיך
verses.english: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;
verses.romanian: și dacă DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău enlarge tău coast, as he sunt sworn lui tău părinți, și a da te toți the țară care he promised to a da lui tău părinți;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תשמר את כל המצוה הזאת לעשותה אשר אנכי מצוך היום לאהבה את יהוה אלהיך ללכת בדרכיו כל הימים ויספת לך עוד שלש ערים על השלש האלה
verses.english: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:
verses.romanian: dacă să a păzi toți these porunci to a face them, care I command te this zi, to a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și to a umbla ever in lui căi; atunci shalt tu add trei cetăți more căci te, beside these trei:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא ישפך דם נקיא בקרב ארצך אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך נחלה והיה עליך דמים
verses.english: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance, and [so] blood be upon thee.
verses.romanian: că innocent blood fi nu shed in tău țară, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te [căci] an moștenire, și [so] blood fi upon te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יהיה איש שנא לרעהו וארב לו וקם עליו והכהו נפש ומת ונס אל אחת מן הערים האלה
verses.english: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
verses.romanian: dar dacă vreun om hate lui neighbour, și lie in wait căci him, și a se ridica up împotriva him, și a lovi him mortally că he a muri, și fleeth into unu of these cetăți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושלחו זקני עירו ולקחו אתו משם ונתנו אתו ביד גאל הדם והומת
verses.english: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
verses.romanian: atunci the elders of lui cetate va send și fetch him thence, și deliver him into the mână of the avenger of blood, că he poate a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תחוס עינך עליו ובערת הדם הנקיא מישראל וטוב לך
verses.english: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away [the guilt of] innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
verses.romanian: al tău ochi va nu pity him, dar să a pune away [the vină of] innocent blood din Israel, că it poate a merge well cu te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תסיג גבול רעך אשר גבלו ראישונים בנחלתך אשר תנחל בארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך לרשתה
verses.english: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
verses.romanian: să nu remove tău neighbour's landmark, care they of old time au a așeza in al tău moștenire, care să a moșteni in the țară că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יקום עד אחד באיש לכל עון ולכל חטא בכל חטא אשר יחטא על פי שני עדים או על פי שלשה עדים יקום דבר
verses.english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
verses.romanian: unu witness va nu a se ridica up împotriva a om căci vreun nelegiuire, sau căci vreun păcat, in vreun păcat că he sinneth: at the gură of doi witnesses, sau at the gură of trei witnesses, va the matter fi established.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יקום עד חמס באיש לענות בו סרה
verses.english: And if a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him [that which is] wrong;
verses.romanian: și dacă a false witness a se ridica up împotriva vreun om to testify împotriva him [că care este] wrong;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועמדו שני האנשים אשר להם הריב לפני יהוה לפני הכהנים והשפטים אשר יהיה בימים ההם
