verses.english: Cursed [be] he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.romanian: blestemat [fi] he că smiteth lui neighbour secretly. și toți the popor va a spune, Amen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור לקח שחד להכות נפש דם נקיא ואמרו כל העם אמן
verses.english: Cursed [be] he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.romanian: blestemat [fi] he că taketh reward to a ucide an innocent person. și toți the popor va a spune, Amen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור אשר לא יקים את כל דברי התורה הזאת לעשותם ואמרו כל העם אמן
verses.english: Cursed [be] he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.romanian: blestemat [fi] he că confirmeth nu toți cuvintele of this lege to a face them. și toți the popor va a spune, Amen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אם שמע תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר לעשות את כל מצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום ונתנך יהוה אלהיך עליון על כל גוי הארץ
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe [and] to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, dacă să hearken diligently lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi [și] to a face toți lui porunci care I command te this zi, că DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a așeza te on high deasupra toți neamuri of the pământ:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאו עליך כל הברכות האלה והשיגוך כי תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: și toți these binecuvântări va a veni on te, și overtake te, dacă să hearken lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברוך אתה בעיר וברוך אתה בשדה
verses.english: Blessed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and blessed [shalt] thou [be] in the field.
verses.romanian: binecuvântat [shalt] tu [fi] in the cetate, și binecuvântat [shalt] tu [fi] in the câmp.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברוך פרי בטנך ופרי אדמתך ופרי בהמתך שגר אלפיך ועשתרות צאנך
verses.english: Blessed [shall be] the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.romanian: binecuvântat [va fi] the rod of tău body, și the rod of tău ground, și the rod of tău vite, the increase of tău kine, și the turme of tău oaie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברוך טנאך ומשארתך
verses.english: Blessed [shall be] thy basket and thy store.
verses.romanian: binecuvântat [va fi] tău basket și tău store.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברוך אתה בבאך וברוך אתה בצאתך
verses.english: Blessed [shalt] thou [be] when thou comest in, and blessed [shalt] thou [be] when thou goest out.
verses.romanian: binecuvântat [shalt] tu [fi] când tu comest in, și binecuvântat [shalt] tu [fi] când tu goest out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יתן יהוה את איביך הקמים עליך נגפים לפניך בדרך אחת יצאו אליך ובשבעה דרכים ינוסו לפניך
verses.english: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va cause al tău enemies că a se ridica up împotriva te to fi smitten înainte tău față: they va a ieși împotriva te unu cale, și flee înainte te șapte căi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יצוה יהוה אתך את הברכה באסימך ובכל משלח ידיך וברכך בארץ אשר יהוה אלהיך נתן לך
verses.english: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hands unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va command the binecuvântare upon te in tău storehouses, și in toți că tu settest al tău mâini lui; și he va bless te in the țară care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău giveth te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יקימך יהוה לו לעם קדש כאשר נשבע לך כי תשמר את מצות יהוה אלהיך והלכת בדרכיו
verses.english: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va establish te an sfânt popor lui însuși, as he sunt sworn lui te, dacă să a păzi poruncile of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și a umbla in lui căi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראו כל עמי הארץ כי שם יהוה נקרא עליך וייראו ממך
verses.english: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.romanian: și toți popor of the pământ va a vedea că tu art a chemat by the name of DOMNUL; și they va fi afraid of te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והותירך יהוה לטוב בפרי בטנך ובפרי בהמתך ובפרי אדמתך על האדמה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיך לתת לך
verses.english: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va a face te plenteous in goods, in the rod of tău body, și in the rod of tău vite, și in the rod of tău ground, in țara pe care DOMNUL sware lui tău părinți to a da te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יפתח יהוה לך את אוצרו הטוב את השמים לתת את מטר ארצך בעתו לברך את כל מעשה ידיך והלוית גוים רבים ואתה לא תלוה
verses.english: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hands: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va open lui te lui good treasure, the heaven to a da the rain lui tău țară in lui season, și to bless toți the work of al tău mâini: și să lend lui many neamuri, și să nu borrow.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנך יהוה לראש ולא לזנב והיית רק למעלה ולא תהיה למטה כי תשמע אל מצות יהוה אלהיך אשר אנכי מצוך היום לשמר ולעשות
verses.english: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do [them]:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va a face te the cap, și nu the tail; și să fi deasupra numai, și să nu fi beneath; dacă că tu hearken lui the porunci of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, care I command te this zi, to a păzi și to a face [them]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תסור מכל הדברים אשר אנכי מצוך היום ימין ושמאל ללכת אחרי אלהים אחרים לעבדם
verses.english: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, [to] the right hand, or [to] the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.romanian: și să nu a merge aside din vreun of cuvintele care I command te this zi, [to] the right mână, sau [to] the left, to a merge după alți dumnezei to a sluji them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אם לא תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר מצותיו וחקתיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום ובאו עליך כל הקללות האלה והשיגוך
verses.english: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.romanian: dar it va a veni to a trece, dacă tu wilt nu hearken lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi to a face toți lui porunci și lui porunci care I command te this zi; că toți these curses va a veni upon te, și overtake te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור אתה בעיר וארור אתה בשדה
verses.english: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the field.
verses.romanian: blestemat [shalt] tu [fi] in the cetate, și blestemat [shalt] tu [fi] in the câmp.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור טנאך ומשארתך
verses.english: Cursed [shall be] thy basket and thy store.
verses.romanian: blestemat [va fi] tău basket și tău store.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור פרי בטנך ופרי אדמתך ופרי בהמתך שגר אלפיך ועשתרות צאנך
verses.english: Cursed [shall be] the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, and fruit of thy animals, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.romanian: blestemat [va fi] the rod of tău body, și the rod of tău țară, și rod of tău animals, the increase of tău kine, și the turme of tău oaie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ארור אתה בבאך וארור אתה בצאתך
verses.english: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou comest in, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou goest out.
verses.romanian: blestemat [shalt] tu [fi] când tu comest in, și blestemat [shalt] tu [fi] când tu goest out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ישלח יהוה בך את המרה ואת המהמה ואת המגערת בכל משלח ידיך אשר תעשה עד השמידך ועד אבידך מהר מפני רע מעלליך אשר עזבתני
verses.english: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hands unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va send upon te cursing, vexation, și rebuke, in toți că tu settest al tău mâini lui căci to a face, until tu fi a nimicit, și until tu perish quickly; pentru că of the wickedness of tău doings, whereby tu hast forsaken me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ידבק יהוה בך את הדבר עד כלותו אתך מעל האדמה אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה
verses.english: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a face the pestilence cleave lui te, until he au consumed te din off the țară, whither tu goest to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יכך יהוה בשחפת ובקדחת ובדלקת ובחרחר ובחרב ובשדפון ובירקון ירדפוך עד אבידוך
verses.english: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a lovi te cu a consumption, și cu a fever, și cu an inflammation, și cu an extreme burning, și cu the sword, și cu blasting, și cu mildew; they va pursue te until tu perish.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו שמיך אשר על ראשך נחשת והארץ אשר תחתיך ברזל
verses.english: And thy heaven that [is] over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee [shall be] iron.
verses.romanian: și tău heaven că [este] peste tău cap va fi brass, și the pământ că este sub te [va fi] fier.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יתן יהוה את מטר ארצך אבק ועפר מן השמים ירד עליך עד השמידך
verses.english: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a face the rain of tău țară powder și dust: din heaven va it a veni down upon te, until tu fi a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יתנך יהוה נגף לפני איביך בדרך אחת תצא אליו ובשבעה דרכים תנוס לפניו והיית לזועה לכל ממלכת הארץ
verses.english: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va cause te to fi smitten înainte al tău enemies: să a ieși unu cale împotriva them, și flee șapte căi înainte them: și shalt fi removed into toți the kingdoms of the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה נבלתך למאכל לעוף השמים ולבהמת הארץ ואין מחריד
verses.english: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray [them] away.
verses.romanian: și tău carcase va fi carne lui toți fowls of the air, și lui the beasts of the pământ, și no om va fray [them] away.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יכך יהוה בשחין מצרים ובעפלים ובגרב ובחרס אשר לא תוכל להרפא
verses.english: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a lovi te cu the botch of Egypt, și cu the emerods, și cu the scab, și cu the itch, whereof tu canst nu fi healed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יכך יהוה בשגעון ובעורון ובתמהון לבב
verses.english: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a lovi te cu madness, și blindness, și astonishment of inimă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיית ממשש בצהרים כאשר ימשש העור באפלה ולא תצליח דרכך והיית רק עשוק וגזול כל הימים ואין מושיע
verses.english: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and surely thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save [thee].
verses.romanian: și să grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, și să nu prosper in tău căi: și negresit să fi numai oppressed și spoiled evermore, și no om va save [te].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשה תארש ואיש אחר ישכב עמה בית תבנה ולא תשב בו כרם תטע ולא תחללנו
verses.english: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.romanian: să betroth a wife, și another om va lie cu ei: să a construi an casă, și să nu dwell therein: să plant a vineyard, și shalt nu gather the grapes thereof.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שורך טבוח לעיניך ולא תאכל ממנו חמורך גזול מלפניך ולא ישוב לך צאנך נתנות לאיביך ואין לך מושיע
verses.english: Thine ox [shall be] slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass [shall be] violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep [shall be] given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue [them].
verses.romanian: al tău bou [va fi] ucis înainte al tău ochi, și să nu eat thereof: al tău ass [va fi] violently taken away din înainte tău față, și va nu fi restored to te: tău oaie [va fi] given lui al tău enemies, și să au niciun to rescue [them].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בניך ובנתיך נתנים לעם אחר ועיניך ראות וכלות אליהם כל היום ואין לאל ידך
verses.english: Thy sons and thy daughters [shall be] given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail [with longing] for them all the day long: and [there shall be] no might in thine hand.
verses.romanian: tău fii și tău fiice [va fi] given lui another popor, și al tău ochi va a privi, și fail [cu longing] căci them toți the zi long: și [acolo va fi] no ar putea in al tău mână.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פרי אדמתך וכל יגעך יאכל עם אשר לא ידעת והיית רק עשוק ורצוץ כל הימים
verses.english: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed always:
verses.romanian: The rod of tău țară, și toți tău labours, va a neam care tu knowest nu eat up; și să fi numai oppressed și crushed always:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיית משגע ממראה עיניך אשר תראה
verses.english: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.romanian: So că să fi mad căci the sight of al tău ochi care să a vedea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יכך יהוה בשחין רע על הברכים ועל השקים אשר לא תוכל להרפא מכף רגלך ועד קדקדך
verses.english: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a lovi te in the knees, și in the legs, cu a sore botch că nu poate fi healed, din the sole of tău picior lui the top of tău cap.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יוליך יהוה אתך ואת מלכך אשר תקים עליך אל גוי אשר לא ידעת אתה ואבתיך ועבדת שם אלהים אחרים עץ ואבן
verses.english: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a aduce te, și tău rege care să a așeza peste te, lui a neam care neither tu nor tău părinți au known; și acolo shalt tu a sluji altor dumnezei, lemn și piatră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיית לשם ולמשל ולשנינה בכל העמים אשר ינהגך יהוה שמה
verses.english: And thou shalt become an astonishment, and a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.romanian: și să become an astonishment, și a proverb, și a byword, între toți neamuri whither DOMNUL va lead te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זרע רב תוצא השדה ומעט תאסף כי יחסלנו הארבה
verses.english: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather [but] little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.romanian: să carry much sămânță out into the câmp, și shalt gather [dar] little in; căci the locust va consume it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כרמים תטע ועבדת ויין לא תשתה ולא תאגר כי תאכלנו התולעת
verses.english: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress [them], but shalt neither drink [of] the wine, nor gather [the grapes]; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.romanian: să plant vineyards, și dress [them], dar shalt neither drink [of] the vin, nor gather [the grapes]; căci the worms va eat them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זיתים יהיו לך בכל גבולך ושמן לא תסך כי ישעל זיתיך
verses.english: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint [thyself] with the oil; for thine olive shall cast [his fruit].
verses.romanian: să au olive copaci throughout toți tău coasts, dar să nu anoint [thyself] cu the ulei; căci al tău olive va cast [lui rod].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בנים ובנות תוליד ולא יהיו לך כי ילכו בשבי
verses.english: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.romanian: să beget fii și fiice, dar să nu enjoy them; căci they va a merge into captivity.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל עצך ופרי אדמתך יוריש הצלצל
verses.english: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.romanian: toți tău copaci și rod of tău țară va the locust consume.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הגר אשר בקרבך יעלה עליך מעלה מעלה ואתה תרד מטה מטה
verses.english: The stranger that [is] within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.romanian: The străin că [este] în te va get up deasupra te foarte high; și să a veni down foarte low.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הוא ילוך ואתה לא תלונו הוא יהיה לראש ואתה תהיה לזנב
verses.english: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.romanian: He va lend to te, și să nu lend to him: he va fi the cap, și să fi the tail.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאו עליך כל הקללות האלה ורדפוך והשיגוך עד השמידוך כי לא שמעת בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר מצותיו וחקתיו אשר צוך
verses.english: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.romanian: Moreover toți these curses va a veni upon te, și va pursue te, și overtake te, till tu fi a nimicit; pentru că tu hearkenedst nu lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi lui porunci și lui porunci care he commanded te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו בך לאות ולמופת ובזרעך עד עולם
verses.english: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.romanian: și they va fi upon te căci a sign și căci a wonder, și upon tău sămânță căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תחת אשר לא עבדת את יהוה אלהיך בשמחה ובטוב לבב מרב כל
verses.english: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all [things];
verses.romanian: pentru că tu servedst nu DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu joyfulness, și cu gladness of inimă, căci the abundance of toți [things];

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבדת את איביך אשר ישלחנו יהוה בך ברעב ובצמא ובערום ובחסר כל ונתן עול ברזל על צוארך עד השמידו אתך
verses.english: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all [things]: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.romanian: de aceea shalt tu a sluji al tău enemies care DOMNUL va send împotriva te, in hunger, și in thirst, și in nakedness, și in want of toți [things]: și he va a pune a yoke of fier upon tău neck, until he au a nimicit te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ישא יהוה עליך גוי מרחק מקצה הארץ כאשר יראה הנשר גוי אשר לא תשמע לשנו
verses.english: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, [as swift] as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va a aduce a neam împotriva te din far, din the end of the pământ, [as swift] as the vultur flieth; a neam al cărui tongue să nu understand;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: גוי עז פנים אשר לא ישא פנים לזקן ונער לא יחן
verses.english: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.romanian: A neam of fierce countenance, care va nu regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכל פרי בהמתך ופרי אדמתך עד השמידך אשר לא ישאיר לך דגן ותירש ויצהר שגר אלפיך ועשתרות צאנך עד אבידו אתך
verses.english: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which [also] shall not leave thee [either] corn, and wine, or oil, [or] the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.romanian: și he va eat the rod of tău vite, și the rod of tău țară, until tu fi a nimicit: care [de asemenea] va nu leave te [either] grâu, și vin, sau ulei, [sau] the increase of tău kine, sau turme of tău oaie, until he au a nimicit te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והצר לך בכל שעריך עד רדת חומתך הגבחות והבצרות אשר אתה בטח בהן בכל ארצך והצר לך בכל שעריך בכל ארצך אשר נתן יהוה אלהיך לך
verses.english: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.romanian: și he va besiege te in toți tău porți, until tău high și fenced walls a veni down, wherein tu trustedst, throughout toți tău țară: și he va besiege te in toți tău porți throughout toți tău țară, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt given te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלת פרי בטנך בשר בניך ובנתיך אשר נתן לך במצור ובמצוק אשר יציק לך איביך
verses.english: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.romanian: și să eat the rod of al tău own body, the flesh of tău fii și of tău fiice, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt given te, in the siege, și in the straitness, wherewith al tău enemies va distress te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האיש הרך בך והענג מאד תרע עינו באחיו ובאשת חיקו וביתר בניו אשר יותר
verses.english: [So that] the man [that is] tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.romanian: [So că] the om [că este] tender între you, și foarte delicate, lui ochi va fi evil toward lui frate, și toward the wife of lui bosom, și toward the remnant of lui copii care he va leave:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מתת לאחד מהם מבשר בניו אשר יאכל מבלי השאיר לו כל במצור ובמצוק אשר יציק לך איביך בכל שעריך
verses.english: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.romanian: So că he va nu a da to vreun of them of the flesh of lui copii pe care he va eat: pentru că he sunt nimic left him in the siege, și in the straitness, wherewith al tău enemies va distress te in toți tău porți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הרכה בך והענגה אשר לא נסתה כף רגלה הציגה על הארץ מהתענג ומרך תרע עינה באיש חיקה בבנה ובבתה
verses.english: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, toward her son, and toward her daughter
verses.romanian: The tender și delicate femeie între you, care ar nu adventure to a așeza the sole of ei picior upon the ground căci delicateness și tenderness, ei ochi va fi evil toward the husband of ei bosom, toward ei fiu, și toward ei fiică

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשלתה היצאת מבין רגליה ובבניה אשר תלד כי תאכלם בחסר כל בסתר במצור ובמצוק אשר יציקו לך איביך בשעריך
verses.english: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all [things] secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.romanian: și toward ei young unu că cometh out din between ei picioare, și toward ei copii care she va bear: căci she va eat them căci want of toți [things] secretly in the siege și straitness, wherewith al tău enemies va distress te in tău porți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם לא תשמר לעשות את כל דברי התורה הזאת הכתובים בספר הזה ליראה את השם הנכבד והנורא הזה את יהוה אלהיך
verses.english: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.romanian: dacă tu wilt nu a păzi to a face toți cuvintele of this lege că sunt written in this book, că tu mayest a se teme this glorious și fearful name, DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והפלא יהוה אלהיך את מכותך ואת מכות זרעך מכות גדלות ונאמנות וחלים רעים ונאמנים
verses.english: Then the LORD God of you will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, [even] great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.romanian: atunci DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you va a face tău plagues wonderful, și the plagues of tău sămânță, [even] great plagues, și of long continuance, și sore sicknesses, și of long continuance.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשיב בך את כל מדוי מצרים אשר יגרת מפניהם ודבק בך
verses.english: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.romanian: Moreover he va a aduce upon te toți the diseases of Egypt, care tu wast afraid of; și they va cleave lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: גם כל חלי וכל מכה אשר לא כתוב בספר התורה הזה יעלם יהוה עליך עד השמידך
verses.english: Also every sickness, and every plague, which [is] not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.romanian: de asemenea fiecare sickness, și fiecare plague, care [este] nu written in the book of this lege, them va DOMNUL a aduce upon te, until tu fi a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשארתם במתי מעט תחת אשר הייתם ככוכבי השמים לרב כי לא שמעתם בקול יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.romanian: și voi va fi left few in număr, whereas voi erau as the stars of heaven căci multitude; pentru că tu wouldest nu a asculta the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כאשר שש יהוה עליכם להטיב אתכם ולהרבות אתכם כן ישש יהוה עליכם להאביד אתכם ולהשמיד אתכם ונסחתם מעל האדמה אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, [that] as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, [că] as DOMNUL rejoiced peste you to a face you good, și to multiply you; so DOMNUL va rejoice peste you to a nimici you, și to a aduce you to nought; și voi va fi plucked din off the țară whither tu goest to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והפיצך יהוה בכל העמים מקצה הארץ ועד קצה הארץ ועבדת שם אלהים אחרים אשר לא ידעת אתה ואבתיך עץ ואבן
verses.english: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, [even] wood and stone.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va scatter te între toți popor, din the unu end of the pământ even lui the other; și acolo să a sluji altor dumnezei, care neither tu nor tău părinți au known, [even] lemn și piatră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובגוים ההם לא תרגיע ולא יהיה מנוח לכף רגלך ונתן יהוה לך שם לב רגז כליון עינים ודיבון נפש
verses.english: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.romanian: și între these neamuri shalt tu find no ease, neither va the sole of tău picior au rest: dar DOMNUL va a da te acolo a trembling inimă, failing of ochi, și sorrow of mind:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו חייך תלאים לך מנגד ופחדת לילה ויומם ולא תאמן בחייך
verses.english: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.romanian: și tău life va hang in doubt înainte te; și să a se teme zi și night, și shalt au niciun assurance of tău life:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בבקר תאמר מי יתן ערב ובערב תאמר מי יתן בקר מפחד לבבך אשר תפחד וממראה עיניך אשר תראה
verses.english: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.romanian: In the morning să a spune, ar Dumnezeu it erau even! și at even să a spune, ar Dumnezeu it erau morning! căci the a se teme of al tău inimă wherewith să a se teme, și căci the sight of al tău ochi care să a vedea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשיבך יהוה מצרימה באניות בדרך אשר אמרתי לכם לא תוסיפון עוד לראותה והתמכרתם שם לאיביכם לעבדים ולשפחות ואין קנה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה דברי הברית אשר צוה יהוה את משה לכרת את בני ישראל בארץ מואב מלבד הברית אשר כרת אתם בחורב
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא משה אל כל ישראל ויאמר אליהם אתם ראיתם את כל אשר עשה יהוה לעיניכם בארץ מצרים לפרעה ולכל עבדיו ולכל ארצו
verses.english: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.romanian: și Moise a chemat lui toți Israel, și a spus lui them, voi au seen toți că DOMNUL a făcut înainte vostru ochi in the țara Egiptului lui Pharaoh, și lui toți lui slujitori, și lui toți lui țară;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המסות הגדלות אשר ראו עיניך האתות והמופתים הגדלים ההם
verses.english: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.romanian: The great temptations care al tău ochi au seen, the signs, și those great miracles:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא נתן יהוה לכם לב לדעת ועינים לראות ואזנים לשמע עד היום הזה
verses.english: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.romanian: Yet DOMNUL sunt nu given you an inimă to perceive, și ochi to a vedea, și urechi to a auzi, lui this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואוליך אתכם ארבעים שנה במדבר לא בלו שמלתיכם מעליכם ונעליכם לא בלו מעל רגליכם
verses.english: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy feet.
verses.romanian: și I au led you patruzeci ani in the pustie: vostru clothes sunt nu waxen old upon you, și tău shoe este nu waxen old upon tău picioare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לחם לא אכלתם ויין ושכר לא שתיתם למען תדעו כי אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: voi au nu eaten pâine, neither au voi drunk vin sau strong drink: că voi ar putea a cunoaște că I [am] DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותבאו אל המקום הזה ויצא סיחון מלך חשבון ועוג מלך הבשן לקראתנו למלחמה ונכם
verses.english: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.romanian: și când voi a venit lui this place, Sihon the rege of Heshbon, și Og the rege of Bashan, a venit out împotriva us lui battle, și we a lovit them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונקח את ארצם ונתנה נחלה לראובני ולגדי ולחצי שבט המנשה
verses.english: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.romanian: și we a luat lor țară, și a dat it căci an moștenire lui the Reubenites, și to the Gadites, și to the half seminție of Manasseh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את דברי הברית הזאת ועשיתם אתם למען תשכילו את כל אשר תעשון
verses.english: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.romanian: a păzi de aceea cuvintele of this legământ, și a face them, că voi poate prosper in toți că voi a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אתם נצבים היום כלכם לפני יהוה אלהיכם ראשיכם שבטיכם זקניכם ושטריכם כל איש ישראל
verses.english: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, [with] all the men of Israel
verses.romanian: voi a sta this zi toți of you înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău; vostru captains of vostru seminții, vostru elders, și vostru officers, [cu] toți the oameni of Israel

verses.samaritan_hebrew: טפכם ונשיכם וגרך אשר בקרב מחניך מחטב עציך ועד שאב מימיך
verses.english: Your little ones, and your wives, and thy stranger that [is] in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood and unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.romanian: vostru little ones, și vostru wives, și tău străin că [este] in tău tabără, din the hewer of tău lemn și lui the drawer of tău apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לעברך בברית יהוה אלהיך ובאלתו אשר יהוה אלהיך כרת עמך היום
verses.english: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.romanian: că tu shouldest enter into legământ cu DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și into lui oath, care DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău maketh cu te this zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמען הקים אתך היום לו לעם והוא יהיה לך לאלהים כאשר דבר לך וכאשר נשבע לאבתך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב
verses.english: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and [that] he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.romanian: că he poate establish te to zi căci a popor lui însuși, și [că] he poate fi lui te a Dumnezeu, as he sunt a spus lui te, și as he sunt sworn lui tău părinți, to Abraham, to Isaac, și to Jacob.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא אתכם לבדכם אנכי כרת את הברית הזאת ואת האלה הזאת
verses.english: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.romanian: Neither cu you numai a face I a face this legământ și this oath;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי את אשר ישנו פה עמנו עמד היום לפני יהוה אלהינו ואת אשר איננו פה עמנו היום
verses.english: But with [him] that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with [him] that [is] not here with us this day:
verses.romanian: dar cu [him] că standeth aici cu us this zi înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru, și de asemenea cu [him] că [este] nu aici cu us this zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אתם ידעתם את אשר ישבנו בארץ מצרים ואת אשר עברנו בקרב הגוים אשר עברתם
verses.english: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;)
verses.romanian: (căci voi a cunoaște cum we au dwelt in the țara Egiptului; și cum we a venit prin the neamuri care voi a trecut by;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותראו את שקציהם ואת גלליהם עץ ואבן כסף וזהב אשר עמהם
verses.english: (And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which [were] among them:)
verses.romanian: (și voi au seen lor abominations, și lor idoli, lemn și piatră, argint și aur, care [erau] între them:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פן יש בכם איש או אשה או משפחה או שבט אשר לבבו פנה היום מעם יהוה אלהינו ללכת לעבד את אלהי הגוים ההם פן יש בכם שרש פרה ראש ולענה
verses.english: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go [and] serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.romanian: Lest acolo trebuie să fi între you om, sau femeie, sau family, sau seminție, al cărui inimă turneth away this zi din DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru, to a merge [și] a sluji the gods of these neamuri; lest acolo trebuie să fi între you a root că beareth gall și wormwood;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה בשמעו את דברי האלה הזאת והתברך בלבבו לאמר שלום יהיה לי כי בשרירת לבי אלך למען ספות הרואה את הצמאה
verses.english: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.romanian: și it a veni to a trece, când he heareth cuvintele of this blesteme, că he bless însuși in lui inimă, saying, I va au peace, though I a umbla in the imagination of al meu inimă, to add drunkenness to thirst:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יאבה יהוה לסלח לו כי אז יחר אף יהוה וקנאתו באיש ההוא ורבצו בו כל האלה הכתובה בספר הזה ומחה יהוה את שמו מתחת השמים
verses.english: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL va nu spare him, dar atunci the anger of DOMNUL și lui jealousy va smoke împotriva că om, și toți the curses că sunt written in this book va lie upon him, și DOMNUL va blot out lui name din sub heaven.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבדילו יהוה לרעה מכל שבטי ישראל ככל האלות הברית הכתובה בספר התורה הזה
verses.english: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va separate him lui evil out of toți the seminții of Israel, după toți the curses of the legământ că sunt written in this book of the lege:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמר הדור האחרון בניכם אשר יקומו מאחריכם והנכרי אשר יבוא מארץ רחוקה וראה את מכות הארץ ההיא ואת תחלאיה אשר חלא יהוה בה
verses.english: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
verses.romanian: So că the generation to a veni of vostru copii că va a se ridica up după you, și the străin că va a veni din a far țară, va a spune, când they a vedea the plagues of că țară, și the sicknesses care DOMNUL sunt laid upon it;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: גפרית ומלח שרפה כל ארצה לא תזריע ולא תצמיח ולא יעלה בה כל עשב כמהפכת סדם ועמרה אדמה וצבאים אשר הפך יהוה באפו ובחמתו
verses.english: [And that] the whole land thereof [is] brimstone, and salt, [and] burning, [that] it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.romanian: [și că] the whole țară thereof [este] brimstone, și salt, [și] burning, [că] it este nu sown, nor beareth, nor vreun grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, și Gomorrah, Admah, și Zeboim, care DOMNUL overthrew in lui anger, și in lui wrath:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרו כל הגוים על מה עשה יהוה ככה לארץ הזאת ומה חרי האף הגדול הזה
verses.english: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? And what [meaneth] the heat of this great anger?
verses.romanian: Even toți neamuri va a spune, de aceea sunt DOMNUL done astfel lui this țară? și ce [meaneth] the heat of this great anger?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרו על אשר עזבו את ברית יהוה אלהי אבותם אשר כרת עמהם בהוצאו אתם מארץ מצרים
verses.english: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.romanian: atunci oameni va a spune, pentru că they au forsaken the legământ of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of lor părinți, care he a făcut cu them când he a adus them forth out of the țara Egiptului:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילכו ויעבדו אלהים אחרים וישתחוו להם אלהים אשר לא ידעום ולא חלק להם
verses.english: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and [whom] he had not given unto them:
verses.romanian: căci they a mers și a slujit alți dumnezei, și worshipped them, gods pe care they a cunoscut nu, și [pe care] he had nu given lui them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף יהוה בארץ ההיא להביא עליה את כל הקללה הכתובה בספר הזה
verses.english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.romanian: și the anger of DOMNUL era kindled împotriva this țară, to a aduce upon it toți the curses că sunt written in this book:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתשם יהוה מעל אדמתם באף ובחמה ובקצף גדול וישלכם אל ארץ אחרת כיום הזה
verses.english: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as [it is] this day.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL rooted them out of lor țară in anger, și in wrath, și in great indignation, și cast them into another țară, as [it este] this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הנסתרות ליהוה אלהינו והנגלאות לנו ולבנינו עד עולם לעשות את כל דברי התורה הזאת
verses.english: The secret [things belong] unto the LORD our God: but those [things which are] revealed [belong] unto us and to our children for ever, that [we] may do all the words of this law.
verses.romanian: The secret [things belong] lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul nostru: dar those [things care sunt] revealed [belong] lui us și to nostru copii căci ever, că [we] poate a face toți cuvintele of this lege.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יבאו עליך כל הדברים האלה הברכה והקללה אשר נתתי לפניך והשבות אל לבבך בכל הגוים אשר ידיחך יהוה אלהיך שמה
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call [them] to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, când toți these things sunt a veni upon te, the binecuvântare și the blesteme, care I au a așeza înainte te, și să a chema [them] to mind între toți the neamuri, whither DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt driven te

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושבת עד יהוה אלהיך ושמעת בקולו ככל אשר אנכי מצוך היום אתה ובניך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך
verses.english: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.romanian: și shalt return lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și shalt a asculta lui voice după toți că I command te this zi, tu și tău copii, cu toată inima ta, și cu tot sufletul tău;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושב יהוה אלהיך את שובתך ורחמך ושב וקבצך מכל העמים אשר הפיצך יהוה אלהיך שם
verses.english: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.romanian: că atunci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a se întoarce tău captivity, și au compassion upon te, și va return și gather te din toți the neamuri, whither DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău sunt scattered te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם יהיה נדחך בקצה השמים משם יקבצך יהוה אלהיך ומשם יקחך
verses.english: If LORD drove you out unto the outmost [parts] of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.romanian: dacă DOMNUL drove you out lui the outmost [parts] of heaven, din thence va DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău gather te, și din thence va he fetch te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביאך יהוה אלהיך אל הארץ אשר ירשו אבתיך וירשתה והרבך מאבתיך
verses.english: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a aduce te into the țară care tău părinți a stăpânit, și să a stăpâni it; și he va a face te good, și multiply te deasupra tău părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומל יהוה אלהיך את לבבך ואת לבב זרעך לאהבה את יהוה אלהיך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך למען חייך
verses.english: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va circumcise al tău inimă, și the inimă of tău sămânță, to a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu toată inima ta, și cu tot sufletul tău, că tu mayest a trăi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן יהוה אלהיך את כל האלות האלה על איביך ועל שנאיך אשר רדפוך
verses.english: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a pune toți these curses upon al tău enemies, și on them că hate te, care persecuted te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתה תשוב ושמעת בקול יהוה אלהיך ועשית את כל מצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום
verses.english: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD God of you, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.romanian: și să return și a asculta the voice of DOMNUL Dumnezeu of you, și a face toți lui porunci care I command te this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והותירך יהוה אלהיך בכל מעשה ידיך בפרי בטנך ובפרי אדמתך ובפרי בהמתך לטובה כי ישוב יהוה לשש עליך לטוב כאשר שש על אבתיך
verses.english: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hands, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va a face te plenteous in fiecare work of al tău mâini, in the rod of tău body, și in the rod of tău vite, și in the rod of tău țară, căci good: căci DOMNUL va again rejoice peste te căci good, as he rejoiced peste tău părinți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תשמע בקול יהוה אלהיך לשמר מצותיו וחקתיו הכתובה בספר התורה הזה כי תשוב אל יהוה אלהיך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך
verses.english: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, [and] if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.romanian: dacă să hearken lui the voice of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a păzi lui porunci și lui porunci care sunt written in this book of the lege, [și] dacă tu a se întoarce lui DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău cu toată inima ta, și cu tot sufletul tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי המצוה הזאת אשר אנכי מצוך היום לא נפלאת היא ממך ולא רחוקה היא
verses.english: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it [is] not hidden from thee, neither [is] it far off.
verses.romanian: căci this poruncă care I command te this zi, it [este] nu hidden din te, neither [este] it far off.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא בשמים היא לאמר מי יעלה לנו השמים ויקחה לנו וישמענו אתה ונעשנה
verses.english: It [is] not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.romanian: It [este] nu in heaven, că tu shouldest a spune, care va a se urca căci us to heaven, și a aduce it lui us, că we poate a auzi it, și a face it?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא מעבר לים היא לאמר מי יעבר לנו אל עבר הים ויקחה לנו וישמענו אתה ונעשנה
verses.english: Neither [is] it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.romanian: Neither [este] it beyond the sea, că tu shouldest a spune, care va a merge peste the sea căci us, și a aduce it lui us, că we poate a auzi it, și a face it?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי קרוב אליך הדבר מאד בפיך ובלבבך לעשותו
verses.english: But the word [is] very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.romanian: dar the cuvânt [este] foarte nigh lui te, in tău gură, și in tău inimă, că tu mayest a face it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראה נתתי לפניך את החיים ואת הטוב ואת המות ואת הרע
verses.english: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.romanian: a vedea, I au a așeza înainte te this zi life și good, și death și evil;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר אנכי מצוך היום לאהבה את יהוה אלהיך וללכת בדרכיו ולשמר חקיו ומצותיו ומשפטיו וחיית ורבית וברכך יהוה אלהיך בארץ אשר אתה בא שמה לרשתה
verses.english: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.romanian: In că I command te this zi to a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, to a umbla in lui căi, și to a păzi lui porunci și lui porunci și lui judecăți, că tu mayest a trăi și multiply: și DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău va bless te in the țară whither tu goest to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יפנה לבבך ולא תשמע ונדחת והשתחוית לאלהים אחרים ועבדתם
verses.english: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.romanian: dar dacă al tău inimă a se întoarce away, so că tu wilt nu a auzi, dar shalt fi drawn away, și worship alți dumnezei, și a sluji them;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הגדתי לכם היום כי אבד תאבדון לא תאריכון ימים על האדמה אשר אתם עברים את הירדן לבוא שמה לרשתה
verses.english: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, [and that] ye shall not prolong [your] days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.romanian: I denounce lui you this zi, că voi va negresit perish, [și că] voi va nu prolong [vostru] zile upon the țară, whither tu passest peste Iordan to a merge to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: העדתי בכם היום את השמים ואת הארץ החיים והמות נתתי לפניך הברכה והקללה ובחרת בחיים למען תחיה אתה וזרעך
verses.english: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, [that] I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.romanian: I a chema heaven și pământ to record this zi împotriva you, [că] I au a așeza înainte you life și death, binecuvântare și cursing: de aceea a alege life, că both tu și tău sămânță poate a trăi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לאהבה את יהוה אלהיך ולשמע בקולו ולהדבקה בו כי הוא חייך וארך ימיך לשבת על האדמה אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב לתת לכם
verses.english: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, [and] that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he [is] thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you.
verses.romanian: că tu mayest a iubi DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, [și] că tu mayest a asculta lui voice, și că tu mayest cleave lui him: căci he [este] tău life, și the length of tău zile: că tu mayest dwell in țara pe care DOMNUL sware lui tău părinți, to Abraham, to Isaac, și to Jacob, to a da you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילך משה וידבר את הדברים האלה אל כל ישראל
verses.english: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise a mers și a vorbit these cuvinte lui toți Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם בן מאה ועשרים שנה אנכי היום לא אוכל עוד לצאת ולאבוא ויהוה האמר אלי לא תעבר את הירדן הזה
verses.english: And he said unto them, I [am] an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.romanian: și he a spus lui them, I [am] an sută și douăzeci ani old this zi; I poate no more a ieși și a intra: de asemenea DOMNUL sunt a spus lui me, să nu a merge peste this Iordan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה אלהיך הוא העבר לפניך הוא ישמיד את הגוים האלה מלפניך וירשתם ויהושע הוא העבר לפניך כאשר דבר יהוה
verses.english: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, [and] he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, he va a merge peste înainte te, [și] he va a nimici these neamuri din înainte te, și să a stăpâni them: și Iosua, he va a merge peste înainte te, as DOMNUL sunt a spus.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה יהוה להם כאשר עשה לסיחון ולעוג מלכי האמרי ולארצם אשר השמיד אתם
verses.english: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va a face lui them as he a făcut to Sihon și to Og, regi of the Amorites, și lui the țară of them, pe care he a nimicit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנם יהוה לפניכם ועשיתם להם ככל המצוה אשר צויתי אתכם
verses.english: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL va a da them up înainte vostru față, că voi poate a face lui them according lui toți the porunci care I au commanded you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חזקו ואמצו אל תיראו ואל תערצו מפניהם כי יהוה אלהיך הוא ההלך עמך לא ירפך ולא יעזבך
verses.english: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he [it is] that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.romanian: fi strong și of a good courage, a se teme nu, nor fi afraid of them: căci DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, he [it este] că doth a merge cu te; he va nu fail te, nor forsake te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא משה ליהושע ויאמר אליו לעיני כל ישראל חזק ואמץ כי אתה תביא את העם הזה אל הארץ אשר נשבע יהוה לאבתם לתת להם ואתה תנחילנה אתם
verses.english: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.romanian: și Moise a chemat lui Iosua, și a spus lui him in the sight of toți Israel, fi strong și of a good courage: căci tu trebuie a merge cu this popor lui țara pe care DOMNUL sunt sworn lui lor părinți to a da them; și să cause them to a moșteni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהוה הוא ההלך לפניך הוא יהיה עמך לא ירפך ולא יעזבך לא תירא ולא תחת
verses.english: And the LORD, he [it is] that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL, he [it este] că doth a merge înainte te; he va fi cu te, he va nu fail te, neither forsake te: a se teme nu, neither fi dismayed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכתב משה את התורה הזאת ויתנה אל הכהנים בני לוי הנשאים את ארון ברית יהוה ואל כל זקני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise a scris this lege, și delivered it lui the preoți the fiii lui Levi, care bare the ark of the legământ of DOMNUL, și lui toți the elders of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו משה אתם לאמר מקץ שבע שנים במועד שנת השמטה בחג הסכות
verses.english: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of [every] seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles
verses.romanian: și Moise commanded them, saying, At the end of [fiecare] șapte ani, in the solemnity of the an of release, in the feast of tabernacles

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בבוא כל ישראל להראות את פני יהוה אלהיך במקום אשר בחר יקרא את התורה הזאת נגד כל ישראל באזניהם
verses.english: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.romanian: când toți Israel este a veni to appear înainte DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău in locul pe care îl va alege, să a citi this lege înainte toți Israel in lor hearing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הקהל את העם האנשים והנשים והטף וגרך אשר בשעריך למען ישמעו ולמען ילמדו וייראו את יהוה אלהיכם ושמרו לעשות את כל דברי התורה הזאת
verses.english: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that [is] within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.romanian: Gather the popor together, oameni, și femei, și copii, și tău străin că [este] în tău porți, că they poate a auzi, și că they poate a învăța, și a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, și a păzi to a face toți cuvintele of this lege:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובניהם אשר לא ידעו ישמעו ולמדו ליראה את יהוה אלהיהם כל הימים אשר הם חיים על האדמה אשר אתם עברים את הירדן שמה לרשתה
verses.english: And [that] their children, which have not known [any thing], may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.romanian: și [că] lor copii, care au nu known [vreun thing], poate a auzi, și a învăța to a se teme DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, as long as voi a trăi in the țară whither voi a merge peste Iordan to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה הן קרבו ימיך למות קרא את יהושע והתיצבו באהל מועד ואצונו וילך משה ויהושע ויתיצבו באהל מועד
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, iată, tău zile approach că tu trebuie a muri: a chema Iosua, și present yourselves in the tabernacle of the obște, că I poate a da him a charge. și Moise și Iosua a mers, și presented înșiși in the tabernacle of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויראה יהוה באהל בעמוד ענן ויעמד עמוד הענן אל פתח האהל
verses.english: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL appeared in the tabernacle in a stâlp of a cloud: și the stâlp of the cloud a stat peste the door of the tabernacle.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה הנך שכב עם אבתיך וקם העם הזה וזנה אחרי אלהי נכר הארץ אשר הוא בא שמה בקרבו ועזבוני והפרו את בריתי אשר כרתי אתו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go [to be] among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, iată, să sleep cu tău părinți; și this popor va a se ridica up, și a merge a whoring după the gods of the străini of the țară, whither they a merge [to fi] între them, și va forsake me, și a sfărâma meu legământ care I au a făcut cu them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחרה אפי בו ביום ההוא ועזבתים והסתרתי פני מהם והיו לאכלה ומצאהו רעות רבות וצרות ואמר ביום ההוא הלוא על כי אין אלהי בקרבי מצאוני הרעות האלה
verses.english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God [is] not among us?
verses.romanian: atunci meu anger va fi kindled împotriva them in că zi, și I va forsake them, și I va hide meu față din them, și they va fi devoured, și many evils și troubles va befall them; so că they va a spune in că zi, sunt nu these evils a veni upon us, pentru că nostru Dumnezeu [este] nu între us?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואנכי הסתר אסתיר פני מהם ביום ההוא על כל הרעה אשר עשו כי פנו אל אלהים אחרים
verses.english: And I will surely hide my face in that day from them for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.romanian: și I va negresit hide meu față in că zi din them căci toți the evils care they va au wrought, in că they sunt s-a întors lui alți dumnezei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה כתבו לכם את השירה הזאת ולמדה את בני ישראל שימה בפים למען תהיה לי השירה הזאת לעד בבני ישראל
verses.english: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: and put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: acum de aceea a scrie voi this song căci you, și a învăța it the copiii lui Israel: și a pune it in lor guri, că this song poate fi a witness căci me împotriva the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אביאנו אל האדמה אשר נשבעתי לאבתיו לתת להם זבת חלב ודבש ואכל ושבע ודשן ופנה אל אלהים אחרים ועבדום ונאצוני והפרו את בריתי
verses.english: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers to give them, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.romanian: căci când I va au a adus them into the țară care I sware lui lor părinți to a da them, că floweth cu lapte și miere; și they va au eaten și filled înșiși, și waxen fat; atunci va they a se întoarce lui alți dumnezei, și a sluji them, și provoke me, și a sfărâma meu legământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי תמצאנה אתו רעות רבות וצרות וענתה השירה הזאת לפניו לעד כי לא תשכח מפי זרעו כי ידעתי את יצרו אשר הוא עשה היום בטרם אביאנו אל האדמה אשר נשבעתי לאבתיו
verses.english: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware to their fathers.
verses.romanian: și it va a veni to a trece, când many evils și troubles sunt befallen them, că this song va testify împotriva them as a witness; căci it va nu fi uitat out of the guri of lor sămânță: căci I a cunoaște lor imagination care they a merge about, even acum, înainte I au a adus them into the țară care I sware to lor părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכתב משה את השירה הזאת ביום ההוא וילמדה את בני ישראל
verses.english: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: Moise de aceea a scris this song the same zi, și a învățat it the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו את יהושע בן נון ויאמר חזק ואמץ כי אתה תביא את בני ישראל אל הארץ אשר נשבעתי להם ואנכי אהיה עמך
verses.english: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.romanian: și he a dat Iosua the fiu of Nun a charge, și a spus, fi strong și of a good courage: căci să a aduce the copiii lui Israel into the țară care I sware lui them: și I va fi cu te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי ככלות משה לכתב את דברי התורה הזאת על ספר עד תמם
verses.english: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece, când Moise had a făcut an end of writing cuvintele of this lege in a book, until they erau finished

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו משה את הלוים נשאי ארון ברית יהוה לאמר
verses.english: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying
verses.romanian: că Moise commanded the leviți, care bare the ark of the legământ of DOMNUL, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לקחו את ספר התורה הזה ושמתם אתו מצד ארון ברית יהוה אלהיכם והיה שם בך לעד
verses.english: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.romanian: a lua this book of the lege, și a pune it in the side of the ark of the legământ of DOMNUL, Dumnezeul tău, că it poate fi acolo căci a witness împotriva te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אנכי ידעתי את מריך ואת ערפך הקשה הן בעודני חי עמכם היום ממרים הייתם עם יהוה ואף כי אחרי מותי
verses.english: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.romanian: căci I a cunoaște tău rebellion, și tău stiff neck: iată, în timp ce sunt yet alive cu you this zi, voi au been rebellious împotriva DOMNUL; și cum much more după meu death?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הקהלו אלי את כל זקני שבטיכם ושטריכם ואדברה באזניהם את הדברים האלה ואעידה בם את השמים ואת הארץ
verses.english: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.romanian: Gather lui me toți the elders of vostru seminții, și vostru officers, că I poate a vorbi these cuvinte in lor urechi, și a chema heaven și pământ to record împotriva them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ידעתי אחרי מותי כי השחת תשחתון וסרתם מן הדרך אשר צויתי אתכם וקרתה אתכם הרעה באחרית הימים כי תעשו את הרע בעיני יהוה להכעיסו במעשה ידיכם
verses.english: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt [yourselves], and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.romanian: căci I a cunoaște că după meu death voi va utterly corrupt [yourselves], și a se abate din the cale care I au commanded you; și evil va befall you in the latter zile; pentru că voi va a față răul înaintea DOMNUL, to provoke him to anger prin the work of vostru mâini.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה באזני כל קהל ישראל את דברי השירה הזאת עד תמם
verses.english: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit in the urechi of toți the obște of Israel cuvintele of this song, until they erau ended.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האזינו השמים ואדברה ותשמע הארץ אמרי פיי
verses.english: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.romanian: a da ureche, O voi heavens, și I va a vorbi; și a auzi, O pământ, cuvintele of meu gură.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יערף כמטר לקחי ותאזל כטל אמירתי כשעירים עלי דשא וכרביבים עלי עשב
verses.english: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.romanian: meu doctrine va drop as the rain, meu speech va distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, și as the showers upon the grass:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי בשם יהוה אקרא והבו גדל לאלהינו
verses.english: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: and ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.romanian: pentru că I va publish the name of DOMNUL: și ascribe voi greatness lui nostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הצור תמים פעלו כי כל דרכיו משפט אל אמונה ואין עול צדיק וישר הוא
verses.english: [He is] the Rock, his work [is] perfect: for all his ways [are] judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right [is] he.
verses.romanian: [He este] the Rock, lui work [este] perfect: căci toți lui căi [sunt] judecată: a Dumnezeu of truth și fără nelegiuire, just și right [este] he.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שחתו לא לו בני מום דור עקש ופתלתל
verses.english: They have corrupted themselves, their spot [is] not [the spot] of his children: [they are] a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.romanian: They au corrupted înșiși, lor spot [este] nu [the spot] of lui copii: [they sunt] a perverse și crooked generation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הליהוה תגמלו זאת עם נבל ולא חכם הלוא הוא אביך קנך הוא עשך ויכוננך
verses.english: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? [is] not he thy father [that] hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.romanian: a face voi astfel requite DOMNUL, O foolish popor și unwise? [este] nu he tău tată [că] sunt bought te? sunt he nu a făcut te, și established te?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זכרו יומת עולם בינו שנת דור ודר שאל אביך ויגידך זקניך ויאמרו לך
verses.english: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.romanian: adu-ți aminte de zilele of old, consider the ani of many generations: a întreba tău tată, și he va shew te; tău elders, și they va tell te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בהנחיל עליון גוים בהפרידו בני אדם יצב גבולת עמים למספר בני ישראל
verses.english: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: când the Most High divided to the neamuri lor moștenire, când he separated the fiii lui Adam, he a așeza the bounds of the popor după the număr of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי חלק יהוה עמו יעקב חבל נחלתו ישראל
verses.english: For the LORD's portion [is] his people; Jacob [is] the lot of his inheritance, Israel
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL's portion [este] lui popor; Jacob [este] the lot of lui moștenire, Israel

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יאמצהו בארץ המדבר ובתהללות ישמנהו יסבבנהו ויבננהו ויצרנהו כאישן עינו
verses.english: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.romanian: He found him in a pustie țară, și in the waste howling pustie; he led him about, he instructed him, he a păzit him as the apple of lui ochi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כנשר יער קנו ועל גוזליו ירחף יפרש כנפיו ויקחהו ישאהו על אברתו
verses.english: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, and fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, and taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.romanian: As an vultur stirreth up ei nest, și fluttereth peste ei young, spreadeth abroad ei wings, și taketh them, beareth them on ei wings:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה בדד ינחנו ואין עמו אל נכר
verses.english: [So] the LORD alone did lead him, and [there was] no strange god with him.
verses.romanian: [So] DOMNUL alone a făcut lead him, și [acolo era] no strange Dumnezeu cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ירכבהו על במתי הארץ יאכלהו תנופת שדי יינקהו דבש מסלע ושמן מחלמיש צור
verses.english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.romanian: He a făcut him ride on the high places of the pământ, că he ar putea eat the increase of the câmpuri; și he a făcut him to suck miere out of the rock, și ulei out of the flinty rock;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חמת בקר וחלב צאן עם חמת כרים ואילים בני בשן ועתודים עם חלב כליות חטה ודם ענב תשתה חמר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יאכל יעקב וישבע ישמן ישרון ויבעט שמנת עבית כשית ויטש אלה עשהו וינבלו צור ישועתו
verses.english: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered [with fatness]; then he forsook God [which] made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.romanian: dar Jeshurun waxed fat, și kicked: tu art waxen fat, tu art grown thick, tu art covered [cu fatness]; atunci he forsook Dumnezeu [care] a făcut him, și lightly esteemed the Rock of lui salvation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יקנאהו בזרים ובתועבות יכעיסהו
verses.english: They provoked him to jealousy with strange [gods], and with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.romanian: They provoked him to jealousy cu strange [gods], și cu abominations provoked they him to anger.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יזבחו לשדים לא אלה אלהים לא ידעום חדשים מקרב באו ולא שערום אבתיכם
verses.english: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new [gods that] came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.romanian: They sacrificed lui devils, nu to Dumnezeu; to gods pe care they a cunoscut nu, to new [gods că] a venit newly up, pe care vostru părinți s-a temut nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צור ילדך תשא ותשכח אל מהללך
verses.english: Of the Rock [that] begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.romanian: Of the Rock [că] begat te tu art unmindful, și hast uitat Dumnezeu că formed te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא יהוה וינאץ מכעס בניו ובנתיו
verses.english: And when the LORD saw [it], he abhorred [them], because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.romanian: și când DOMNUL a văzut [it], he abhorred [them], pentru că of the provoking of lui fii, și of lui fiice.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אסתיר פני מהם ואראה מה אחריתם כי דור הפכות הם בנים לא האמן בם
verses.english: And he said, I will hide my face from them, and I will see what their end [shall be]: for they [are] a very froward generation, children in whom [is] no faith.
verses.romanian: și he a spus, I va hide meu față din them, și I va a vedea ce lor end [va fi]: căci they [sunt] a foarte froward generation, copii in pe care [este] no faith.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הם קנאוני בלא אל כעסוני באבליהם ואני אקניאם בלא עם בגוי נבל אכעיסם
verses.english: They have moved me to jealousy with [that which is] not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with [those which are] not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.romanian: They au moved me to jealousy cu [că care este] nu Dumnezeu; they au provoked me to anger cu lor vanities: și I va move them to jealousy cu [those care sunt] nu a popor; I va provoke them to anger cu a foolish neam.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אש קדחה באפי ותוקד עד שאל תחתית תאכל ארץ ויבולה תלחט מוסדי הרים
verses.english: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.romanian: căci a foc este kindled in al meu anger, și va burn lui the lowest hell, va consume the pământ cu ei increase, și a așeza on foc the foundations of the munți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אספה עליהם רעות וחצי אכלה בם
verses.english: I will heap mischiefs upon them; and I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.romanian: I va heap mischiefs upon them; și I va spend al meu arrows upon them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מזה רעב לחמו רשף קטף מררים ושן בהמות אשלח בם עם חמת זחלי עפר
verses.english: [They shall be] burnt with hunger, devoured with burning heat, with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.romanian: [They va fi] burnt cu hunger, devoured cu burning heat, cu bitter destruction: I va de asemenea send the teeth of beasts upon them, cu the poison of serpents of the dust.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מחוץ תשכל חרב ומחדרים אימה גם בחור גם בתולה וינק עם איש שיבה
verses.english: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling [also] with the man of gray hairs.
verses.romanian: The sword fără, și terror în, va a nimici both the young om și the virgin, the suckling [de asemenea] cu the om of gray hairs.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אמרתי אפי הם אשבית מאנוש זכרם
verses.english: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.romanian: I a spus, I ar scatter them into corners, I ar a face the remembrance of them to cease din între oameni:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לו לא כעס איבי אגור פן ינכרו צרינו פן יאמרו ידינו רמה ולא יהוה פעל כל זאת
verses.english: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, [and] lest they should say, Our hand [is] high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.romanian: erau it nu că I s-a temut the wrath of the enemy, lest lor adversaries trebuie să behave înșiși strangely, [și] lest they trebuie să a spune, nostru mână [este] high, și DOMNUL sunt nu done toți this.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי גוי אבד עצות הם ואין בהם תבונה
verses.english: For they [are] a nation void of counsel, neither [is there any] understanding in them.
verses.romanian: căci they [sunt] a neam void of counsel, neither [este acolo vreun] understanding in them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא חכמו וישכילו זאת ויבינו לאחריתם
verses.english: And o that they were wise, and [that] they understood this, and [that] they would consider their latter end!
verses.romanian: și o că they erau wise, și [că] they understood this, și [că] they ar consider lor latter end!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איך ירדף אחד אלף ושנים יניסו רבבה אם לא צורם מכרם ויהוה הסגירם
verses.english: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.romanian: cum trebuie să unu chase a mie, și doi a pune zece mie to flight, except lor Rock had sold them, și DOMNUL had shut them up?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא כצורנו צורם ואיבינו פללים
verses.english: For their rock [is] not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves [being] judges.
verses.romanian: căci lor rock [este] nu as nostru Rock, even nostru enemies înșiși [fiind] judecători.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מגפן סדם גפנם ומשדמות עמרה ענביהם ענבי ראש ואשכלי מררות למו
verses.english: For their vine [is] of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes [are] grapes of gall, their clusters [are] bitter:
verses.romanian: căci lor viță [este] of the viță of Sodom, și of the câmpuri of Gomorrah: lor grapes [sunt] grapes of gall, lor clusters [sunt] bitter:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חמת תנינים יינם וראש פתנים אך זרי
