verses.english: Their wine [is] the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of strange asps.
verses.romanian: lor vin [este] the poison of dragons, și the cruel venom of strange asps.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הלוא הוא כנוס עמדי חתום באוצרתי
verses.english: [Is] not this laid up in store with me, [and] sealed up among my treasures?
verses.romanian: [este] nu this laid up in store cu me, [și] sealed up între meu treasures?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ליום נקם ושלם לעת תמוט רגלם כי קרוב יום אידם וחש עתידת למו
verses.english: To me [belongeth] vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in [due] time: for the day of their calamity [is] at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.romanian: To me [belongeth] vengeance, și recompence; lor picior va slide in [due] time: căci the zi of lor calamity [este] at mână, și the things că va a veni upon them a face haste.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ידין יהוה עמו ועל עבדיו יתנחם כי יראה כי אזלת יד ואפס עצור ועזוב
verses.english: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that [their] power is gone, and [there is] none shut up, or left.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL va judecător lui popor, și repent însuși căci lui slujitori, când he seeth că [lor] power este gone, și [acolo este] niciun shut up, sau left.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרו איה אלהימו צור חסיו בו
verses.english: And he shall say, Where [are] their gods, [their] rock in whom they trusted
verses.romanian: și he va a spune, Where [sunt] lor gods, [lor] rock in pe care they trusted

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר חלב זבחיהם יאכלו וישתו יין נסכם יקומו ויעזרוכם יהיו עליכם סתרה
verses.english: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, [and] be your protection.
verses.romanian: care a făcut eat the fat of lor sacrifices, și drank the vin of lor drink offerings? let them a se ridica up și help you, [și] fi vostru protection.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראו עתה כי אני אני הוא ואין אלהים עמדי אני אמית ואחיה מחצתי ואנכי ארפא ואין מידי מציל
verses.english: See now that I, [even] I, [am] he, and [there is] no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither [is there any] that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.romanian: a vedea acum că I, [even] I, [am] he, și [acolo este] no Dumnezeu cu me: I a ucide, și I a face alive; I wound, și I heal: neither [este acolo vreun] că poate deliver out of meu mână.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אשא אל השמים ידי ואמרתי חי אנכי לעולם
verses.english: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.romanian: căci I lift up meu mână to heaven, și a spune, I a trăi căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם שנתי ברק חרבי ותאחז במשפט ידי אשיב נקם לצרי ולמשנאי אשלם
verses.english: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.romanian: dacă I whet meu glittering sword, și al meu mână a lua hold on judecată; I va render vengeance to al meu enemies, și va reward them că hate me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשכיר חצי מדם וחרבי תאכל בשר מדם חלל ושביה מראש פרעת אויב
verses.english: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; [and that] with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revengers upon the enemy.
verses.romanian: I va a face al meu arrows drunk cu blood, și meu sword va devour flesh; [și că] cu the blood of the ucis și of the captives, din the beginning of revengers upon the enemy.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הרנינו גוים עמו כי דם עבדיו יקם ונקם ישיב לצריו וכפר אדמת עמו
verses.english: Rejoice, O ye nations, [with] his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, [and] to his people.
verses.romanian: Rejoice, O voi neamuri, [cu] lui popor: căci he va avenge the blood of lui slujitori, și va render vengeance to lui adversaries, și va fi merciful lui lui țară, [și] to lui popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא משה וידבר את כל דברי השירה הזאת באזני העם הוא ויהושע בן נון
verses.english: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.romanian: și Moise a venit și a vorbit toți cuvintele of this song in the urechi of the popor, he, și Hoshea the fiu of Nun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכל משה מדבר את הדברים האלה אל כל ישראל
verses.english: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.romanian: și Moise a făcut an end of speaking toți these cuvinte to toți Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם שימו לבבכם על כל הדברים אשר אנכי מעיד בכם היום אשר תצום את בניכם לשמר ולעשות את כל דברי התורה הזאת
verses.english: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe and to do, all the words of this law.
verses.romanian: și he a spus lui them, a așeza vostru inimi lui toți cuvintele care I testify între you this zi, care voi va command vostru copii to a păzi și to a face, toți cuvintele of this lege.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא דבר רק הוא מכם כי הוא חייכם ובדבר הזה תאריכון ימים על האדמה אשר אתם עברים את הירדן שמה לרשתה
verses.english: For it [is] not a vain thing for you; because it [is] your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong [your] days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.romanian: căci it [este] nu a vain thing căci you; pentru că it [este] vostru life: și prin this thing voi va prolong [vostru] zile in the țară, whither voi a merge peste Iordan to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה בעצם היום הזה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise că selfsame zi, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עלה אל הר העברים הזה הר נבא אשר בארץ מואב אשר על פני יריחו וראה את ארץ כנען אשר אני נתן לבני ישראל לאחזה
verses.english: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, [unto] mount Nebo, which [is] in the land of Moab, that [is] over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.romanian: Get te up into this munte Abarim, [lui] munte Nebo, care [este] in the țară of Moab, că [este] peste împotriva Jericho; și iată the țară of Canaan, care I a da lui the copiii lui Israel căci a moștenire:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומות בהר אשר אתה עלה שמה והאסף אל עמך כאשר מת אהרן אחיך בהר ההר ויאסף אל עמו
verses.english: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.romanian: și a muri in the munte whither tu goest up, și fi gathered lui tău popor; as Aaron tău frate a murit in munte Hor, și era gathered lui lui popor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על אשר מעלתם בי בתוך בני ישראל במי מריבת קדש מדבר צן על אשר לא קדשתם אתי בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: pentru că voi trespassed împotriva me între the copiii lui Israel at the ape of Meribah-Kadesh, in the pustie of Zin; pentru că voi sanctified me nu in the midst of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מנגד תראה את הארץ ושמה לא תבוא אל הארץ אשר אני נתן לבני ישראל
verses.english: Yet thou shalt see the land before [thee]; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: Yet să a vedea the țară înainte [te]; dar să nu a merge thither lui the țară care I a da the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת הברכה אשר ברך משה איש האלהים את בני ישראל לפני מותו
verses.english: And this [is] the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.romanian: și this [este] the binecuvântare, wherewith Moise the om of Dumnezeu binecuvântat the copiii lui Israel înainte lui death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה מסיני בא וזרח משעיר למו הופיע מהר פראן ואתו מרבבות קדש מימינו אשדות למו
verses.english: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand [went] a fiery law for them.
verses.romanian: și he a spus, DOMNUL a venit din Sinai, și s-a ridicat up din Seir lui them; he shined forth din munte Paran, și he a venit cu zece mii of saints: din lui right mână [a mers] a fiery lege căci them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אף חובב עמים וכל קדשיו בידך והם תכו לרגליך ושאו מדברתך
verses.english: Yea, he loved the people; and all his saints [are] in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; and [every one] shall receive of thy words.
verses.romanian: Yea, he a iubit the popor; și toți lui saints [sunt] in tău mână: și they sat down at tău picioare; și [fiecare unu] va receive of tău cuvinte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תורה צוה לנו משה מורשה קהלת יעקב
verses.english: Moses commanded us a law, [even] the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.romanian: Moise commanded us a lege, [even] the moștenire of the obște of Jacob.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בישרון מלך בהתאספו ראשי העם יחדו שבטי ישראל
verses.english: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people [and] the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.romanian: și he era rege in Jeshurun, când the capete of the popor [și] the seminții of Israel erau gathered together.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יחי ראובן ואל ימות ויהי מאתו מספר
verses.english: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let [not] his men be few.
verses.romanian: Let Reuben a trăi, și nu a muri; și let [nu] lui oameni fi few.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת ליהודה ויאמר שמע יהוה קול יהודה ואל עמו תביאנה ידו ריב לו ועזר מצריו תהיה
verses.english: And this [is the blessing] of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hand be sufficient for him; and be thou an help [to him] from his enemies.
verses.romanian: și this [este the binecuvântare] of Judah: și he a spus, a auzi, DOMNUL, the voice of Judah, și a aduce him lui lui popor: let lui mână fi sufficient căci him; și fi tu an help [to him] din lui enemies.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולוי אמר תמיך ואריך לאיש חסידך אשר נסיתהו במסה ותריבהו על מי מריבה
verses.english: And of Levi he said, [Let] thy Thummim and thy Urim [be] with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.romanian: și of Levi he a spus, [Let] tău Thummim și tău Urim [fi] cu tău sfânt unu, pe care tu didst prove at Massah, și cu pe care tu didst strive at the ape of Meribah;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האמר לאביו ולאמו לא ראיתי ואת אחיו לא הכר ואת בנו לא ידע כי שמרו אמירתך ובריתך ינצרו
verses.english: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.romanian: care a spus lui lui tată și to lui mamă, I au nu seen him; neither a făcut he acknowledge lui brethren, nor a cunoscut lui own copii: căci they au a păzit tău cuvânt, și a păzit tău legământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יורו משפטיך ליעקב ותורתיך לישראל ישימו קטרה באפיך וכליל על מזבחך
verses.english: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.romanian: They va a învăța Jacob tău judecăți, și Israel tău lege: they va a pune incense înainte te, și whole burnt sacrifice upon al tău altar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברך יהוה חילו ופעל ידו תרצה מחץ מתני קמיו ומשנאיו מי יקימנו
verses.english: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hand: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.romanian: Bless, DOMNUL, lui substance, și accept the work of lui mână: a lovi prin the loins of them că a se ridica împotriva him, și of them că hate him, că they a se ridica nu again.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולבנימים אמר יד יד יהוה ישכן לבטח וחופף עליו כל היום ובין כתפותיו שכן
verses.english: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.romanian: și of Benjamin he a spus, The beloved of DOMNUL va dwell in safety de el; și DOMNUL va cover him toți the zi long, și he va dwell between lui shoulders.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וליוסף אמר מברכת יהוה ארצו ממגד שמים מטל ומתהום רבצת תחת
verses.english: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD [be] his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath
verses.romanian: și of Joseph he a spus, binecuvântat of DOMNUL [fi] lui țară, căci the precious things of heaven, căci the dew, și căci the deep că coucheth beneath

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וממגד תבואת שמש וממגד גרושי ירחים
verses.english: And for the precious fruits [brought forth] by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon
verses.romanian: și căci the precious roade [a adus forth] by the sun, și căci the precious things a pune forth by the moon

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומראש הרי קדם וממגד גבעת עולם
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וממגד ארץ ומלואה ורצון שכן סנה תבואתה לראש יוסף ולקדקד נזיר אחיו
verses.english: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and [for] the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let [the blessing] come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him [that was] separated from his brethren.
verses.romanian: și căci the precious things of the pământ și fulness thereof, și [căci] the good va of him că dwelt in the bush: let [the binecuvântare] a veni upon the cap of Joseph, și upon the top of the cap of him [că era] separated din lui brethren.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בכור שור הדר לו וקרני ראמי קרניו בהם עמים ינגח יחדו אפסי הארץ הם רבבות אפרים והם אלפי מנשה
verses.english: His glory [is like] the firstling of his bullock, and his horns [are like] the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: they [are] the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they [are] the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.romanian: lui glory [este like] the firstling of lui bullock, și lui horns [sunt like] the horns of unicorns: cu them he va push the popor together to the ends of the pământ: they [sunt] the zece mii of Ephraim, și they [sunt] the mii of Manasseh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבולן אמר שמח זבולן בצאתך ויששכר באהליך
verses.english: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.romanian: și of Zebulun he a spus, Rejoice, Zebulun, in tău going out; și, Issachar, in tău tents.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עמים הרי יקראו ושם יזבחו זבחי צדק כי שפע ימים יינק ושפוני טמוני חול
verses.english: They shall call the people unto the mountain; and there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck [of] the abundance of the seas, and [of] treasures hid in the sand.
verses.romanian: They va a chema the popor lui the munte; și acolo they va offer sacrifices of righteousness: căci they va suck [of] the abundance of the seas, și [of] treasures hid in the sand.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולגד אמר ברוך מרחיב גד כלביה שכן טרוף זרוע גם קדקד
verses.english: And of Gad he said, Blessed [be] he that enlargeth Gad; he dwelleth as a lion, teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.romanian: și of Gad he a spus, binecuvântat [fi] he că enlargeth Gad; he dwelleth as a lion, teareth the arm cu the crown of the cap.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא ראשית לו כי שם חלקת מחוקק ספון ויתא ראשי העם צדקת יהוה עשה ומשפטיו עם ישראל
verses.english: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, [in] a portion of the lawgiver, [was he] seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.romanian: și he provided the întâi part căci însuși, pentru că acolo, [in] a portion of the lawgiver, [era he] seated; și he a venit cu the capete of the popor, he executed the justice of DOMNUL, și lui judecăți cu Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולדן אמר דן גור אריה ויזנק מן הבשן
verses.english: And of Dan he said, Dan [is] a lion's whelp: and he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.romanian: și of Dan he a spus, Dan [este] a lion's whelp: și he va leap din Bashan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולנפתלי אמר נפתלי שבע ורצון ומלא ברכת יהוה ימה ודרום יירש
verses.english: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.romanian: și of Naphtali he a spus, O Naphtali, satisfied cu favour, și full cu the binecuvântare of DOMNUL: a stăpâni tu the west și the south.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולאשר אמר ברוך מבנים אשר ויהי רצוי אחיו וטבל בשמן רגליו
verses.english: And of Asher he said, [Let] Asher [be] blessed with children; and let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his feet in oil.
verses.romanian: și of Asher he a spus, [Let] Asher [fi] binecuvântat cu copii; și let him fi acceptable to lui brethren, și let him dip lui picioare in ulei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ברזל ונחשת מנעליך וכימיך רביך
verses.english: Thy shoes [shall be] iron and brass; and as thy days, [so shall] thy strength [be].
verses.romanian: tău shoes [va fi] fier și brass; și as tău zile, [so va] tău strength [fi].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אין כאל ישרון רכב שמים בעזרך ובגאתו שחקים
verses.english: [There is] none like unto the God of Jeshurun, [who] rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.romanian: [acolo este] niciun like lui the Dumnezeu of Jeshurun, [care] rideth upon the heaven in tău help, și in lui excellency on the sky.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מעונה אלהי קדם ומתחת זרועת עולם ויגרש מפניך אויב ויאמר השמיד
verses.english: The eternal God [is thy] refuge, and underneath [are] the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy [them].
verses.romanian: The eternal Dumnezeu [este tău] refuge, și underneath [sunt] the everlasting arms: și he va thrust out the enemy din înainte te; și va a spune, a nimici [them].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישכן ישראל בטח בדד עין יעקב על ארץ דגן ותירש ואף שמיך יערפו טל
verses.english: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob [shall be] upon a land of corn and wine; and also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.romanian: Israel atunci va dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob [va fi] upon a țară of grâu și vin; și de asemenea lui heavens va drop down dew.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשרך ישראל מי כמוך העם הנושע ביהוה מגן עזרך ואשר חרב גאתך ויכחשו איביך לך ואתה על במתם תדרך
verses.english: Happy [art] thou, O Israel: who [is] like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who [is] the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.romanian: Happy [art] tu, O Israel: care [este] like lui te, O popor saved by DOMNUL, the shield of tău help, și care [este] the sword of tău excellency! și al tău enemies va fi found liars lui te; și să tread upon lor high places.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעל משה מערבת מואב אל הר נבא ראש הפסגה אשר על פני יריחו ויראהו יהוה את כל הארץ מנהר מצרים עד הנהר הגדול נהר פרת ועד הים האחרון
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אליו זאת הארץ אשר נשבעתי לאבתיך לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב לאמר לזרעך אתננה הראתיך בעיניך ושמה לא תעבר
verses.english: And the LORD said unto him, This [is] the land which I sware unto your fathers, unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see [it] with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui him, This [este] the țară care I sware lui vostru părinți, lui Abraham, lui Isaac, și lui Jacob, saying, I va a da it lui tău sămânță: I au caused te to a vedea [it] cu al tău ochi, dar să nu a merge peste thither.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימת שם משה עבד יהוה בארץ מואב על פי יהוה
verses.english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.romanian: So Moise the slujitor of DOMNUL a murit acolo in the țară of Moab, după the cuvânt of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקבר אתו בגיא בארץ מואב מול בית פעור ולא ידע איש את קברתו עד היום הזה
verses.english: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.romanian: și he buried him in a valley in the țară of Moab, peste împotriva Beth-peor: dar no om knoweth of lui sepulchre lui this zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומשה בן מאה ועשרים שנה במותו לא כהתה עינו ולא נס לחה
verses.english: And Moses [was] an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.romanian: și Moise [era] an sută și douăzeci ani old când he a murit: lui ochi era nu dim, nor lui natural force abated.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבכו בני ישראל את משה בערבת מואב שלשים יום ויתמו ימי בכי אבל משה
verses.english: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping [and] mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel wept căci Moise in the plains of Moab treizeci zile: so the zile of weeping [și] mourning căci Moise erau ended.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהושע בן נון מלא רוח חכמה כי סמך משה את ידו עליו וישמעו אליו בני ישראל ויעשו כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hand upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Iosua the fiu of Nun era full of the duh of wisdom; căci Moise had laid lui mână upon him: și the copiii lui Israel hearkened lui him, și a făcut as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא קם עוד נביא בישראל כמשה אשר ידעו יהוה פנים אל פנים
verses.english: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face
verses.romanian: și acolo arose nu a prophet since in Israel like lui Moise, pe care DOMNUL a cunoscut față în față

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לכל האתות והמופתים אשר שלחו יהוה לעשות בארץ מצרים לפרעה ולכל עבדיו ולכל ארצו
verses.english: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land
verses.romanian: In toți the signs și the wonders, care DOMNUL sent him to a face in the țara Egiptului to Pharaoh, și to toți lui slujitori, și to toți lui țară

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולכל היד החזקה ולכל המראה הגדול אשר עשה משה לעיני כל ישראל
verses.english: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.romanian: și in toți că mighty mână, și in toți the great terror care Moise shewed in the sight of toți Israel.
